chapters.title: Chapter 2780 A Moment of Infinity, A Leap of Quintessence! V
paragraphs: 2780 A Moment of Infinity, A Leap of Quintessence! V
DUM! DUM!
Heavy beats resounded out with an ever-increasing frequency..

The reality playing out was an astonishing one as the figure of the White Monkey buzzed with even more activity- the musical instruments around him, increasing by one as the moment the Prime Devourer placed his hand on Noah's visage- a golden horn appeared in the hands of the White Monkey, and he blew on it!
HUUM!
The booming sound of a horn as if it was the end of the world.
But it was ushering in something grand as a Tier 5 Hyperversal Extremity had gotten their hands on an entity that had yet to even condense a single Extremity Rune Scripture.
The result was already set in stone.
The history was over and done with. The ink had dried!
And yet with this unchangeable reality and knowledge they knew of...they were in for a surprise.
Records.
This was the thing that Noah chose to turn Infinite.
For what he wanted to do...for what he sought to accomplish- it could only be his Records that were taken towards infinity!
What he aimed for was something so utterly unfathomable that not a single other entity within the Vitalis Domains or the Vacuous Domains should have ever attempted it.
What he was gazing at was something Quintessential!
Now, what did it mean to turn one's Records infinite? What were Records?
They were a collection of everything that made up an existence. They were what had to be destroyed if one wanted to grant an existence True Death.
Records were one's history and memories.
Their very existence.
BOOM!
The moment Noah took his records towards Infinity, a phenomenal change took place as the Prime Devourer would be the first one to experience it!
1 Second for his Records to be infinite.
Within this one second, phenomenal change would occur as after it, nothing would be the same!

The moment the burly hands of the Primogenitor of the Yog-Nyarvax Infernal Extremity Lineage filled with billowing smoke grabbed onto Noah on the throne, his power unleashed freely as thousands of Crimson Hyperversal Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures descended like a tide, devouring and eating up Noah's very existence as behind him- a purple light had already been established between him and the Annals Inquisitor behind him.
This light flowed from his hands as it isolated and directed his force directly onto Noah's records- burning with a blazing light that pierced into the Vitalis Annals of Extremity!

Part of the vision of the Prime Devourer changed as he saw his black flames devouring a golden line hiding itself through layers and layers of records, and he followed its destination as he could sense with the aid of the Annals Inquisitor that it was linked to multiple bodies across different regions.
Now, he just had to burn all of these records along with the main body as one millisecond was more than enough for this!
He followed and devoured the golden light that became wider and wider until it turned into a river.
And from a river, it expanded into a vast golden sea.
The first thing the Prime Devourer noted was that it was a sea of records vaster than any distinguished Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity.
But it didn't matter.
BLAZE!

His will containing thousands of blazing Crimson Hyperversal Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures then unleashed its might fully as the entire golden sea appearing before the vision of the Prime Devourer became scorched and disappeared.
[Now...the only thing remaining is the link to the main bod-...!]

After the vast golden sea of records was scorched, the will of the Prime Devourer buzzed as before it, he didn't see a like leading back to the main body of his target as...an extension of a golden sea far vaster stretched out before him.
And it only seemed to be getting larger!

His will flashed with brilliance as an instant later, his billowing obsidian flames boomed and changed from, a Titanic amalgamation of an Infernal Worm representing the Yog-Nyarvax Infernal Extremity Lineage appearing.

It held a hundred pairs of flaming wings on its back and molten slime fell and scorched all nearby records- its head being made up of a circular spinning jaw with trillions of swirling obsidian teeth as the moment it appeared, a light of singularity flashed within the center of these jaws!
[Infernal Devouring]
And the vast sea of golden records before him and what stretched out in the distance all disappeared as if it had never existed.
The main ability of any accomplished Entity of the Yog-Nyarvax Infernal Extremity Lineage.
And from the hands of the Primogenitor of this Lineage itself, it was utterly deadly as it could eradicate the Records of multiple Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities all at once!
The vast seas of golden records before the Prime Devourer faded in the face of the illusory Infernal Worm, and yet...the Will of the Prime Devourer buzzed again.
The swathes of golden seas of records...seemed like they kept going.
It didn't seem like they diminished one bit.
[What!]
He bellowed out and prepared to continue devouring everything, but...
A millisecond had passed.
And he wasn't alone in this outside domain.
The valiant cry of an Esteemed Havenly Empress rang out in the outside reality.
[Celestia's Havenly Protection]!
BOOM!

A brilliant Golden light flashed around Noah's figure seated on the throne as a scorching pair of illusory wings appeared above, the burly hands of the Prime Devourer being rebuffed and pushed away as a sea of golden light filled with thousands of Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures unfolded!
The figure of Extremity Solarium finally appeared as with a grave expression, her will came to gaze upon Noah's figure on the throne.

She wasn't the only one as the wills of the two Esteemed Havenly Emperors she brought, the Annals Inquisitor, and the Primogenitor of Talismans behind the Prime Devourer all focused on Noah as shockingly...they still saw him sitting calmly on his throne!
The light in his eyes never dimmed.
The grandeur he released was not devoured and extinguished.
They were astonished, but none of them were more astonished than the Prime Devour who bellowed out a booming roar while his body transformed into that of a massive Infernal Worm!
His roar affirmed many things for them.
It told them that even after this Tier 5 Entity had his hands on Osmont seated on the throne, he wasn't able to eradicate him within the breadth of a millisecond.
This...was utterly unbelievable!

chapters.title: Chapter 2781 A Moment of Infinity, A Leap of Quintessence! VI
paragraphs: 2781 A Moment of Infinity, A Leap of Quintessence! VI
How?!
How did he survive when he was in the hands of a terrifying entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity?!
Such a question buzzed in the minds of all, and as if to answer them- the very cognizant will of Noah seated on the throne boomed out with a voice of utmost regality.
[You cannot extinguish that which is infinite.]
BOOM!

Surrounded by[Celestia's Havenly Protection], Noah uttered such heavy words as around him, reality congealed and shuddered as the Extremity Souls of Tier 5s expressed themselves on this domain, a shocking battle now about to unfold.
The Three-Headed Emperor Lion of the Havenly Animalia Extremity Lineage appeared before the Annals Inquisitor, his head releasing molten flows of time-space as he uttered coldly.
[Spacetime Continuum Desolation]
Space warped and distorted as the surrounding reality began to change.

Before the Primogenitor of Talismans, millions of branches of the Golden Willow Tree shot down, the reality below Noah's throne having already been altered as a shocking Domain Expansion unfolded from below seeking to cover everything!
[Domain Expansion- Life]
The lower end of the Minor Haven was entirely erased as verdant stellar rivers of light shot out with the massive Golden Willow Tree at the center and snaked above to cover everything.
And yet the body of the Prime Devourer continued its bellow as from above...
[9 Infernal Hells of Damnation!]
BOOM!

Thousands of Hyperversal Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures were burned as the top of the Minor Haven shattered entirely and no longer existed, pillars of obsidian crimson damnation and illusory Havens filled with obsidian flames appearing and layering themselves above!
This whole reality was entirely changed.

The pristine golden mountains within this Minor Haven of the Inheritance of Infinite Extremity became scorched and erased above while below, a few floating ones became filled with the verdant aura of life.
Forces above.
Forces below.
All at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity.
And at the center of it all was Noah who was covered by [Celestia's Havenly Protection], a dense number of prompts appearing before him at this moment!
[You are under the effects of the Celestia's Havenly Protection]
[You are immune to all attacks at Tier 4 and below for the next second.]
[You can resist 80% of all attacks of at Tier 5 for the next second.]
[10,000 Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of CELESTIA surge around and protect you for the next second!]
Prompts of the shocking capabilities of Extremity Solarium were unfolding as even more prompts about the Extremity of Life expanded below were about to come, but Noah tuned them all out.
He focused on the prompts about him as his very existence was currently feeling an unprecedented change!
[Your Records are stretching towards Infinity for the next second.]
[An unimaginable feat with unknown consequences!]
He felt all his Aspects of Existence buzz.
His soul, body, and origin obtained a sense as if they were being stretched out endlessly as he...couldn't truly describe this sensation.

His Origin that was forging the backbone of an Extremity Vein pulsed with ever grander fervor as the Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of VITALIS and VACUOUS above his main body within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven continued to rain down their authorities, the completion of his Ninth Aletheian Haven now reaching 90% as it didn't waste this chance!
And in the midst of all of this...all of the Loot multiplied by RUINATION that was leftover flowed into Noah's Origin to act as fuel.
He didn't channel it towards the Sporos V of Extremity.

It would not be enough to mature this seed, but it would be enough to aid for the last percentages of the Ninth Aletheian Haven that was urging its completion by refining and assimilating Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority- by establishing itself as the Unrecorded Quintessential Existential Hyperversal Extremity Superius Origin!
[An Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity has pervaded into your Records and sought to extinguish your very existence.]
The prompts continued to come.
[A Profoundly Quintessential Achievement!]
[The might of an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity failed to erase your records!]
A blinding light of Quintessence overflowed within his soul.

It was so bright and potent that it gushed out of his main body, and the dazzling spinning singularity of the Quintessence Planalith Krystallos that he was refining this whole time...devoured these massive waves of overflowing Quintessence before a moment later- its rotations came to a halt.
A multicolored crystalline stone now lay before Noah's main body as around it, Reality began to brighten up and become filled with shocking awe as all swirling authorities came to a momentary halt.
All authorities.
Vitalis and Vacuous included!
They all came to a stop at the birth of something so Quintessential.
[The Middle Grade Quintessence Planalith Krystallos has been successfully refined.]
[An impossible and unrecorded feat even for Entities that have stepped on the Gradations of Extremity!]
[Within the Quintessence Planalith Krystallos lies a Quintessential Seed of Extremity.]
It was a crystal like stone about 9 inches wide.
It held processed, refined, and purified authority of Quintessence...that contained a semblance of Extremity.
[Your proficiency in the Modified Golden Hyperversal Planalith Krystallos Refinement Art has increased by 10%!]
Not a Low Grade Planalith Krystallos.

Noah brought forth a Middle Grade Quintessence Planalith Krystallos in an unprecedented fashion due to an influx of achievements and waves of Quintessence, in addition to being in a state of Quintessential Unity of Existence and having his Records stretch towards Infinity!

[The Middle Grade Quintessence Planalith Krystallos is the second refined Krystallos from the True Emperor of Quintessence, and it has attained an impeccable level of grandeur as it is 100% effective in aiding the elevation of the Extremity of Quintessence across the First to the Fifth Gradation of Extremity, with its effectiveness fading greatly within the Sixth Gradation of Extremity. Forging something like this is an impossibility with the Golden Hyperversal Planalith Krystallos Refinement Art, and yet such a product was produced in your hands.]

[It's forging was an impossibility as when devoured only by the True Emperor of Quintessence, its fuel is theoretically enough to aid you in taking the step forward and arriving at the Extremity of Quintessence.]
Another millisecond had passed.
Within a second, there were 1,000 milliseconds as so far, three milliseconds had passed since Noah activated the 17th Boundary Layer of Infinity.
Time seemed to be moving so gloriously slow as at this moment, Noah's main body grabbed the Middle Grade Quintessence Planalith...and he threw it into his mouth and devoured it completely.
A Planalith Krystallos with a semblance of Extremity...of Quintessence.
HUUM!
His Aspects of Existence buzzed as a terrifying multicolored light exploded with immeasurable intensity.

His advancing Origin churned as trillions of Royal Cosmos were forged, the booming multicolored light of Quintessence flowing into it as the backbone of the Extremity Vein being forged was bombarded by the heavy multicolored light of Quintessence!
So much of this multicolored light flooded into it as another millisecond passed.
And...
[The Extremity Vein of Quintessence is being born.]
[The Ninth Aletheian Haven has reached 99% completion!]
Everything was coming to a close.
His Origin was about to be completed as thereafter, it promised the Sources of the Boundaries within it to achieve Extremity.
The Middle Grade Quintessence Planalith Krystallos was forged as within it lay a semblance of the Extremity of Quintessence.
And then...there was infinity as his records were being stretched towards it.
In this glorious coalescence of factors and time...Noah's will moved as at this time, he called forth the rewards of all Honorariums he had accumulated so far to be released.
THUMP!
The booming sound of a beating heart resounded, but it wasn't from Noah's body.
It stemmed...from the endlessly vast Infinite Hyperversal Haven around him as at this moment, this very Haven began to undergo a tremendous change.
[The forming Extremity Vein of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven is resonating with the Extremity Vein of Quintessence within your Origin.]
[A tremendous amount of Quintessential Feats and Honorariums have been accumulated over the last days.]
[Every single Quintessential Honorarium has only elevated itself from the last as with so many feats and actions of Quintessence, the Boundary of Quintessence can no longer deny it.]
[Your Body reflects Quintessence.]
[Your Origin radiates Quintessence.]
[Your Soul manifests Quintessence.]
An unimaginable radiance of multiple colors erupted from his main body freely as it began to travel towards his many clones.
Within his soul, this light was concentrated the most as at this moment, a Rune Scripture sought to form.
The light that surrounded it...was not crimson.
Nor was it obsidian.
Nor was it gold.
[You have opened the doors of an Unprecedented Path.]
The surrounding reality flowed once more as now, utter wildness flowed with it.
DUM! DUM!
Booming drums began to resound.
[The Vitalis Annals of Extremity shudder at your achievement.]
[The Vacuous Annals of Extremity tremble at your path!]
[The Aeonic Annals of Extremity herald your achievements across it.]
WA! WA! WA!
A terrifying crescendo began to build as within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, a low chant began to echo out.
The chant...echoed out Noah's name.
OSMONT!
Like a boom, it spread out far and wide.
Across Recorded History.
Across the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
Within the Nether Haven of Dissolution.
OSMONT!
The chanting of a devilish name began.
Within the Nether Haven of Genesis.
OSMONT!
The chants continued.
An unprecedented reality began to unfold as across innumerable records, his distinction spread as his achievements were revered!
Within the Nether Havens of Extremity.
Within the Supernal Havens of Extremity!
And...even in the far away Vacuous Domains of Extremity!
His name was being heralded across eons as before his eyes, a glorious affirmation rose.
[You have attained the Extremity of Quintessence!]

[The Vitalis Annals of Extremity shudder at your achievement.]
[The Vacuous Annals of Extremity tremble at your path!]
[The Aeonic Annals of Extremity herald your achievements across it.]
WA!
WA!
WA!
A terrifying crescendo began to build as within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, a low chant began to echo out.
The chant...echoed out Noah's name.
OSMONT!
Like a boom, it spread out far and wide.
Across Recorded History.
Across the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
Within the Nether Haven of Dissolution.
OSMONT!
The chanting of a devilish name began.
Within the Nether Haven of Genesis.
OSMONT!
The chants continued.
An unprecedented reality began to unfold as across innumerable records, his distinction spread as his achievements were revered!
Within the Nether Havens of Extremity.
Within the Supernal Havens of Extremity!
And...even in the far away Vacuous Domains of Extremity!
His name was being heralded across eons as before his eyes, a glorious affirmation rose.
[You have attained the Extremity of Quintessence!]

chapters.title: Chapter 2782 The Extremity of Quintessence! I
paragraphs: 2782 The Extremity of Quintessence! I
OSMONT!
The chants were like a neverending chorus.
Across the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Domains, they thundered out!
In the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.
Within the folds of Records, across the vast Vitalis Annals of Extremity.

An isolated domain existed that had a floating landmass the size of a small world pulsing with Vitalis Hyperversal Authority, with transparent white grasslands waving gloriously alongside tall oak trees radiating Vitalis.

In such a place, the figure of a woman adorned in a white robe and silver hair could be seen floating with her hands outstretched- Vitalis Hyperversal Authority gathering under her gestures as it flowed into a forming Vitalis Planalith Krystallos!
In such a critical period of time during her Refinement...
OSMONT!
A booming chant exploded out from the Records all around her that instantly destroyed her concentration and flow of Vitalis in the surroundings.
[Motherfu-]
OSMONT!
Her head rose and gazed out into the endless records with a glimmer of anger that soon turned into somberness.
The chants echoing out across the Annals of Extremity didn't stop!
Within the Supernal Havens of Extremity.
The Main Body of the Avernus Clan Overlord and Seer Amestris had gotten together as at this moment, their faces turned extremely dark as around them...
OSMONT!
A name was being chanted over and over again.
It was a chanting that showed a shocking level of honorarium that was heralded across the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, and it didn't stop after a few chants.
In the Supernal Haven of Dissolution, near the Obsidian Saurischian Archipelago where Noah's clone used to be.
The visage of the Tier 4 Extremity Blue heard the same chants as all others, her face shining with even more madness and Lunacy as with every chant, her eyes only became more crazed!
And then, outside of the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains- within the region where Vacuous and Vitalis Malignancies had endless Legions currently clashing against each other.

In an area filled with overlapping Domain Expansions of different concepts seeking Hegemony, Emperor Shao turned his head up while surrounded by rotating white pillars of Vitalis that were defending against chains of Infernal Authorities in the distance.
He and all others in this region could hear...
OSMONT!
The chanting of a glorious name.
It caused their gazes to change as their Wills probed out around them!
Far away from the clashing Legions, within the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains.
Inside the Infernal Haven of Perdition.
Within a Minor Haven made out entirely from the bones of a Titanopillar Species.
A man shrouded in a blue robe floated before the massive figure of a Vacuous Extremity that seemed to be in a deep slumber.
Three women floated a bit further away from him as they were devouring the Pure Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Perdition coalesced into crystalline bone mountains around them.

The man floating in front of the slumbering Vacuous Extremities was infusing his will and soul into such an Entity as he attempted to scale an unbelievable wall of subjugating such an Entity- this man being none other than the Great Usurper, Noah Eckert.
At this moment...
OSMONT!
A glorious chant split open the Aurora of authority above them as his head and the heads of the three women near him rose.
The cerulean eyes of Eckert flashed with tendrils of blue light as the shock within them couldn't be veiled, his voice echoing out a moment after before it was drowned out by more chants!
"Are you serio-"
OSMONT!
With booming glory.
A chorus continued.
As for the Entity responsible for it all?
He was experiencing something new that even he didn't fully know what exactly would come from it.
[An Unprecedented Path has been brought to life under your lead!]
[Your very existence burns with Quintessence.]
[You have taken a step forward and embarked on the Gradations of Extremity, with Quintessence showing the way forward.]
The prompts just came as thereafter, all light faded.
His consciousness seemingly came to a halt and became entirely dark as after the passage of an instant, he finally came to once more.
He was no longer gazing at the reality of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven or even the scene of the shocking battle within the Nether Haven of Helios.
He found himself...in what looked like a murky, dark, and extremely suffocating body of water that stretched out endlessly!

When his awareness came to, he began to see his surroundings better as he saw his figure anchored in this murky body of water, its tendrils wrapping around his body on all sides as if they were chains holding him in place.

And inches away from his illusory figure, he could see other figures all around him- their bodies showing dim glowing Golden or Obsidian Rune Scriptures on their chests as their glow...pushed away and even dissolved some of the many chains wrapping around them!
Innately, his eyes were drawn a distance away where he saw the illusory visage of Kazuhiko.

His figure was wrapped tightly by countless chains of murky light, and the dim glow of DARKNESS on his chest had shaken off some of these chains as his struggling figure was ever so slowly rising up across the murky waters.

His awareness turned elsewhere as he saw the devilish figure of Lilith, her face filled with the same struggling expression as everyone else- with the dim glows of HATRED, LUST, and a few more Scriptures on her chest cutting off the murky chains as her figure also rose a little higher in an extremely slow pace!
A far distance away, he recognized the illusory figure of Ayame whom he just elevated to Extremity.
A distance away, he saw the figure of the Kraken, Orion, and Aurelia!

The illusory images of Entities Noah could see weren't all on the same level as some floated higher than others, their bodies showing a constant expression of a struggle as they fought against the murky tendrils holding them in place- the glows of the Rune Scriptures on their body emanating light and slowly dissolving some of these chains as their bodies rose slightly higher every time!
None of them seemed to be cognizant of what was happening.
All they had was the same struggling expression.
None of them were like Noah, whose expression seemed calm and cognizant as his eyes and will gazed at the shocking scene of illusory figures around him!
Their numbers....were innumerable.

chapters.title: Chapter 2783 The Extremity of Quintessence! II
paragraphs: 2783 The Extremity of Quintessence! II
Noah's vision then gazed below him as past his feet, he saw the murky body of water end as further down, there was a congealed earth.

A solid state of matter as within it...the astonishing scene of trillions upon trillions of illusory figures could be seen entrenched on this earth- their hands raised up in a struggle as they sought to climb into the murky body of water!
He could see his son among the illusory figures with their hands raised high.
He could see Adelaide.
He could see a great number of people with their faces showing great torment and struggle as they just sought to grasp onto a line of demarcation that many would never cross!
HUUM!
At this moment, a glow began to radiate from Noah's chest as a flood of affirmations and information flowed in his mind.
Below him in the congealed earth that stretched out endlessly were Entities who had never grasped Extremity.
The further down they were, the lower they had achieved in their Boundary Layers.
Those close to the line of demarcation with their hands outstretched had arrived at the 17th Boundary Layer as they sought to enter the murky waters!
As they sought to enter the First Gradation of Extremity.
Noah retracted his gaze into this murky body of water once more as he saw the glow that began emanating on his chest...and it was the glow of Quintessence.
The moment it came to fruition, the countless murky chains holding his body in place began to burn and fall apart at a shocking speed!
When he gazed at his chest, he saw a Rune Scripture being into existence that read [QUINTESSENCE].
And this Rune Scripture...was colorless.
It almost seemed transparent as if it didn't exist.

Its radiance was much more domineering and tyrannical as while all other figures around Noah with their golden or obsidian Rune Scriptures had managed to destroy a decimal percentage of the chains holding them down, Noah's murky chains were falling apart from his body at such a shocking pace that within moments, his upper body held no more chains.
And as the transparent glow of Quintessence continued to spread over his body, he felt a shocking sense of freedom and power erupting out as with a flash of brilliance...
HUUM!
He felt great and irreversible changes occur as his whole body was covered by the transparent glow.
And at this moment, no chains were attached to him.
Like dried and dead roots, they all flaked away!
His figure stood there, unbound by any of the chains that countless other illusory figures were bound by.
[You have stepped on the First Gradation of Extremity!]

[The First Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scripture of QUINTESSENCE has formed, its immensity helping to constantly refine your Existence and acclimate it across the higher Gradations of Extremity.]

Prompts buzzed in his mind as he felt his Extremity Soul cheer the bathing of the Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scripture of QUINTESSENCE, his Body and Origin also burning with excitement as after becoming bathed by this light...they began elevating in power and might!

[The Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scripture is a type of Rune Scriptures that is unknown across Recorded History, with its capabilities and features only being written down after you test its limits.]
WAA!
Another glow began to bloom on his chest.

After the first Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scripture of QUINTESSENCE formed, another one also came to form as the intensity of the transparent light around Noah only became more potent!

His eyes radiated a shocking light of tyranny at this moment as he gazed around the other illusory figures bound down by their countless murky chains, while his body that was free of all chains...began to rise.
BOOM!
Like an erupting torpedo or missile.

While others seemed to be taking a snail's pace and moving a thousandth of an inch upwards, his body instantly shot up while surrounded by an immense transparent light as he crossed miles of the murky waters in an instant.

Around him, countless struggling faces were passed as the extremely murky waters only ever became slightly clear, with his speed being so fast that within a moment, he arrived at another line of demarcation.
The Line that demarcated the First and the Second Gradation of Extremity!
An innumerable number of souls were stopped below this line as when Noah gazed around him, he could see millions of Vitalis and Vacuous Lifeforms.
All of them struggling as one.
All of them seeking to find the same path.
All of them seeking to cross into yet another Gradation of Extremity!
Noah stopped below this line of demarcation briefly before his figure decisively shot upwards again.
HUUM!
Like an impenetrable layer, it stopped his advancement forward.
A great weight was pressed into his illusory figure that seemed to deny him entry- as if he didn't have enough authority or his Existence was not strong enough!

But the moment the second Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scripture of QUINTESSENCE was finished, the transparent glow around Noah only became more intense as his existence received another round of feedback and refinement- the demarcation that stopped him buzzing as he broke into it a moment after.
The Second Gradation of Extremity.
The pressure here was more intense.
The waters were slightly less murky.
But in the surroundings, there were still a great number of illusory figures wrapped by many chains trying to move up ever slowly.
Noah continued to move up freely, but his speed had slowed down.
There seemed to be an active pressure pointing down unto him as unless he held more Rune Scriptures and held a stronger Extremity Existence, he would only get slower and slower as he climbed up.
But then...
HUUM!
A third Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scripture of QUINTESSENCE began to bloom as he resumed his shocking speed once more.
But this wasn't all.
Around his chest, over a dozen Colorless lights bloomed in the next instant and sought to come to fruition as their strokes...did not read QUINTESSENCE.
One stroke trying to come to fruition began with TYR!
Another stroke began with PROT.
Another stroke began with LOO.
Another stroke began with ASCE!

Different Rune Scriptures representing other concepts began to light up with immeasurable grandeur around Noah's chest, his illusory figure becoming bathed with an intense transparent light as against the pressure pressing down on him...he shot up at an even faster pace!

At the same time, his Will became more cognizant as he could feel the rest of his existence once more, his soul coming back into awareness of the outside reality once more as at this moment...10 milliseconds of the 1,000 milliseconds of his Records being infinite had passed.
The unfolding reality around his main body was utterly baffling to look at as away from it...the Infinite Hyperversal Haven was even more terrifying to gaze at.
Erupting seas of authority were booming all around as each of them...carried a trace of Extremity.
A maddening light of Manadynamics.
A burning glow of Entropy.
A halcyon glow of Dreams!

The Aletheian Havens shook and tumbled as immeasurable changes bloomed across them, the forming Extremity Vein that passed through all of them radiating a profound light at this moment as a myriad of colors began to flow across the infinity symbol that was this Extremity Vein- as if an engine was now becoming fully functional and cycling shocking might!
And the man responsible for this all...

His main body was surrounded by three swirling massive transparent Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of QUINTESSENCE, a fourth one beginning to form as in his immediate surroundings- similar lights of Scriptures just like this has bloomed by the dozens.
This was occuring because...
[Your Nine Aletheian Havens have been completed.]
[The Extremity Vein of Quintessence within your Origin cycles and equilibrates your Authorities.]
[After the elevation of Quintessence, the rest of the Concepts with their Sources bound to you are elevating towards Extremity!]

chapters.title: Chapter 2784 The Extremity of Quintessence! III
paragraphs: 2784 The Extremity of Quintessence! III
After Quintessence, all others would follow!
The Concepts of the Body, Origin, and Soul that Noah stopped before rushed towards Extremity.
Manadynamics, Entropy, Gravitation, Dreams, Avalon...all Natural Laws and Decreta surged towards Extremity!
And there was something unique every time a Rune Scripture formed and with Quintessence....
[The Fourth Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scripture of QUINTESSENCE is being formed.]
Prompt after another came regarding the Scriptures of Quintessence.
They were termed Existential.
But for other Rune Scriptures...
[The First Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scripture of CULTIVATION is being formed.]
[The First Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scripture of MANADYNAMICS is being formed.]
[The First Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scripture of LOOT is being formed.]
Every single one thereafter, without a doubt...was not Havenly, or Infernal, or Existential.
The Rune Scriptures of those from the Vacuous Domains had the moniker of Infernal.
The Rune Scriptures of those from the Vitalis Domains had the moniker of Havenly.
While Vitalis and Vacuous themselves...formed a type of Existential Rune Scriptures for those who could truly bring out their power!
Noah's Quintessence was termed Existential as every one of his Boundaries that followed was neither Havenly nor Infernal, instead taking on the state of [Quintessential].
Every single one...was influenced by Quintessence.
As countless computations surged within Noah's mind, he knew that the reason every other Rune Scripture that came after Quintessence was Colorless...was simply due to Quintessence.
But what did the Colorless distinction actually grant?
He had already discerned one thing as he viewed the murky endless seas of the Gradations.
Other beings could not see them.
When Xiaomi or any of his Vassals stepped into the First Gradation of Extremity they saw nothing like this.
They didn't even have access to such a scene!
All of them...held looks of desperation and struggle as they tried to move up.

Meanwhile, Noah was cognizant of such a shocking scene as all the shackles that bound him were torn, and he affirmed at this moment that he...could freely traverse across the Gradations without a worry.
The moment such a thought rose in his mind, all other thoughts came to a stop.
Why...would he be able to traverse back and forth across the Gradations?
Why did the Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scripture of QUINTESSENCE grant this capability?
What he saw greatly changed again.
The vast majority of his vision came to see the murky endless sea he was crossing the Second Gradation of as his figure stopped.

Around him, one Colorless Rune Scripture after another continued to form as when he looked around him, he still saw throngs of Entities of all races bound by dense murky chains, only portions of their bodies freed by Golden or Obsidian Rune Scriptures as they crawled up slowly.
His gaze turned down as far, far in the distance, he could see the struggling figure of Xiaomi.
With his eyes flashing with brilliance, he stopped going up and began to descend as with a thought...
WAP!
His figure actually crossed the Gradations as if they were a movable space and teleported right beside Xiaomi.

An instant after, one of his Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of QUINTESSENCE pulsed with light before it dimmed just a little, but on Xiaomi's figure...
HUM!
Hundreds of murky chains among the countless ones burning her down were destroyed as her figure instantly rose up, moving a few miles above!

In the outside Reality, Xiaomi's figure that was floating far below the astonishing visage of Noah's main body like all other Vassals suddenly felt her existence tremble, and her power began to rise as within her soul, more Obsidian Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of RUIN began to forged.
Back in the scene of the endless murky sea, Noah's eyes shone with brilliance as prompts rose before him.
[One of the features of the Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scripture of QUINTESSENCE has unveiled itself.]
[The Feature of the Quintessential Gradation Guider has been Recorded!]
Quintessential Graduation Guider.
He...could seamlessly traverse across the Gradations of Extremity in any direction as what he could do thereafter...
He turned his head even further down.
Past the demarcation between the First and the Second Gradation of Extremity.
Past even this, he came to stare at the face of his struggling son below the Gradations of Extremity.
His soul buzzed.
He felt like he could do more.
So while staying in place...his finger tapped out towards the far distance below.

And another one of his Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of QUINTESSENCE released a blinding radiance before dimming as around his son...thousands of murky shackles snapped and shattered as his hand that was right at the demarcation bellow the First Gradation of Extremity...climbed up and passed through a long with the rest of his body.
His son...who held Crimson Consummate Boundaries.
The highest Boundary Noah had taken to Extremity in his unique state of Quintessential Unity of Existence was a Golden Consummate Boundary of Heat belonging to Ayame.
And yet with a single tap from him now...
HUUM!
His vision shifted again.

He gazed far below him within the changing Infinite Hyperversal Haven as he saw his son's figure radiate a blinding light...and a Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scripture of DESTINY began to form above him as he stared at it in shock and stupor.
This...was what Noah could do!
His vision shifted again.
His gaze mainly returned back into the endless murky waters as after affirming what he could do, he got back to himself as his figure stared up again.
This time, he looked at the furthest distance his vision could grasp in this unique space as he didn't even resume going back up like before.
He merely...
WAP!
His figure disappeared in a flash of brilliant light as he instantly came to arrive at the demarcation between the Second and Third Gradation of Extremity!

He felt a heavy pressure come down all around, and yet he acclimated to it instantly as many more Colorless Rune Scriptures now surrounded him, and his figure didn't halt for even an instant as he pierced right through this demarcation.
BOOM!
His existence buzzed.

His Body, Origin, and Soul vivaciously ate up the colorless light being released from his many Rune Scriptures as all of his Aspects of Existence were strengthened, with Noah taking a few milliseconds to acclimate to the Third Gradation of Extremity!

chapters.title: Chapter 2785 The Extremity of Quintessence! IV
paragraphs: 2785 The Extremity of Quintessence! IV
It was an utterly ridiculous reality.
Others were stuck on the First or Second Gradation of Extremity all of their lives as it took others hundreds, thousands, or even millions of years before they could cross these Gradations.
Noah....took a few milliseconds to arrive at the Third Gradation of Extremity.

And as he acclimated to the slightly less murky waters of the Third Gradation of Extremity, he saw tens of thousands of illusory figures with the same struggling faces all around him and continuing to stretch out into the endless sea.
Some with the Source of their existence within Vitalis, others within Vacuous.
Noah's vision spread wide as he gazed at the many Entities around him, his Will seemingly about to stumble into something when...
HUM!
Around his chest, a Runic Scripture reading ASCENDANCY happened to finish its formation.
The moment that the Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scripture of ASCENDANCY was fully formed, a blinding golden sea of light erupted from the depths of Noah's existence!
[The Extremity of Ascendancy seeks to exert its might after it has achieved Extremity.]
[Ascendancy seeks to elevate the transformation of the Extremity of Quintessence occurring due to his Ascendancy into the Gradations of Extremity!]
[The Feature of Quintessential Extremity Ascendancy has been born under the Extremity of Ascendancy.]
The very extremes of Ascendancy exerted their might as the details of the newly enacted feature weren't even fully ascertained before a grand change occurred in Noah's surroundings.

His body that was covered with a transparent light of utter majesty this whole time erupted with a golden light that actually attracted the endlessly murky waters and tendrils of chains all around Noah towards him- and this murky authority of the Gradations of Extremity was then devoured by the halcyon light of Ascendancy released from the Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scripture of ASCENDANCY and turned into a source of energy that...
Actually caused the Rune Scriptures around Noah to finish forming even faster as new ones began forming at an even faster rate!

The new feature of Quintessential Extremity Ascendancy seemed to actually take the bindings of the Gradations of Extremity and utilize them to further elevate Noah's transformation as while an influx of information entered his mind, Noah's eyes released a bright light.
He once more gazed down.

His vision crossed the Third and Second Gradations of Extremity as he arrived in the first, gazing at the figure of his son who had just begun to rise within this Gradation as when he locked onto him, he spoke out with a tyrannical authority.
[Quintessential Extremity Ascendancy].
A blinding golden light erupted around Henry as his transformation into a Hyperversal Extremity was vastly enhanced and elevated by the Extremity of Ascendancy!
Thereafter, Noah's gaze retracted into himself once more as he calmly stayed right above the line of demarcation of the Third Gradation of Extremity.
Climbing up was not an issue.

He was analyzing and making sure he wasn't missing any major things that were blooming with every Concept taken to Extremity as when he arrived at this thought, his eyes turned towards a concept that had not yet taken the step towards Extremity out of all the concepts he had.
And it was the one that he utilized as a fiery match to set things in motion- with a grand choice made from its 17th Boundary Layer due to his expectations for it!
He wanted to see whether a mere theory he held- whether a mere possibility he only imagined...could be achieved.
And as he basked in waves of Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Quintessence, he wanted to make his theory into a reality even if he had to do it forcefully!
So he looked deep within himself and stared at the source of the concept lying quiet and silent even as all others advanced.
[What are you doing?]
His booming voice was directed to none other than the concept of Infinity.

Its light was boundlessly vast as it continued to stretch his Records, and Noah fully turned the light and might of the Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Quintessence unto the Concept of Infinity at this moment!
Such an action was like a path being illuminated.
Akin to fuel being added to an ever raging flame.
It tipped the domino that began a shocking chain reaction as a moment later...
RUMBLE!
All of Noah's existence shook as the source of it...was his connection to the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
His Records stretching towards Infinity flooded across this channel of connection as his infinite records began to resonate with the Infinite Hyperversal Haven itself!
[An Unfathomable and Unrecorded Quintessential Resonance is taking place between extremely unalike Entities.]
[The Records of the Extremity of Quintessence stretching out towards Infinity are basking and flooding into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.]
The immeasurably vast Infinite Hyperversal Haven shook.
And a moment later, it stabilized with ease as this construct...had truly grown to a Quintessential level.
The formed Extremity Vein within it pulsed as the incoming records of Noah stretching towards Infinity were wondrously directed into this Vein in the shape of an Infinity symbol!
Thereafter...these records were cycled across as even though they were stretching towards Infinity, the Infinite Hyperversal Haven could handle them!
And at such a moment.
At the point that exactly 36 milliseconds of the 1,000 milliseconds of Noah's records being stretched towards Infinity passed...
BOOM!
His Extremity Vein of Quintessence and the Extremity Vein within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven pulsed with a multicolored light that went on to cover every stretch of this massive construct.
And thereafter...
[The vast Records of the Extremity of Quintessence are circulating across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.]
[The phenomenon has caused the Infinite Hyperversal Haven to actualize an unimaginable potential of itself as a Reservoir of Records!]
The moment he saw this prompt, Noah knew.
What he theorized...may no longer just remain a passing thought of glory within his mind.
And so, he put all of his cards forward.
[The Will of the Extremity of Quintessence surges with determination!]
[The Infinite Hyperversal Haven resonates with his Will and moves forward.]

[The Infinite Hyperversal Haven seeks to utilize the Records stretching towards Infinity as the basis to construct the backbone of an entirely separate Reservoir of Recorded and Unrecorded Histories outside of the Vitalis and Vacuous Annals of Extremity.]
[The Infinite Hyperversal Haven moves to construct the Quintessential Annals of Extremity!]

chapters.title: Chapter 2786 Decimating the Scales of Power! I
paragraphs: 2786 Decimating the Scales of Power! I
[The single use of the 17th Boundary Layer of Infinity is going on to forge an unfathomable construct.] [A glimpse of Infinity is being utilized and possibly stretched into permanence!]

[The Boundary of Infinity has reached a profound extreme and enters into the Gradations of Extremity!] Too many ridiculously important and reality altering things were happening all at once as Noah observed them all with utter care and scrutiny.
First, there was an idea.
An idea he held while looking at the Vitalis and Vacuous Annals of Extremity that were encompassed under the umbrella of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
He dared to think...what if he could enact his own Annals? His own library of Recorded and Unrecorded Histories?
To achieve this, he turned towards Infinity and the expansion of his Records- which should have theoretically affected the Infinite Hyperversal Haven that he was intricately connected to!
He just didn't think...it would work out so spectacularly.
At this moment, the Quintessential Annals of Extremity had begun its construction with Noah's endlessly stretching records as the building blocks.
And the work was far from being done.
Many things could happen as even something as grand as this could fail
After all...no other existence had even attempted such a ridiculous thing!
[And all of it...was made possible by a Spiritual Land from an insignificant world...]
While surrounded by dozens of swirling Colorless Hyperversal Existential and Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures, Noah's voice boomed out as it traversed across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
This construct...truly had humble beginnings.

And its current stage was an unbelievable one as at this moment, Noah saw the cycling authorities within the forming Extremity Vein of this construct rapidly increase their speed- a manifestation of Records in the form of countless Illusory pages erupted out and spread across these vast lands.
While this scene occurred, Noah once more focused on himself- specifically...on a brand new Rune Scripture that began to form within his Existence.
The concept that was causing the current changes in conjunction with Quintessence as even after Quintessence took the lead to Extremity and others followed it, this concept stayed still!

Noah now gazed at Infinity once more as after its actions of allowing a glimpse of Infinity were making way for something more permanent- something like the Quintessential Annals of Extremity, it was stepping into the Gradations of Extremity.
The strokes of a blinding Rune Scripture began.
And they...were not colorless.
With an astonishing cerulean glow as if it stemmed from an endless sea, a gorgeous blue erupted from this Rune Scripture and blazed out of Noah's existence!
A gorgeous blue that went on to cover and paint the stretches of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven and even the illusory manifestation of Endless pages erupting from its Extremity Vein.
It was so blinding that the visage of Henry entering the Gradations of Extremity had to avert his gaze and will.
It was so glaring that all other Entities within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven turned their heads down as if the brightness would scorch their existence!
Such a blinding light originated from Noah as the first Rune Scripture of Infinity twisted and turned, its strokes somehow forming the Infinity symbol before it branded itself into Noah's soul.

[The First Cerulean Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scripture of INFINITY has formed, its immensity helping to constantly refine your Existence and speedily traverse the higher Gradations of Extremity.] [The Cerulean Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scripture of Infinity is a type of Rune Scripture that is unknown across Recorded History, with its color chosen by the concept of Infinity itself as its capabilities and features only written down as you test its limits.] ...!
The Rule Scripture of Infinity did not get shaded by the grandeur of Quintessence.

It did not obtain the moniker of a Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scripture like all others that followed Quintessence as it was also its own Existential Extremity Rune Scripture!
And it chose its own color and distinction as it went with an ultramarine hue that was so blinding- to the extent its initial burst of light forced all others to turn their gazes down.
As soon as it formed...
BUZZ!
It radiated a domineering ultramarine light that pulsed and clashed with the dominant Colorless light of Quintessence!
Noah's soul buzzed as his eyes turned somber.
[The Existential Authority of Infinity burns with endless glory!]
[The Existential Authority of Quintessence burns with unfathomable majesty!]

His Existence received a massive shock as these two Existential Authorities seemingly came to clash, with Noah's eyes releasing a light of Tyranny as before such a phenomenon could get out of control, his Existence pulsed with undeniable power that grasped on the Sources of both of these concepts that he controlled.
[The One Who Led Quintessence and Infinity exerts his undeniable authority.]
HUM!
The One Who Led Quintessence and Infinity.
This was his distinction as both of these Existential Authorities came to be because of him!
He expanded their first Boundary Layers all the way to the Seventeenth Layer.
He bound their Sources as no matter their brilliance, they were ultimately his tools!

He reigned in their sources as their blinding lights and brilliance melded into his soul silently, the single Cerulean Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scripture of INFINITY glaring silently and with glory at the now Nine Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of QUINTESSENCE.
Their brilliance found their respective as thereafter, the Rune Scripture of Infinity did not sit still.

It turned its gaze towards the unfolding phenomenon of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as while stirred and directed by Noah's Soul... [The Cerulean Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scripture of Infinity is acting as the Architect of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity.] Infinity flashed with splendid brilliance as simultaneously...
[The Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scripture of QUINTESSENCE is acting as the Architect of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity.] ...!
The backbone was already being built by the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
Now, both the Existential Authorities of Infinity and Quintessence led as the architects of these astounding Annals of Extremity!

Such a blinding light originated from Noah as the first Rune Scripture of Infinity twisted and turned, its strokes somehow forming the Infinity symbol before it branded itself into Noah's soul.

[The First Cerulean Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scripture of INFINITY has formed, its immensity helping to constantly refine your Existence and speedily traverse the higher Gradations of Extremity.] [The Cerulean Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scripture of Infinity is a type of Rune Scripture that is unknown across Recorded History, with its color chosen by the concept of Infinity itself as its capabilities and features only written down as you test its limits.] ...!
The Rule Scripture of Infinity did not get shaded by the grandeur of Quintessence.

It did not obtain the moniker of a Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scripture like all others that followed Quintessence as it was also its own Existential Extremity Rune Scripture!
And it chose its own color and distinction as it went with an ultramarine hue that was so blinding- to the extent its initial burst of light forced all others to turn their gazes down.
As soon as it formed...
BUZZ!
It radiated a domineering ultramarine light that pulsed and clashed with the dominant Colorless light of Quintessence!
Noah's soul buzzed as his eyes turned somber.
[The Existential Authority of Infinity burns with endless glory!]
[The Existential Authority of Quintessence burns with unfathomable majesty!]

His Existence received a massive shock as these two Existential Authorities seemingly came to clash, with Noah's eyes releasing a light of Tyranny as before such a phenomenon could get out of control, his Existence pulsed with undeniable power that grasped on the Sources of both of these concepts that he controlled.
[The One Who Led Quintessence and Infinity exerts his undeniable authority.]
HUM!
The One Who Led Quintessence and Infinity.
This was his distinction as both of these Existential Authorities came to be because of him!
He expanded their first Boundary Layers all the way to the Seventeenth Layer.
He bound their Sources as no matter their brilliance, they were ultimately his tools!

He reigned in their sources as their blinding lights and brilliance melded into his soul silently, the single Cerulean Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scripture of INFINITY glaring silently and with glory at the now Nine Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of QUINTESSENCE.
Their brilliance found their respective as thereafter, the Rune Scripture of Infinity did not sit still.
It turned its gaze towards the unfolding phenomenon of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as while stirred and directed by Noah's Soul...

[The Cerulean Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scripture of Infinity is acting as the Architect of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity.] Infinity flashed with splendid brilliance as simultaneously...
[The Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scripture of QUINTESSENCE is acting as the Architect of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity.] ...!
The backbone was already being built by the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
Now, both the Existential Authorities of Infinity and Quintessence led as the architects of these astounding Annals of Extremity!

chapters.title: Chapter 2787 Decimating the Scales of Power! II
paragraphs: 2787 Decimating the Scales of Power! II
Both Infinity and Quintessence led the way as the Architects of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity.

And instantly, the trillions of illusory pages being released from the Extremity Vein became all that much more solid- and they melded and fused into the reality of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as a moment later...immense silence descended all around as if all noise was cut off.
As if all senses were momentarily cut off.
And only before Noah's will did a burst of information pass.
[The Records of the Extremity of Quintessence are his own.]

[The Records of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity are distinct and separate as any Recorded and possible Unrecorded Histories of the Extremity of Quintessence and those associated with him are being stricken off from the Vitalis and Vacuous Annals of Extremity!] ...!
A phenomenal prompt came.
A prompt...that had tremendous repercussions and long lasting effects.
Within the Supernal Havens of Extremity.

In the furthest reaches of the Supernal Haven of Genesis, austere white liquified Havenly Extremity Authority of Genesis floated into streams and circled a circular singularity of light that was the size of a grain of sand.
This singularity seemed to always twist and distort space as it was currently within the Supernal Haven of Genesis, but days ago, it was warped into the Supernal Haven of Penumbra!

Its exterior was covered by hundreds of thousands of Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of Havenly Authorities, such a dense yet silent convergence of power being enough to ground even an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity with a mere exertion of pressure.
And within this singularity, an astonishing scene could be observed.

As if entering an entirely new record of Reality, a paradisiacal space filled with rising flames of Havenly Authorities surrounded a massive obsidian Blacksmith's Forge that looked like an ancient castle unseen even in the olden times.

And this Forge had at its very center a crimson gold hammer that was currently smashing down by itself- its target actually being a miniaturized Minor Haven that was clustered together with a metalloid giving off waves of Extremity Authority!
Tens of thousands of Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of FORGING and SMITHING swirled around this hammer as it pounded down ever so often.

Around this austere forge, one could see a few hundred Armaments of Extremity displayed on its walls or floating around it with serenity- ranging from Armor, Helms, Axes, Spears, Swords, Vessels, and more.

One particular Armament was held in the hands of the only Entity within this domain, his burly brose hands grasping a Chalice radiating the glow of a Middle Grade Armament of Extremity as it shone with a golden light of Helios.
The Entity holding it was humanoid in his current form as his figure was a robust and sizable one, his arms thick from constant work as rolling muscles were powerfully hidden within.
His face carried a sense of age and mystery, as well as profound calmness and power as his dark hair messily arrived at his shoulders.
His upper body and its bulging bronze muscles were laid bare as black briefs radiating the glow of a Middle Grade Armament of Extremity covered his lower half.
This being was currently staring at the golden chalice within his hands as the Halton liquid within it was buzzing due to no other fact but... OSMONT!
The chorus of veneration and honor that bellowed out the name of a single being over and over again with a booming symphony.
The Eyes of the Extremity of Steel were calm as he listened to the chorus around him, his gaze complex as he seemed to be thinking about something else as he sighed.
[One more to add to the tally...but what difference does it make?]
Words holding great age and mystery echoed out from him as he listened to the profound symphony, comparing it to others he had heard in the past as... OSM-
His head rose.
He looked around.
He listened.
And...he heard nothing.
The booming chorus of honor and glory along with the chanting of the name had suddenly been cut off.
And this Entity knew it was forcefully cut off as he felt the very Records of this chanting disappear- as if they never existed!
His eyes blinked with a trace of surprise as he peered deeper.
Hundreds of thousands of Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures swirled around him from just a few concepts as he sought the Records of what had just occurred.
And his eyes went from surprise to astonishment as he...couldn't find any records of the glory and honorarium that was just being chanted.
As if it had never even existed!
[What...]
What had caused the chanting to cease? What happened to even the Records of this that even he could not find them?
Across the Vitalis and Vacuous Annals of Extremity, there were truly very little that he could not access.
HUUM!
His burly hand formed into a fist at this moment as around it, a dense cluster of Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of VITALIS bloomed as he uttered out a name.
[OSMONT...]
The name that was being honored and glorified just moments ago.
He knew of this being as the Vitalis Annals of Extremity whispered traces of the happenings of the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.
He knew of Noah Osmont and other rising figures amidst the Last Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification.
But he never actively sought information and records of this being before...until now.
And as he did so...
He couldn't find anything.
He couldn't locate even a trace of Records...of Noah Osmont.
Not that his records were veiled by some fearsome power, or somehow hidden in the furthest reaches of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity that even he could not access.
He turned his head to the Vacuous Annals of Extremity as even there, he received the same feedback.
That Noah Osmont...did not exist.
There were absolutely no records of him!
It was a finding that caused this powerful Primogenitor to turn entirely somber!

chapters.title: Chapter 2788 Decimating the Scales of Power! III
paragraphs: 2788 Decimating the Scales of Power! III
What the Aeonic Annals of Extremity were telling the Primogenitor of Steel...was that the Records of Noah Osmont did not even exist.
As if this being had never moved across the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.
As if he hadn't intricately interacted with multiple entities within it as his actions gradually caused shifts on a large scale!
And the Primogenitor of Steel...was not the only one.
Within the Domains of the Sima Clan.

The adulations and choruses of Noah's name were ringing within its walls as the visage of the old Seer of Sima gazed at him with shock, but with mere milliseconds passing...these adulations of his glory were suddenly brought to a halt.

Around the figure of Noah's clone, blinding light has only just begun to shine, but before the eyes of the Seer of Sima, Erikson, and the Extremity of Foundation...every trace of authority and aura around him receded and was entirely erased!
And in the next moment...the Seer of Sima gasped as her ancient eyes shook.
She had felt many shocking things in this very instant as the biggest one caused her to gaze towards Noah's visage with a trace of shock and dismay.
[Primogenitor...I cannot feel you anymore.]

She could feel a faint sense of connection this whole time through her lineage as through it, she had been able to send communications to whoever lay at the top of this Lineage- the being she now stood in front of!

Yet currently, she couldn't feel this connection at all as she felt a sense of loss and isolation, and yet at the same time...she could feel her blood churning and boiling as the Lineage from this Primogenitor should have been getting her another elevation.
But even as this was happening, she still felt a sense of grand loss.
As if she was partly included in a great lineage, but something so tremendously significant had occurred as at the same time, she felt entirely cut out of something unfathomable.

This feeling that the Seer of Sima felt close at hand...was something that all holders of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage would gradually come to feel as the Records of the Extremity of Quintessence were stricken off entirely from the Vacuous and Vitalis Annals of Extremity, and yet his footprints still remained within these domains as unless they completed the transition and stepped foot into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven... They would forever feel this sense of loss.
As if they were part of something grand, and yet they didn't have access to it, and nor could they obtain more information about it!
Even now as the Seer of Sima gazed at the visage of Noah's clone, it felt like he was enshrouded in a hazy light as if he would disappear right before her eyes any second.
This was what she experienced.

Far from the Sima Domains, within the Nether Haven of Helios where a conflict had begun in and yet currently...it was taking place in a spacetime continuum veiled within layers of Records and Talismans that other entities could not even access.

In such a domain, the Entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity and the uninvolved White Monkey- the Bard of Vitalis...were all gazing with scrutiny at Noah's figure that was seated on the throne calmly while around them, his veneration and adulations had been ringing out!
When the symphony of his name began to echo out, the Bard of Vitalis had stopped playing as he closed his eyes and listened to the playing symphony- this shocking entity being in his own groove.

Extremity Solarium was entangled with the Prime Devourer as a Titanic armored celestial form was taken by her that pushed back tens of thousands of Crimson Hyperversal Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures surrounding the Infernal Worm of the Yog-Nyarvax Infernal Extremity Lineage that only continued to blaze with power with every passing millisecond.

The Plantae and Animalia Fifth Gradation of Extremity Entities were entangled with the Annals Inquisitor and the Primogenitor of Talismans as undoubtedly...portions of their wills were focused on the Entity still seated on a throne amidst their shocking battle as they could feel something grand from him!

The moment that his name began to be sung in adulations, his body had erupted with a Colorless light that actually...caused the Crimson Hyperversal Havenly and Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures swirling around each of them to buzz with a sense of oppression.
Yes.
This was what caught their attention the most as they were truly powerful beings that knew a great deal of things.
When they asked themselves what kind of authority- what kind of power could show a sense of oppression against Crimson Rune Scriptures...there was only a single answer.
That answer was Existential.
But this...was a power reserved by powerful Primogenitors that could truly bring out the true extent of Vacuous and Vitalis!
It was reserved for beings who had undergone more than Five Existential Awakenings as far as they knew!
So how did this Entity before them who should have just been stepping into the stage of Extremity show a glimpse of such a power?
Was this the reason for his adulation?!

These buzzing questions rose in their minds as before they could be answered, an equally terrifying Cerulean light also flashed from his body ever so briefly as it caused their Crimson Rune Scriptures to feel the same sensation, but a moment after that... OSM-
WAP!
All of this light faded.
At the same time, the symphony of Adulations stopped.
The aura Noah had just begun to reveal entirely disappeared as on his throne, his eyes opened as for the first time, he began to rise.
The moment the symphony of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity was cut off, a light of surprise flashed on the eyes of the Primogenitor of Talismans who was the veiled identity of the Cimmerian Architect.

And right after the abrupt end of the chorus of his name...the Bard of Vitalis opened his eyes once more as an obsidian gold guitar emanating the profound light of a Middle Grade Armament of Extremity appeared in his hands, his human like fingers instantly landing on their chords as he began a booming beat!
HUUM!
