chapters.title: Chapter 2789 Decimating the Scales of Power! IV
paragraphs: 2789 Decimating the Scales of Power! IV
The chords of the guitar were resonant!

The Bard of Vitalis had his monkey like visage radiate a profound light as around his white fur, a few hundred thousand Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures began to swirl as the symphony he was creating right after Noah's ended seemed to affect him at a fundamental level.
At the same time, his head began to bop up and down as around him, illusory golden drums appeared as a heavy and victorious beat joined the symphony of the guitar.
It was a beat that seemed to be welcoming the rise of the Extremity of Quintessence from his throne as he gazed at the Entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity before him with a sharp gaze!
His Records were retracted from the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
His existence was veiled and hidden from all others as they didn't even know about the existence of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity that were being forged right now!
If they couldn't even access these records...what would they be able to do to him?
Even the Tier 5 Entities before him that seemed like an insurmountable wall would not be able to kill him- even if he didn't have the state of his Records stretching out towards Infinity.
At the same time, as he fully stepped into the Gradations of Extremity and slowly became familiar with the many concepts arriving at their extremes...he wondered something.
Just like his wonderings and musings of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity, he would see if he could make this musing into a reality.

So on the mark of 45 milliseconds after his records stretched towards Infinity and the Primogenitor of the Yog-Nyarvax Infernal Extremity Lineage attacked him, he rose from his throne without a single trace of aura or power as he gazed up at the apocalyptic reality above under the influence of a Domain Expansion...and his voice echoed out.
[I wonder...what will be enough before I can put you at the heels of my feet, O Primogenitor of the Yog-Nyarvax.]
What would be enough?

How many Colorless and Cerulean Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures did he have to attain? What Gradation did he have to reach before he could look at the terrifying being and power above him...and then thoroughly suppress it?
This was a daring question that the moment it was uttered out, the visage of the Infernal Worm above pulsated with utmost glory and offense.
The Prime Devourer did not like the flow of the current reality.
Things were taking too long, and the one involved was showing a great deal of mystery!
It had to end, and it had to end quickly.
So the countless swirling teeth on his worm-like body churned and cut apart reality as his thundering voice echoed out.
[Yog-Nyarvax Infernal Descent.]
HUUM!
So his power as a Primogenitor unfurled.
He called upon his Lineage and all the power he held that he spearheaded.

Behind him, the illusion of trillions upon trillions of worms flashed with a light of apocalypse as they descended unto the current reality, all of them coming to fuse from trillions of illusory lights until two massive illusory Infernal Worms with a hundred pairs of obsidian flaming wings and heads that had countless swirling jagged teeth.

The expression on Extremity Solarium changed drastically as these two Infernal Worms instantly bypassed her left and right, her figure that was surrounded by a celestial image of a Havenly Celestia Extremity trying to turn unsuccessfully as the main body of the Prime Devourer thundered down with indomitable might and tens of thousands of swirling Crimson Hyperversal Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures!

It momentarily tied her up as in the reality below, two massive and interminable illusory figures of Infernal Worms called upon by the descent of the Yog-Nyarvax Infernal Extremity Lineage itself...thundered down from Noah's left and right sides.
Two forces emanating power at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity came for him from two separate directions as...could the Extremity of Quintessence be capable of doing anything against it?
The gaze of the Extremity of Quintessence was a cold one as while gazing at these coming attacks, an unseen colorless brilliance began to wrap around his body as...his vision changed.
He viewed himself once more in the murky waters where he had arrived within the lowest bounds of the Third Gradation of Extremity.

He had yet to move a single step upwards, and yet around his body, scintillating Colorless Hyperversal Existential and Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures were blazing in abundance as after over 100 Concepts were taken to Extremity...the number of Rune Scriptures formed in the last few milliseconds reached 999!

This wasn't to mention the 9 Cerulean Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of INFINITY that were forming at a faster pace than all others- coming to match the rate of formation of the Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of QUINTESSENCE.
His Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures were grander than the common Crimson, Obsidian, or Golden Rune Scriptures that other beings held.

He didn't know by how much, but the rulings of how many Rune Scriptures demarcated the different Gradations of Extremity...were not applicable to him as he had to set his own rules that respected his Rune Scriptures!
So after he saw them spill over 1,000, his eyes rose up again as he stared out into the expanse of murky waters around him.
Tens of thousands of shackled beings could be seen all around him as even though they had broken and torn off some of the murky chains, they were still bound.
They were still not free.
In such a space, a blinding Colorless and Cerulean light blazed from Noah as he took a single step upwards, and his figure disappeared.
BOOOM!
An explosive book reverberated out as the waters where he was just at churned, his visage actually warping across the Third Gradation of Extremity as when he reappeared... BUZZ!
His eyes stared at a buzzing layer of heavy obstruction and uncrossable authority that was...the Demarcation between the Third and the Fourth Gradation of Extremity.
A single step.
This was all it took for him to go from the early stages of the Third Gradation of Extremity and to its Zenith.
The same stage that the Adjudicator of Dissolution was at when Noah first met her.
The same stage that was right at the cusp of another layer of brilliance that many never crossed in their lives!
HUUM!

As he arrived at the Zenith of the Third Gradation of Extremity, Noah felt the Extremity of Ascendancy once more devour the authority of the murky waters around him greedily as even more Rune Scriptures formed on his body, and his Body, Origin, and Soul continued to be refined and elevated by them as his Existence acclimated to this level of the Gradation of Extremity!
And as he peered ahead into the Fourth Gradation of Extremity that he had to cross the line of...

[You have come across the first Major Gradation of Extremity that many Entities with lesser Concepts of Extremity cannot easily cross.] [The Demarcation of the Fourth Gradation of Extremity seeks to test the worthiness of your Concepts of Extremity!]
A heavy light of pressure and majesty barreled out and tried to descend into his body.
The moment it did so...
[The Extremity of Cultivation gazes with endless disdain at the bottleneck seeking to hinder your Ascension!]
A blinding light of brilliance shone!

sentences.text: 2789 Decimating the Scales of Power!
IV
The chords of the guitar were resonant!

The Bard of Vitalis had his monkey like visage radiate a profound light as around his white fur, a few hundred thousand Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures began to swirl as the symphony he was creating right after Noah's ended seemed to affect him at a fundamental level.
At the same time, his head began to bop up and down as around him, illusory golden drums appeared as a heavy and victorious beat joined the symphony of the guitar.
It was a beat that seemed to be welcoming the rise of the Extremity of Quintessence from his throne as he gazed at the Entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity before him with a sharp gaze!
His Records were retracted from the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
His existence was veiled and hidden from all others as they didn't even know about the existence of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity that were being forged right now!
If they couldn't even access these records...what would they be able to do to him?
Even the Tier 5 Entities before him that seemed like an insurmountable wall would not be able to kill him- even if he didn't have the state of his Records stretching out towards Infinity.
At the same time, as he fully stepped into the Gradations of Extremity and slowly became familiar with the many concepts arriving at their extremes...he wondered something.
Just like his wonderings and musings of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity, he would see if he could make this musing into a reality.

So on the mark of 45 milliseconds after his records stretched towards Infinity and the Primogenitor of the Yog-Nyarvax Infernal Extremity Lineage attacked him, he rose from his throne without a single trace of aura or power as he gazed up at the apocalyptic reality above under the influence of a Domain Expansion...and his voice echoed out.
[I wonder...what will be enough before I can put you at the heels of my feet, O Primogenitor of the Yog-Nyarvax.]
What would be enough?
How many Colorless and Cerulean Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures did he have to attain?
What Gradation did he have to reach before he could look at the terrifying being and power above him...and then thoroughly suppress it?
This was a daring question that the moment it was uttered out, the visage of the Infernal Worm above pulsated with utmost glory and offense.
The Prime Devourer did not like the flow of the current reality.
Things were taking too long, and the one involved was showing a great deal of mystery!
It had to end, and it had to end quickly.
So the countless swirling teeth on his worm-like body churned and cut apart reality as his thundering voice echoed out.
[Yog-Nyarvax Infernal Descent.]
HUUM!
So his power as a Primogenitor unfurled.
He called upon his Lineage and all the power he held that he spearheaded.

Behind him, the illusion of trillions upon trillions of worms flashed with a light of apocalypse as they descended unto the current reality, all of them coming to fuse from trillions of illusory lights until two massive illusory Infernal Worms with a hundred pairs of obsidian flaming wings and heads that had countless swirling jagged teeth.

The expression on Extremity Solarium changed drastically as these two Infernal Worms instantly bypassed her left and right, her figure that was surrounded by a celestial image of a Havenly Celestia Extremity trying to turn unsuccessfully as the main body of the Prime Devourer thundered down with indomitable might and tens of thousands of swirling Crimson Hyperversal Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures!

It momentarily tied her up as in the reality below, two massive and interminable illusory figures of Infernal Worms called upon by the descent of the Yog-Nyarvax Infernal Extremity Lineage itself...thundered down from Noah's left and right sides.
Two forces emanating power at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity came for him from two separate directions as...could the Extremity of Quintessence be capable of doing anything against it?
The gaze of the Extremity of Quintessence was a cold one as while gazing at these coming attacks, an unseen colorless brilliance began to wrap around his body as...his vision changed.
He viewed himself once more in the murky waters where he had arrived within the lowest bounds of the Third Gradation of Extremity.

He had yet to move a single step upwards, and yet around his body, scintillating Colorless Hyperversal Existential and Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures were blazing in abundance as after over 100 Concepts were taken to Extremity...the number of Rune Scriptures formed in the last few milliseconds reached 999!

This wasn't to mention the 9 Cerulean Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of INFINITY that were forming at a faster pace than all others- coming to match the rate of formation of the Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of QUINTESSENCE.
His Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures were grander than the common Crimson, Obsidian, or Golden Rune Scriptures that other beings held.

He didn't know by how much, but the rulings of how many Rune Scriptures demarcated the different Gradations of Extremity...were not applicable to him as he had to set his own rules that respected his Rune Scriptures!
So after he saw them spill over 1,000, his eyes rose up again as he stared out into the expanse of murky waters around him.
Tens of thousands of shackled beings could be seen all around him as even though they had broken and torn off some of the murky chains, they were still bound.
They were still not free.

BUZZ!

And as he peered ahead into the Fourth Gradation of Extremity that he had to cross the line of...

chapters.title: Chapter 2790 Decimating the Scales of Power! V
paragraphs: 2790 Decimating the Scales of Power! V
It was a blinding light of brilliance that disdained the first Major Gradation of Extremity!
This Demarcation actually sought to test Noah's concepts as Quintessence and Infinity didn't even have to reveal their brilliance as Cultivation came forth.
[The Extremity of Cultivation denounces any bottlenecks in front of you.]

[So long as your Existence has achieved a sufficient level of refinement under the Gradations of Extremity, it will naturally bypass any bottlenecks under the authority of the Extremity of Cultivation!] There was a flash of brilliance.

The pressure descending unto Noah as if to test him of his worthiness was shattered as 9 Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of CULTIVATION blared grandly, Noah's very Existence experiencing a continuous round of Refinement and elevation as his body began to rise!

And as he crossed the Zenith Third Gradation of Extremity, every inch seemed to grant his existence bursts of an influx of power as his illusory figure hungrily devoured the murky seas of the Gradations of Extremity- his Rune Scriptures exploding in number as they instantly doubled to over two thousand in the next moment.

The blinding light around his figure only became more brilliant as by the time he came to touch the line of demarcation of the Third and Fourth Gradation of Extremity...the number of Rune Scriptures around him buzzed and tipped over 3,000.
His fair fingers wrapped in this brilliance touched the Major Gradation ahead as in the next moment, as if it weren't even a barrier... POP!
Like a bubble popping, he slid through to instantly arrive into the Fourth Gradation of Extremity.
Tier 4.
The stage of true powerhouses and even Extremity Overlords that spearheaded Clans and Major Inheritances.
On the 46th Millisecond after he stretched Infinity towards Extremity, Noah arrived at such a stage.
Within a mere fraction of a second- in its 46th Millisecond to be exact, he jumped from Tier 1 to Tier 4!
He didn't wait for hundreds, thousands, or millions of years- he truly only took milliseconds.
Which Extremity could compare?
Which other being could claim such honorariums?!
[A Quintessential Achievement!]

[You set the Records of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity as every action you take will be considered a baseline for others to look up to and be compared against.] [The more that others cannot come close to your accomplishments, the grander their Honorariums become.] [The Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scripture of QUINTESSENCE is gaining more glory and standing.] [The more breadth and identity it gains as an Existential Authority, the more its standing will rise in comparison to other Existential Authorities!] Prompts came.
Noah's will breezed over them as the moment he arrived into the Fourth Gradation of Extremity, he saw the waters around him being much less murky.
There was now some clarity.
Around him, he could still see shackled figures, but their expressions were no longer struggling as they all held contemplative faces.
As if they had arrived at a grand stage and were much more advanced than others below them.
And yet...even they were still chained.

But Noah didn't even have the luxury to pay attention to them as the moment he arrived in this Fourth Gradation of Extremity, he was met with an influx of these less murky waters along with a terrifying pressure that caused hundreds of Rune Scriptures to emerge from his existence.
His total number quickly doubled to 6,000 before continuing their ascent upwards!

When he achieved 9,999 Colorless and Cerulean Hyperversal Existential and Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures, they stopped multiplying in abundance as their light became concentrated and compressed into him.
It was the sign of yet another elevation.
[You live and breathe Quintessence and Infinity as they course through you.]

[You control Quintessence and Infinity as you are the one at the forefront of elevating their authority as for you, Quintessential and Infinity Awakening is not a true concept as it is merely your milestones.] [You have arrived at a milestone that after it is crossed, it will allow you to obtain the Quintessential Infinite Entity I Form!] WAA!
A milestone and a challenge appeared.

While it did so, Noah felt like he had also arrived at a crucial enough place to be capable of reacting and replying against the attacks thrown his way in the battle with multiple Entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity that he bore witness to Yes!

He, at the cusp of 9,999 Existential and Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures and at only the Fourth Gradation of Extremity...felt like he could actually respond against the attack of an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity!
It was an intuition.
It was a challenge for the Extremity of Quintessence as he sought to utterly abolish the established norms and Scales of Power.
It was a known and established Reality that Entities of lower Gradations could never compete against those of higher Gradations.
After all, being higher in Gradation meant many more Extremity Rune Scriptures as the concepts one took to Extremity...were that much more powerful!

An Entity in the Fifth Gradation of Extremity utilizing the concept of Heat and an Entity in the First Gradation of Extremity utilizing this very same concept would produce dramatically different results.
This was the norm.
But then, there was Noah.
He held Extremity Rune Scriptures of different Colors entirely.
He held concepts that were distinguished as Existential and Quintessential!
Would they not allow him to violate some of these established norms?
HUUM!
With a glimmer of light, his vision moved once more as the scene before the horrific attacks of the Prime Devourer played out.

To massive illusory Infernal Worms with a hundred pairs of obsidian flaming wings and heads that had countless swirling jagged teeth thundered from his left and right as each one carried a collection of Crimson Hyperversal Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures that added up to approximately 100,000.
Each!
They weren't attacks meant for Entities at the Fourth Gradation.
They were attacks meant to heavily injure Tier 5 Hyperversal Extremities!

chapters.title: Chapter 2791 Decimating the Scales of Power! VI
paragraphs: 2791 Decimating the Scales of Power! VI

Extremity Solarium was fully under the oppression of the Primogenitor of one of the Nine Infernal Extremity Lineages as even with her tremendous power, she was still stopped from aiding the being below her who faced a deadly attack.
He still had her Celestia's Havenly Protection around him, but she knew this wouldn't be enough!
At such a phenomenon, she gritted her teeth while calling out.
[Protect him!]

Her words caused the minds of the Prime Devourer and Annals Inquisitor to buzz with care as their wills spread out to look around, while the Primogenitor of Talismans smiled as if she had known something all along.

And extremely close to the Annals Inquisitor, a deadly ray of verdant obsidian light holding 100,000 compressed Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures shot out, its appearance causing the surrounding reality to melt as its source...was a hidden and veiled Tier 5 Entity who had never shown themselves this whole time!
The weapon that Extremity Solarium brought as she intended to use this chance to truly make a Tier 5 Vacuous Extremity fall.
She stemmed from the Extremity Lineage that was given the moniker of Extremity Assassins.
The smallest Entities in existence.
The Havenly Riboviria Extremity Lineage, it was a distinguished Ancestor known as the Havenly Assassinator- Bunyavirales!

Her visage wasn't even perceived as the Annals Inquisitor bellowed out in rage, dazzling obsidian scrolls pulsing with Rune Scriptures burning around her body as they defended against the surprise attack filled with a venomous verdant light that held Rune Scriptures of SEPTICITY, CONTAGION, and DISEASE.
The Havenly Assassin then flickered towards Noah's figure to protect him from the incoming attack of the Prime Devourer.
But...this was when Noah made a move himself.
He gazed at the illusory Infernal Worms representing a heavy power behind an Infernal Lineage as among the many tools he held, his mind quickly moved as he chose a single concept of Extremity.
Unseen by others, 99 dazzling Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures of PLOT flashed over his body.
Along with it, the dense Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Plot bloomed around Noah gloriously for the first time!
The Extremity of Plot.
Its usage was endless while observing a tremendous capability.

[The Extremity Layer of Plot]:: After traversing lesser layers for an extremely short period of time, Plot has ascended to the extreme as with enough Extremity Soul Values to activate a sufficient number of its Rune Scriptures, you can actively rewrite the unfolding plot of the reality around you. After crossing the Gradations of Extremity and growing sufficiently powerful enough, you can even edit the plot of Recorded and Unrecorded Histories yet to unfold, with the only limitation being how far forward or backward in time the plot is. The cost of Soul Values and the required number of Rune Scriptures to be activated will mainly be determined depending on what unfolding plot you are trying to alter, and to what extent... A fairly simplistic description.
But its means...were best expressed in action as Noah spoke out serenely.
[These illusory amalgamations of your Extremity Lineage...will always be getting near me, and yet never reach me.] ...!
His words were undeniable and thunderous.
The moment he spoke, the 99 Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Plot radiated a profound light to alter reality to how he directed it!

They gauged what opposed them as seeing the hundred thousand swirling Crimson Hyperversal Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures within each Infernal Worm coming left and right, they judged that they needed more power.
But so far, there were only 99 Rune Scriptures of Plot.
And it was at this point that one of the qualities of the Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures unveiled itself.
The thousands of Rune Scriptures hidden within Noah's body- Quintessence included, all surged and pulsed as their Hyperversal Extremity Authority backed Plot.
And the brilliance of Plot supported by over 9,000 Rune Scriptures unfurled.
Before the eyes of all beings, nothing had happened.
There were no fluctuations of power around Noah as his Rune Scriptures and power were only visible to him.
He only spoke and asserted the reality that the illusory amalgamations of the Infernal Worms would always be getting near him, and yet never reach him!
And in the next moment...
The Havenly Assassin that was coming to aid Noah stopped in her tracks.
Her small form was revealed as she looked like a devilish fae adorned in a verdant humanoid dress, with a cute face that currently blinked in shock!
She wasn't the only one as the other entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity felt the same thing- with the Prime Devourer feeling it the most as it was his attack that was directly involved!
In the distance, the chorus and beat from the Bard of Vitalis slowed as only the beat of the drums echoed out, even his eyes opening and watching the scene closely.
They all saw a fantastical phenomenon where the terrifying illusory Infernal Worms conjured by the Prime Devourer surged towards Noah's figure.
And they continued to roar out and surge towards Noah's figure.
They got near him.
And they got near him again.
But...they could never seem to reach him.
Visually, they felt and seemed like they were getting close to him and about to have a heavy impact, and yet...they never reached him!
In the distance, the Annals Inquisitor bellowed out in rage as she withstood the sneak attack that the Havenly Assassin had sent out.
A millisecond passed.
And another passed.
And the Infernal Words never got any closer.
And the head of the Extremity of Quintessence rose as he coldly gazed at the Prime Devourer above.

10% of his ever increasing Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul Values that were being altered to an even greater level right now were utilized in conjunction with all of his current Extremity Rune Scriptures to do it.
But he did.

He stopped an attack of an Entity from the Fifth Gradation of Extremity from reaching him- an attack that collectively held 200,000 Crimson Hyperversal Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures while he...only held 9,999 Colorless and Cerulean Hyperversal Existential and Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures!
So he gazed at the Primogenitor of one of the Nine Infernal Extremity Lineages.
And his voice thundered out as the Bard of Vitalis resumed his chorus at this very moment.
[I can already stop your attacks, O Prime Devourer.]
HUUM!

In the distance, the chorus and beat from the Bard of Vitalis slowed as only the beat of the drums echoed out, even his eyes opening and watching the scene closely.
They all saw a fantastical phenomenon where the terrifying illusory Infernal Worms conjured by the Prime Devourer surged towards Noah's figure.
And they continued to roar out and surge towards Noah's figure.
They got near him.
And they got near him again.
But...they could never seem to reach him.
Visually, they felt and seemed like they were getting close to him and about to have a heavy impact, and yet...they never reached him!
In the distance, the Annals Inquisitor bellowed out in rage as she withstood the sneak attack that the Havenly Assassin had sent out.
A millisecond passed.
And another passed.
And the Infernal Words never got any closer.
And the head of the Extremity of Quintessence rose as he coldly gazed at the Prime Devourer above.

10% of his ever increasing Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul Values that were being altered to an even greater level right now were utilized in conjunction with all of his current Extremity Rune Scriptures to do it.
But he did.

He stopped an attack of an Entity from the Fifth Gradation of Extremity from reaching him- an attack that collectively held 200,000 Crimson Hyperversal Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures while he...only held 9,999 Colorless and Cerulean Hyperversal Existential and Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures!
So he gazed at the Primogenitor of one of the Nine Infernal Extremity Lineages.
And his voice thundered out as the Bard of Vitalis resumed his chorus at this very moment.
[I can already stop your attacks, O Prime Devourer.]
HUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 2792 Decimating the Scales of Power! VII
paragraphs: 2792 Decimating the Scales of Power! VII
He could stop the attacks of an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity!
At the same time, he had just stepped into the Fourth Gradation of Extremity.
The Entities he faced were a whole Gradations higher as their Concepts of Extremity should have been more refined.
They should have been able to suppress him and make sure that under their glory, Noah couldn't exert any power!
And yet...
It was the absolute opposite as even though he was a whole Gradation lower, the Concepts he held were of much, much greater quality.
The foundation he had been building was unequaled across Recorded and Unrecorded History as it was now all erupting together at once to propel his power.

He held Existential and Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures of much grander quality when comparing to his enemies ahead as even though within their Existence there were ranges of a few hundred thousand Rune Scriptures while he only had 9,999...he felt like he could match them.
The only thing he had to do now...was to test his limits.
Just how ridiculous were the Dead Paths he opened? Just how profound had the other Concepts he influenced become?
He could only find out by pushing and then exceeding the absolute limits. He could only find out by going wild!
And so...
HUUM!
His body began to buzz as after the passage of a mere millisecond, the 10% of his Extremity Soul Values that were required to halt the attack of a Tier 5 Entity were entirely recovered.

The cerulean glow of Infinity seemed to be entirely behind this as while gazing at the Primogenitor of an entirely Lineage who was currently bubbling with even greater power, Noah turned to the depths of his soul as he sought which concepts to use and test.
There were many.
Some were better for certain situations, others were more tyrannical, while others were a bit of both.
He...leaned more towards Tyranny as his will came to land on the Extremity of Plagiarism.
Its 17th Layer was ridiculous enough, but the 18th and final Extremity Layer...it just further added onto this maddening concept as what he could not do before, he could very much do now!
And so, he began by testing its limits.
And before he did so, he had to ensure that his enemies would not have any possible route of return.

So a part of his mind also turned to Quintessence as he did multiple things simultaneously- this time pulling up on the Records of the Extremity of Quintessence as he affirmed another feature brought forth by this concept.
It related...how Extremities could expand their concepts into domains.
But for him, he could do something absolutely crazy.
Without a delay, his voice began to thunder out.
[Quintessential Extremity Domain Expansion...]
Not a normal Extremity Domain Expansion. Not yet the expansion of the Dynamis of Extremity that he needed to verify the convergence of before utilizing.
It was Quintessential.
[...Dreams.]
HUUM!
[Quintessential Extremity Domain Expansion- Apollyon.]
He uttered out twice.
After the first time, a golden light flashed as above was a hellish Infernal domain and below was a domain of life from the Tier 5 Entity of the Plantae Extremity Lineage.
But a moment after, a golden sandy glow erupted all around as it seemed like a shocking Domain was being expanded!
Another instant later, a crimson glow of hellish Apollyon also flashed as yet another supposed domain was overlapped.
But the reality causes the eyes of the Tier 5 Entities to shine as when their wills observed what was happening, they showed somberness.
They came to the conclusion that what was spreading out was no mere Extremity Domain.
It...looked extremely real.
What was unfolding was so profound that all of them in their hearts affirmed that at this very moment, two new genuine Havens were being formed!
A Haven of Dreams, and a Haven of Apollyon.

And as sandy gold mountains began to appear along with hellish crimson mountains and cosmos, the Tier 5 Entities came to realize these Havens had their backbone intricately stabilized by an uncountable number of foreign Natural Laws that would make it extremely hard if not impossible for others to leave them!
Such an action astonished them as it meant the Entity who had cast them wanted to keep everyone here.
As if he- who hadn't even achieved Extremity milliseconds ago, was not locked in this space with them.
That they were locked in here with him!

And as if to confirm this, the tyrannical will of the Extremity of Quintessence rang out again as unseen by others, over 100 Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Plagiarism flashed around his body.
[These amalgamations of your Extremity Lineage hold a decent power.]
His will was locked onto the massive illusions of the Infernal Worms still coming towards him and never reaching him as he continued.
[It would be a shame if such an authority was never yours to begin with.]
HUUM!
The very extreme of Plagiarism buzzed with his existence.
And it was then backed by all of his other Rune Scripture as he felt immeasurable droves of Mana and now, 9% of his total Extremity Soul Values be used up!
But an instant later, the dozens of pairs of wings on the backs of the massive Infernal Worms shuddered as from their spinning jagged teeth, a Colorless light flashed.
The Runes of Devouring, Perdition, and Vacuous buzzed before another authority was imposed on them.

A Colorless light tinged with a hue of Cerulean grandeur commandeered them as a moment later, all the 100,000 Rune Scriptures within each Infernal Worm became docile as if they had lost their identities.
Thereafter, the Extremity of Quintessence pointed with his hands upwards.
And the massive amalgamations of the Lineage of the Prime Devourer...
Turned up with his beckoning as their ferocious spinning mouths filled with innumerable jagged teeth turned their target to the same being that had called them forth.
Their target changed to the being who had called the very descent of his Lineage to bring them forth!
It was cold blooded!

chapters.title: Chapter 2793 Decimating the Scales of Power! VIII
paragraphs: 2793 Decimating the Scales of Power! VIII
An utterly disrespectful move was made on Noah's part as since he chose to go wild, he began moving rapidly.

While genuine Havens of Dreams and Apollyon were being forged to restrict this space, his figure breath out as his right hand pointed forward, one of the Infernal Worms shooting up and passing the figure of Extremity Solarium as it thundered onto the massive worm like figure of the Prime Devourer.

At the same time, his left hand turned into a fist as the Worm to the left felt a shocking pressure wrap around it, the Colorless and Cerulean light wrapped around its 100,000 Rune Scriptures exerting a reality altering force as the Extremity of Quintessence voiced out with confidence.
[The authority of these Extremity Rune Scriptures was always mine to begin with.]

The moment his words ended, the massive Infernal Worm to his left was reduced by half in size as 50,000 Extremity Rune Scriptures of Devouring, Perdition, and Vacuous disappeared in a blinding light that was concentrated and brought into Noah's own existence.
WAP!
A domineering light flashed thereafter as a few prompts rose before him.
[You are in the process of stealing the Source of Extremity of Four Concepts.]

[When their original holder cannot stop the Extremity of Plagiarism from stealing the concepts within his Existence, they will become your concepts...as they always were to begin with.] [You have devoured a tremendous quantity of Hyperversal Extremity Authority!]
He devoured 50,000 Rune Scriptures.

Their Tier was Crimson as the light of all of these Scriptures acted like a battering ram as they were gradually turned from Crimson and into a Colorless and Cerulean light, and within Noah's body... BOOM!
The limitation of 9,999 Rune Scriptures was instantly broken as he jumped to 14,999.
And his body began to feel the resumption of the elevation of his might and power as he felt like he could do even more!
Up above...
CRACK!
Reality split as the Prime Devourer bellowed while clashing with what should have been his own power.

The impact was maddening as a burst of pressure pushed the Infernal Worm back, causing tens of thousands of Rune Scriptures to disperse as the moment they did so, a Colorless and Cerulean light covered them as they turned into a light that Noah absorbed and assimilated!
His recent moves were a shocking marvel as he was about to continue, but he wasn't alone on this battlefield.
The symphony of the Bard of Vitalis picked up in the background as a wondrous voice filled with femininity and power echoed out.
[You were an interesting one as I expected.]
The voice stemmed from the Primogenitor of Talismans as she stared at Noah with shining eyes, her hands snapping as she continued.
[Let's test just how interesting you are...]
With her snap, over ten thousand talismans appeared and burned right after as space twisted.
And a moment later, Noah's face turned cold as above him, a massive palm covered by tens of thousands of Crimson Hyperversal Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures appeared.

To his left and right, two other palms appeared as below him, a fist manifested and came as he faced attacks on both sides- attacks that seemed to guarantee those contained in their circle would be hit and die!
And yet Noah's words rang out again as the Extremity of Plot flashed.
[I was never here.]
His visage disappeared.
BOOM!
A heavy impact reverberated as it hit nothing, the wills of Tier 5 spreading out quickly to look around as they quickly discovered Noah's figure.
He...had appeared above the heavily breathing visage of the Annals Inquisitor who was wounded by the surprise attack of the Havenly Assassinator, Bunyavirales!
He moved unpredictably as the moment he appeared, the face of the Annals Inquisitor changed as she heard drastic words.
[A tenth of your Existence is already mine.]
BOOM!
Plot and Plagiarism erupted out.
The capability to alter reality and the capability to steal the very reality of others mixed together, supported by Noah's ever increasing number of Rune Scriptures as he tested his limits!
He could say what he just did, but he couldn't say something like 'Half of your existence is already mine' or 'All of your existence is already mine'.
Not yet.
Not against Tier 5 Entities.

But what he said was enough to cause a huge gash on the head of the Annals Inquisitor, her veil being torn as an exceedingly beautiful woman with bronze skin became clear to all, her eyes burning with anger and pain as the light of her very existence escaped from the huge gash on her forehead and assimilated into Noah's figure!
His Rune Scriptures went from 14,999 to 24,999 right away.
Before he could make another move, the Annals Inquisitor clasped her hands as from her, obsidian pages fluttered out that covered everything around her, causing her to be wrapped in a tight cocoon!
Before Noah could react to this...
SHIING!
The aura of a Middle Grade Armament of Extremity appeared from this cocoon in the form of a sharp fan.

The Annals Inquisitor was angered and insulted so greatly that she pulled out all the stops, the fan enlarging in size and threatening to cleave the records of the existence above her as seeing it, Noah's eyes couldn't help but shine with brilliance!

He had utilized 30% of his Extremity Soul Values collectively in the last few moves as when he looked at the appearance of this Middle Grade Armament of Extremity he couldn't help but want to be even wilder.
So he spoke out shamelessly.
[What are you doing using my own weapon against me?]
His words caused astonishment to rise from the Tier 5 Entities around him as the Annals Inquisitor felt a foreboding sensation.
And an instant later, a brilliant light flashed as Noah expanded over 50% of his Extremity Soul Values to activate the might of 24,999 Extremity Rune Scriptures!

When the light faded, the black cocoon around the Annals Inquisitor was untouched, but her own weapon that she had branded with her very own soul and existence...she felt a searing pain as she gazed above to see the ridiculous Entity grasping an obsidian Fan in his hands.
It was her Middle Grade Armament of Extremity.

He unfurled it with a nod as he caused it to disappear a moment later, his mind already sending it to the depths of his soul into the transforming Infinite Forge where RUINATION would gain yet something else to devour to grow her!
His figure then looked around like an extreme menace as his recent actions caused the Tier 5 Entities to be astonished at his means and concepts of Extremity.
Weren't they...just a little too broken?

chapters.title: Chapter 2794 Unshackled Tyranny! I
paragraphs: 2794 Unshackled Tyranny! I
The concepts of Extremity one held defined who they were as an Existence.
A single concept taken to Extremity and focused upon as one arduously climbed the Gradations of Extremity could take one extremely far, with a simple flaring of their concept oppressing all others!
The Esteemed Havenly and Infernal Emperors who had achieved the Fifth Gradation of Extremity knew this.
They had seen many concepts throughout their lives, but the level of concepts this one being displayed right now as they freely rebuffed multiple Tier 5s...they didn't seem normal whatsoever!
So what exactly did he expand towards Extremity?
BOOM!
The questions came and went rapidly as a battle at their stage of power was too fast.
Within the span of less than a millisecond, a move could be made.

As Extremity Solarium, the Three-Headed Emperor Lion, the Havenly Assassinator, and the Willow Tree Esteemed Havenly Emperors fully joined the battle against the Prime Devourer, Annals Inquisitor, and the Primogenitor of Talismans...all of these beings fought to of overpower others with their own concepts of Extremity.
They sought to assert their dominance as Noah's appearance...asserted his own dominance amidst all of them as he withstood attacks from all three Esteemed Infernal Emperors!
DU! DU!
The beat of the drums from the Bard of Vitalis was booming.
The bear was picking up pace.
Looking at the incredulous figure of the Annals Inquisitor who had lost her Middle Grade Armament of Extremity, Noah's eyes shone as he called upon yet another concept of Extremity.
He was already forming a sandy Haven with it all around as now, his eyes saw many possible paths he could take as he came to confirm one.

So he pulled up on the very Extreme of the concept of Dreams as he turned into a luminous golden sandy sun, this light bathing over fluttering obsidian pages forming a protective cocoon around the Annals as a moment later...these obsidian pages filled with tens of thousands of Crimson Hyperversal Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures of VACUOUS, ANARCHOS, and DEFENSE began to change color.

They turned from Obsidian to gold gradually as the three extremes of Vacuous, Anarchos, and Defense actually became painted by a sandy gold light of dreams as they seemingly turned lethargic and sleepy- as if their very authorities were taken to the realm of Dreams!
With them in this state...Noah simply floated down as the cocoon protecting the Annals Inquisitor incredulously fluttered its now gold pages and opened up for him.

The Annals Inquisitor watched with a ferocious and burning expression as the gash on her head where 10% of her existence of her Extremity Clone had been taken away pulsed with injury, and yet her gorgeous unveiled face remained just as enticing.
As one ascended across the Gradations of Extremity, their beauty and existence only became more pristine as it was hard to find someone who wouldn't be the downfall of nations of common men!
Yet at their current stage of power, very few paid attention to looks.
To them, all that mattered was Extremity.

The enticing Annals Inquisitor gazed at Noah's visage as he seamlessly broke into her cocoon and came to float in front of her, his eyes radiating an intense sense of tyranny as even keeping her eyes on him actually gave her a sense of pressure!
His eyes were cold and calculating as she knew why this Entity was now before her.
She could sense it after the words and abnormality of the Primogenitor of Talismans recently.
She was the weakest one among the Infernal Emperors here.
This was why this Entity had appeared before her!

And after he came inches from her, his hand rose and formed into a fist as the cocoon closed, the slumbering tens of thousands of Rune Scriptures that she had called out being controlled by him to form an impenetrable Miniature Haven that was supported by a golden light in her eyes- but a Colorless light within Noah's eyes.

At the same time, 9 rings of light erupted from Noah and flashed to reinforce this Miniature Haven as both he and the Annals Inquisitor did not make a move against each other even though they were inches away!

Noah instead gave a momentary look to the far away Primogenitor of Talismans and the Prime Devourer who were facing the attacks of the Four Esteemed Havenly Emperors with Extremity Solarium in the lead before he came to focus on the Annals Inquisitor once more.
His Existence was getting strengthened, and so were the capabilities of his Body and the Nine Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction.
They were now bathed with the Colorless light of his ever increasing Rune Scriptures as their full might was yet to be quantified!

With them, the Miniature Haven of Dreams, and the tens of Thousands of Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures from the Annals Inquisitor that were now slumbering and following his commands, nobody would be able to break in for the next few milliseconds.
It was enough for him to proceed on the path he foresaw.
With a gash bleeding golden blood on her head, this Entity brought her hands down as her obsidian dress shimmered with the light of a Low Grade Armament of Extremity.
Her gaze was a cold one as she spoke.

[You are many times above what the Prime Devourer stated, and I understand why he came to try and kill you as soon as he could. Pity he failed...so let me be the first to congratulate you on your advancement and welcome you to the Gradations of Extremity.] ...!
Her gaze seemed free and unfettered as she was a being who had seen too much in both the Vitalis and Vacuous Annals of Extremity.

Noah gazed at her calmly as his body was building up power, a light she couldn't see gathering around him as for the first time since he entered the Gradations of Extremity, he was about to utilize his Soul Values and Rune Scriptures at the highest possible levels.

sentences.text: 2794 Unshackled Tyranny!
I
The concepts of Extremity one held defined who they were as an Existence.
A single concept taken to Extremity and focused upon as one arduously climbed the Gradations of Extremity could take one extremely far, with a simple flaring of their concept oppressing all others!
The Esteemed Havenly and Infernal Emperors who had achieved the Fifth Gradation of Extremity knew this.
They had seen many concepts throughout their lives, but the level of concepts this one being displayed right now as they freely rebuffed multiple Tier 5s...they didn't seem normal whatsoever!
So what exactly did he expand towards Extremity?
BOOM!
The questions came and went rapidly as a battle at their stage of power was too fast.
Within the span of less than a millisecond, a move could be made.

As Extremity Solarium, the Three-Headed Emperor Lion, the Havenly Assassinator, and the Willow Tree Esteemed Havenly Emperors fully joined the battle against the Prime Devourer, Annals Inquisitor, and the Primogenitor of Talismans...all of these beings fought to of overpower others with their own concepts of Extremity.
They sought to assert their dominance as Noah's appearance...asserted his own dominance amidst all of them as he withstood attacks from all three Esteemed Infernal Emperors!
DU!
DU!
The beat of the drums from the Bard of Vitalis was booming.
The bear was picking up pace.
Looking at the incredulous figure of the Annals Inquisitor who had lost her Middle Grade Armament of Extremity, Noah's eyes shone as he called upon yet another concept of Extremity.
He was already forming a sandy Haven with it all around as now, his eyes saw many possible paths he could take as he came to confirm one.

So he pulled up on the very Extreme of the concept of Dreams as he turned into a luminous golden sandy sun, this light bathing over fluttering obsidian pages forming a protective cocoon around the Annals as a moment later...these obsidian pages filled with tens of thousands of Crimson Hyperversal Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures of VACUOUS, ANARCHOS, and DEFENSE began to change color.

They turned from Obsidian to gold gradually as the three extremes of Vacuous, Anarchos, and Defense actually became painted by a sandy gold light of dreams as they seemingly turned lethargic and sleepy- as if their very authorities were taken to the realm of Dreams!
With them in this state...Noah simply floated down as the cocoon protecting the Annals Inquisitor incredulously fluttered its now gold pages and opened up for him.

The Annals Inquisitor watched with a ferocious and burning expression as the gash on her head where 10% of her existence of her Extremity Clone had been taken away pulsed with injury, and yet her gorgeous unveiled face remained just as enticing.
As one ascended across the Gradations of Extremity, their beauty and existence only became more pristine as it was hard to find someone who wouldn't be the downfall of nations of common men!
Yet at their current stage of power, very few paid attention to looks.
To them, all that mattered was Extremity.

The enticing Annals Inquisitor gazed at Noah's visage as he seamlessly broke into her cocoon and came to float in front of her, his eyes radiating an intense sense of tyranny as even keeping her eyes on him actually gave her a sense of pressure!
His eyes were cold and calculating as she knew why this Entity was now before her.
She could sense it after the words and abnormality of the Primogenitor of Talismans recently.
She was the weakest one among the Infernal Emperors here.
This was why this Entity had appeared before her!

And after he came inches from her, his hand rose and formed into a fist as the cocoon closed, the slumbering tens of thousands of Rune Scriptures that she had called out being controlled by him to form an impenetrable Miniature Haven that was supported by a golden light in her eyes- but a Colorless light within Noah's eyes.

At the same time, 9 rings of light erupted from Noah and flashed to reinforce this Miniature Haven as both he and the Annals Inquisitor did not make a move against each other even though they were inches away!

Noah instead gave a momentary look to the far away Primogenitor of Talismans and the Prime Devourer who were facing the attacks of the Four Esteemed Havenly Emperors with Extremity Solarium in the lead before he came to focus on the Annals Inquisitor once more.
His Existence was getting strengthened, and so were the capabilities of his Body and the Nine Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction.
They were now bathed with the Colorless light of his ever increasing Rune Scriptures as their full might was yet to be quantified!

With them, the Miniature Haven of Dreams, and the tens of Thousands of Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures from the Annals Inquisitor that were now slumbering and following his commands, nobody would be able to break in for the next few milliseconds.
It was enough for him to proceed on the path he foresaw.
With a gash bleeding golden blood on her head, this Entity brought her hands down as her obsidian dress shimmered with the light of a Low Grade Armament of Extremity.
Her gaze was a cold one as she spoke.
[You are many times above what the Prime Devourer stated, and I understand why he came to try and kill you as soon as he could.
Pity he failed...so let me be the first to congratulate you on your advancement and welcome you to the Gradations of Extremity.] ...!
Her gaze seemed free and unfettered as she was a being who had seen too much in both the Vitalis and Vacuous Annals of Extremity.

Noah gazed at her calmly as his body was building up power, a light she couldn't see gathering around him as for the first time since he entered the Gradations of Extremity, he was about to utilize his Soul Values and Rune Scriptures at the highest possible levels.

chapters.title: Chapter 2795 Unshackled Tyranny! II
paragraphs: Seeing his demeanor, the Annals Inquisitor gave a smile while wiping the Blood away on her gash that slowly healed.

{What, did you expect me to panic at the power you portrayed? You're powerful, yes, but that's it. I am here with my Extremity Clone as even if you are capable of erasing its Records, it won't matter much to me in the end- it's an injury I can heal from within a few hundred years. But after all this...you will become known.}
WAA!

{In the upper echelons of both Vitalis and Vacuous, you will be known. You will become a target for those even more powerful. Over the next few years, I may even get to watch someone as pristine as you with all of these fancy concepts of Extremity stripped of everything before my eyes.}
Her words were scathing as she was truly angered by Noah's actions of taking her Middle Grade Armament of Extremity and a tenth of the existence of her Extremity Clone!
And yet at her words, Noah shook his head as the power he had built up was enough.
{You will not get to live for another few Milliseconds, much less years.}
HUUM!
His words were utterly disrespectful ones as the Annals Inquisitor scoffed, her red lips forming into a rageful smile as she replied.
{Hah, go ahead and show off your power. I came here with an Extremity Clone knowing of the dangers as losing it is not-}
{What are you talking about?}
Her words didn't finish as Noah was looking at her quizzically as if she was confused.

And he continued as the light of the Extremity of Plot reached an unprecedented level, backed by thousands of Colorless and Cerulean Hyperversal Existential and Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures that had now broken past 29,999.
{You were never here with your Extremity Clone. You were here with your Main Body- the very vessel that contains the core of your Existence.}
The smile on the Annals Inquisitor was wiped away so very quickly.
Incredulity and a sense of disbelief dawned on her face.
{Impossibl-}
BOOM!
Reality twisted and tore.
Noah felt his own existence shudder as all at once, over 70% of his Extremity Soul Values that were continuing to scale upwards exponentially these past milliseconds were used up.
All of his Rune Scriptures flashed maddeningly as they supported the utmost extreme of Plot!

And the result was that after a reality distorting flash of light, the scene before Noah now showed an unblemished visage of a woman adorned in a white battledress radiating waves of a Low Grade Armament of Extremity, her dark hair fluttering with awe as she was in a seated position with her hands outstretched.

In front of her, a slowly spinning Vacuous Planalith Krystallos came to a halt and fractured, its Refinement failing as the one who had been refining it- the Main Body of the Annals Inquisitor...gazed around with incredulity and a sense of dawning horror!
Her...her main body!
It was located in layers of veiled Records within the Vacuous Annals of Extremity as now...it suddenly appeared right in front of this terrifying existence!

The expression on the face of the Annals Inquisitor became utterly dreadful as she was no longer so calm, her body exploding out as her outstretched hands instantly conjured a flaming Low Grade Armament of Extremity in the form of an immeasurably sharp sword- tens of thousands of Hyperversal Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures of Anarchos burning with blazing white flames around this Sword as while being inches away, she shot its tip onto the chest of the terrifying entity before her.
His upper body was instantly set aflame as his adornments fell, the tip of the sword going towards his chest as it was about to pierce into it when...
BZZT!
The blade top trembled as if it had met an immovable and impenetrable object.

The tens of thousands of Hyperversal Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures of Anarchos burned out with power and cried out, and yet even they could not pierce even an inch close into the skin of this being!
His upper chest was laid bare as his muscular visage shone with brilliance.
Imperceptibly around his skin, the Innate Extremity Superius Aura blazed.
It was the Innate Extremity Superius Aura of his Unrecorded Infernal Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Superius Physiology!
Before he attained Extremity, it could protect him against up to 243 Crimson Hyperversal Infernal or Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures.

Now as tens of thousands of Existential and Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures covered his existence and elevated everything...what his Physiology could innately defend against had grown to a shocking level.
He affirmed that tens of thousands of Crimson Hyperversal Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures would not injure him.
Furthermore, he could feel from the strength he was borrowing from his main body that currently, his body was no longer equivalent to a Zenith Low Grade Armament of Extremity!
His body...had reached the stage equivalent to the hardness of a Middle Grade Armament of Extremity.
Middle Grade!
And it was only becoming stronger as time passed as...how could a Low Grade Armament of Extremity pierce it?
HUUM!
His right hand rose as he grabbed the sharpened edges of the Low Grade Armament of Extremity with ease.
The white flames of Anarchos did nothing to him as before the Annals Inquisitor could react, Noah's left hand flew out and clamped down onto her neck.
He gazed at her as he looked into her eyes which were losing their incredulity and slowly developing a sense of horror.
After all, her Main Body was now here.
This unfathomable Entity before her seemed to have uncountable means as she truly didn't know the extent of his capabilities!
And now as his eyes locked onto her, she felt the tyranny and coldness within them as his voice echoed out while immense pressure descended from him.
{You...will be the first.}
Unfathomable waves of tyranny buzzed.
60 Milliseconds after Noah expanded his Records towards Infinity.
At this point in time, for the first time in his Recorded History...the Extremity of Quintessence caused an Entity in the Fifth Gradation of Extremity to feel a sense of fear.

chapters.title: Chapter 2796 Unshackled Tyranny! III
paragraphs: Extremity Solarium and the others were fighting their own battles as when they saw the scene playing out in the cocoon of now golden pages, their shock regarding this Entity around them only rose.
His body took a direct hit from a Low Grade Armament of Extremity which was wrapped with tens of thousands of Crimson Hyperversal Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures, and he was unfettered.
And a light of the distortion of reality occurred as paired with his words...he had somehow pulled upon the extremes of a concept to transfer the Main Body of the Annals Inquisitor here!
What a shocking capability.
What a breadth of power and battle.
When Noah went further to clasp the neck of the Annals Inquisitor, they knew a crucial moment had come as a question would soon be answered.
He showed tremendous power, yes.
But was it so obscene that he could threaten the Records and Existence of a Tier 5 Hyperversal Extremity?
Entities whose very records were veiled in layers and layers of secrecy?
Such a profound question would have shocking implications.
Other beings...did not want to see the results of such an implication.
{OOOH!}
The Prime Devourer bellowed out in his large worm like form as the very Extremes of Devouring were activated by him.

He was staking his concept and how far he had taken it towards Extremity as with him at the center, everything back to be swallowed and devoured by him as Extremity Solarium and the Havenly Assassinator changed their gazes and moved back.
In the distance, the Primogenitor of Talismans shook her head at this scene as with a contemplative gaze, she tapped on her forehead as if she was unlocking something.
As if she was setting something free.
{Mmm...I very much liked this identity...}
Her words were cryptic as a long with them, her surroundings instantly changed to become devoid of space, time, and reality itself.
And such a scene only began to spread further as around her, Rune Scriptures of VACUOUS began to dance around her en masse.
But...they weren't merely Hyperversal Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures.
They shone with a myriad of colors.
They emanated the grandeur of existence.
They were Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of VACUOUS!
It showed that the power of this Entity had taken the Existential Authority of Vacuous far and even elevated it further than others like the Prime Devourer and Annals Inquisitor!

With such an unfolding might, everything around her began to change as the Three-Headed Emperor Lion and Willow Tree moved back while bellowing out, the millions of branches of the Willow Tree and her domain of Life being wiped out rapidly with the expansion of the obsidian light.

This light and the light of Devouring from the Prime Devourer all barreled towards the cocoon of golden pages reinforced by a Minor Dream Haven and 9 terrifying Wheels whose power was yet to even be unveiled.
It was a light that didn't prefer to see what results Noah would have as he had a few milliseconds at most before it arrived!
Within the cocoon, he grasped the neck of the Annals Inquisitor as if he were holding onto a molten sun, his hand constantly faced friction and bursts of power.
His left hand holding the Low Grade Armament of Extremity- the blade of the Sword she had tried to kill him with...it buzzed heavily as she still sought to reclaim its authority!
Yet Noah clamped on it tightly as its sharp blade edge...even began to bend and distort.
His thought body...was even bending and distorting a Low Grade Armament of Extremity!
This scene was utterly terrifying as with a primal howl of rage and s sense of fear, the Annals Inquisitor bellowed out while calling onto the extremes of all her Concepts.
Everything she had.

In addition to the dim Extremity Rune Scriptures she had already utilized the power of, a shocking 250,000 Crimson Hyperversal Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures flashed around her body to protect herself as her voice hoarsely rang out.

{Hold on. We have no life or death enmity between us, I...I have a connection with a Primogenitor exceeding the Sixth Gradation of Extremity, if you leave things as they are now, he will give you a reward- I lay my life on it!}
The Annals Inquisitor had scoffed at his abilities milliseconds before.
She didn't do so now.
She realized what a terrifying predicament she was in as she instantly pulled this card!

But Noah only shook his head as after 3 milliseconds, he felt the close to 70% of his Extremity Soul Values actually fully regenerate and bring him to his peak power- their numbers even expanding upwards as more and more Rune Scriptures were formed within his existence.
{You do not have to lay your life anywhere. I will just take it now.}
HUUM!
A Colorless light flashed and converged on the Annals Inquisitor.
Her struggling body let loose and became even more frantic as her Scriptures ran wild!
But the Extremity of Dreams flowed in as instantly, tens of thousands of these Rune Scriptures began to dim and fall to slumber.
This was followed up by the Extremity of Entropy as tens of thousands of other Rune Scriptures began to rust and age, very soon becoming devoid of any identity as they actually turned into dust!
Then, the very extremes of Apocalypse and Armageddon shone.
And as if she had received a reality ending shock...
BOOOM!
The rest of her tens of thousands of Rune Scriptures defending and protecting her existence simultaneously fractured as if they were experiencing the very extremes of the End.
Her eyes dimmed with an incredulous light.
The shattered and dim Scriptures began to flow out of her and sink into Noah's body as she now lay in his hands defenseless.
Her mind buzzed with shock and dismay as now...she could only rely on her means as the Annals Inquisitor as she had hidden her Records in both the Vitalis and Vacuous Annals of Extremity!

chapters.title: Chapter 2797 Unshackled Tyranny! IV
paragraphs: 2797 Unshackled Tyranny! IV
She could only hope that he didn't have concepts of extremes relating to Records yet as he wouldn't be able to entirely scorch her existence or locate everywhere where she hid herself!

But...this hope in her mind was shattered the next moment as she felt this being grasp onto her records...and multiple terrifying, unfamiliar extremes began to appear one after another to track down her Recorded History.
Noah's eyes were callous as he breezed through the steps of decimating a Tier 5 Hyperversal Extremity for the first time.
First, incapacitate their defenses, then locate and erase their records.
For this...the Extremity of Providence flashed as like a virus infecting a database, Noah began to very quickly spread and discover everything that existed about the Annals Inquisitor.
She was someone along the same stage as the Seer of Sima or Seer of Avernus where they specialized in the Annals of Extremity.
Killing such beings was heard as parts of their Records may even be hidden in multiple different places.
But for Noah...
Apart from Providence, the very extremes of Destiny, Karma, Fate, and Fortune flashed simultaneously.
[Ah!]

And the Annals Inquisitor cried out sharply as she felt Noah's soul permeate across her records at such a fast pace that her soul and existence hiding within the Records of the Vacuous and Vitalis Annals of Extremity...were instantly located and laid bare.
Parts of her were located in Records of Wars within both Vacuous and Vitalis Annals.
Other parts of her were hidden in the depths of the absence of reality and time within the Vacuous Domains.
And yet, every single part was found within the span of a millisecond as five foreign extreme concepts pressed down on her existence and found utterly everything.
An unbelievable sense of despondency and disbelief dawned as truly....this was not even close to anything she had imagined when accepting the job from the Prime Devourer.
She looked at the man holding her records and very life in his hands as she spoke out blankly and without power.
[Please...]
[This...this is my whole life. My whole existence. Millions of years of work. Please.]
Her Esteemed Existence and exceeding gorgeous face pleaded at Noah as he grasped her neck ever tighter.

Even with such a regal and honored Entity filled with beauty pleasing for her very life before him, the Extremity of Quintessence was unfettered as from his eyes, the very Extremes of Devouring and Loot activated from him.

[You grasp the entire Recorded History of an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity in your hands.] [The Extremity of Devouring will absorb and assimilate this whole Record into your Existence to empower yourself even more!] [The Extremity of Loot flashed with brilliance.]

They...were about to greatly increase in number.
And yet, this wasn't all.
[The Extremity of Life and Death are triggered simultaneously.]
Within his existence, the Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Life and Death also came at the forefront.

[The Records of the Devoured Target are being made a copy of as after they complete the cycle of True Death, there lies a slim possibility to reactivate and bring to existence a lesser version of their Recorded History and Existence.] ...!
A terrifying progression came.

[The Extremity of the Protagonist disdains the means of Life and Death.]
WAA!

Quintessential Extras have all of their Records and memories before their untimely demise as based on their records, an artificially intelligent Lifeform loyal to you can be summoned and utilized.] ...!
An utterly horrific capability rose.
And yet, things were still not done!
[The Extremity of Conquest and Ascension shine with Quintessential brilliance.]

[All conquered Quintessential Extras will experience an elevation of power in comparison to their devoted Recorded History, undergoing a metamorphosis when they are first brought to fruition.] [The cost to activate and carry out the true usage of the feature of Quintessential Protagonist's Bookmark has risen to an extreme level!] It was a glorious scene.
His Concepts of Extremity were working together and overlapping their extremes to produce shocking possibilities as something as obscene as the Quintessential Protagonist's Bookmark arose.

And Noah's own actions didn't let up as after he had scored across both the Vitalis and Vacuous Annals of Extremity and obtained the Recorded History of the Annals Inquisitor, he was devouring everything and using it as fuel for himself!

The number of his Colorless Hyperversal Existential and Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures was rapidly increasing, currently exceeding 60,000 as 30% of the Recorded History of an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity was devoured.
At the same time as he devoured and assimilated all of this, these very same Records were being stored as if they were a database under the feature of the Quintessential Protagonist's Bookmark.
It was a shocking process as at the same time...
BOOM!
The cocoon outside trembled.

The golden pages fluttered and began to be drawn towards the devouring light of the Prime Devourer, Extremity Solarium and the Havenly Assassinator working together to push back this devouring light of this Primogenitor as the cocoon stabilized momentarily, but the encompassing obsidian light of the Primogenitor of Talismans overwhelmed the Three-Headed Emperor Lion and Willow Tree as it reached the cocoon.
The slumbering authority within the golden pages fluttered as it began to burn.
The Minor Haven of Dreams buzzed as an Existential Authority clashed with it!

And Noah's 9 Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction began to circulate and buzz in an effort to keep away this shocking Existential Authority of Vacuous as his Colorless Hyperversal Existential and Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures blared with brilliance.

Existential Extremity Authority clashed with Existential Extremity Authority as what the hidden identity of the Cimmerian Architect revealed was extremely potent, Noah feeling a sense of repulsion as Quintessence and Infinity were slightly pushed back!
Just slightly.
But they acclimated soon after.
After all, they were two Existential Extremity Authorities facing off against one particularly potent one that has been raised for eons!

And during this short period of time, inside the cocoon, the face of Annals Inquisitor drained of all color and Lifeforce as in such a reality where she was truly having all of her Records devoured, she could only laugh in despair as her gorgeous face still couldn't believe she was in this Reality.
There were so many dreams and plans ahead of her.
So many grand ideals!
But her accepting the request of the Prime Devourer...had actually led her here!
Ah!
In the blink of an eye, her Body, Origin, and Soul that was supported by her Records and Existence began to fade as everything about them was drawn into the body of the Entity in front of her.
Unbound tyranny was all she could see in his eyes that at this moment, she couldn't even meet.
They were too pristine.
Too glorious.

The eyes of this being continued to watch as all life faded from her existence, and even in her last moments, the Annals Inquisitor didn't see any change or remorse as she welcomed a sudden end to her long life.
In her end, she was able to see a fantastical Colorless light of Quintessence.
A vast and endless cerulean light.
Thereafter, her Record came to an end.
The Records of an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity came to an End at the hands of the Extremity of Quintessence who was within his first second of achieving Extremity!

chapters.title: Chapter 2798 Unshackled Tyranny! V
paragraphs: 2798 Unshackled Tyranny! V
[The Extremity of Tyranny radiates profound glory.]
[The Extremity of Quintessence pulses with ever increasing majesty!]

[As an Entity at the Fourth Gradation of Extremity, you have devoured the Records of an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity!] [The concepts they had forged to Extremity have their Sources saved and recorded as you can seamlessly embark on their path of Extremity.] ...!
Devouring the records of another Entity meant many things.

For Noah, it was akin to giving him premium fuel to stoke his flames as waves of Rune Scriptures were born one after another, his Existence only becoming more and more refined from this single action!
After all, it was a grand one.
The intensity of the Colorless and Cerulean Rune Scriptures only became more intense as Noah began to fully digest the Records of an Esteemed Infernal Empress!
At the same time...
[Quintessential Protagonist's Bookmark has sensed a fully devoured Recorded History and activated.]
[The Extremity of the Protagonist seeks your permission to utilize the required resources to realize and actualize its tremendous feat!] Protagonist sought to shine.

Its brightness was blinding as the capability of Quintessential Protagonist's Bookmark was so obscene in what it sought to do that its cost would be more than even when Noah brought the Main Body of the Annals Inquisitor here.
And the answer to the Protagonist came from another Concept entirely.

[The Extremity of Manadynamics pulses with glorification and gives free rein to all abilities from this point onwards.] [Every possible cost of abilities or features will be covered by the Extremity of Manadynamics by 99%, and Manadynamics will go further to manage the usage and efficiency of the Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Soul Values to ensure to best possible results.] ...!

At the same time as his upper values increased exponentially, his Extremity Soul Values began to drain freely as even with the intervention of Manadynamics, the cost was still bound to be astonishing!
At the same time this process has begun...
BOOM!

The barreling power of the Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Vacuous shredded the golden cocoon of pages, the Minor Haven of Dreams also being pushed back as the power of the hidden identity of the Cimmerian Architect was a terrifying one!
Her action allowed them to see the scene within the destroyed cocoon clearly.

The scene that showed Noah's figure standing alone grandly while the visage of the Annals Inquisitor...was turning into stellar dust while in the spot she used to be, three shocking Hyperversal Gradation Fruits of Extremity Were blooming.

The emergence of the Hyperversal Gradation Fruits of Extremity affirmed everything clearly as only when truly power Zenith Tier 4 Entities or higher fell would something like this appear- and not one, but three Fruits of Extremity were born from the death of the Annals Inquisitor!
Seeing such a shocking scene, the melody in the surroundings turned somber and filled with a sense of loss and sadness.
After all, this was the fall of a Tier 5 Entity.
Being such as this were rare.
For those who clearly saw the lines between Vacuous and Vitalis, they could only see it as a loss!
While staring at such a scene, the visage of the hidden identity of the Cimmerian Architect held sharp eyes as her voice echoed out with contention and certainty.
[You attained an Existential Extremity Rune Scripture.]
HUUM!
Her words were filled with confidence and certainty as they caused Extremity Solarium and the other Esteemed Havenly Emperors to blaze their auras in shock.

At the same time, the Will of the Prime Devourer barreled forth with majesty to appear near the visage of the Primogenitor of Talismans, his main body in the form of the Worm like figure still devouring everything around it as an illusory humanoid form came to float near the Primogenitor of Talismans while voicing out.
[I wonder which Primogenitor is utilizing the identity of the Primogenitor of Talismans?]
His voice was calm, but one could still sense the urgency in it even with the calm facade he portrayed outwardly.
The Primogenitor of Talismans sneered while gazing at him calmly.
[Does it matter?]
Who did it matter what she was? This answer caused great disappointment in the eyes of the Prime Devourer as he nodded and continued.

[You're right, it matters not. Since this threat from the Vitalis Domains has grasped the Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scripture of Vitalis and will alter the course of the ongoing war, is Primogenitor able to clear a path for me to devour him, or eradicate him yourself? He seems to only be exerting greater means of Extremity as time passes...] ...!
The Prime Devourer actually sought direction and answers from the being he invited, because he could now obviously see they weren't who said they were!

And yet the Primogenitor of Talismans didn't answer, her gaze going towards the 9 brilliant Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction and fading Dream Haven that was keeping her Existential Authority at bay.
Her reply came a millisecond later as a change began within the cocoon she couldn't yet pierce into.
[You...are asking the wrong questions.]
WAA!

Her words were cryptic as the Will of the Prime Devourer focused on the visage of Noah in the far distance, seeing an oppressive and heavy singularity beginning to form in front of him as this singularity...seemed to hold deep history and Records- records stretching for eons!

After he waved his hands and caused the Hyperversal Gradation Fruits of Extremity to disappear, the whole figure of the Extremity of Quintessence seemed focused on this forming singularity as the voice of the Primogenitor of Talismans rang out coldly to cause the Prime Devourer to turn somber.
[The question you should be asking and wondering...is whether you will even make it out of this ordeal alive.] ...!
A heavy response from the hidden identity of the Cimmerian Architect.
And one that caused the Prime Devourer's mind to buzz with possibilities!
His purpose here was to stop the advent of a being that would steer the war to an unfavorable direction.
If he couldn't do so...why would he continue to risk his life?
