chapters.title: Chapter 2799 Unshackled Tyranny! VI
paragraphs: 2799 Unshackled Tyranny! VI
The gaze of the Primogenitor of the Yog-Nyarvax Infernal Extremity Lineage became firm.

His worm like main body in the distance redirected it's devouring force from the broken cocoon and Esteemed Havenly Emperors as he turned up, gazing at the solid walls of forming Havens as he began to devour space, time, and reality itself.
The very extreme of Devouring was pulled upon as time seemed to be moving back before the Dream Haven was enacted, and anything that was already formed was steadily being broken down and devoured.
The Prime Devourer...was seeking to make a run for it!
At the same time, the singularity before the visage of the Extremity of Quintessence became extremely potent as within a moment, it transformed into an illusory humanoid figure.
When it appeared, even the eyes of the Cimmerian Architect opened wide.
Extremity Solarium and all the others were the same.
The Bard of Vitalis had his symphony gradually change from a somber one and into a low string of tense times as his monkey like figure also watched on closely.

They all watched and were surprised because the illusory outline stemming from the singularity that was becoming more real...looked extremely close to the visage of the Annals Inquisitor that had been granted True Death and even had three Hyperversal Gradation Fruits of Extremity from over her perishing!
It was an ecstatic scene.

And before Noah's eyes, prompts rose and fell as even with the Extremity of Manadynamics jumping in, the fuel to power the Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures of The Protagonist required 80% of his ever changing Extremity Soul Values as Conquest and Ascension sought to affirm their majesty on what was coming to fruition as well!
[The feature of Quintessential Protagonist's Bookmark has chosen Tatiana Nikolaievna, the Annals Inquisitor, as the target Quintessential Extra to summon.] [A great cost has been paid.]

His Colorless and Cerulean Hyperversal Existential and Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures pulsed and radiated waves of glory as they circled around his existence, the devouring and assimilation of the Records of a Tier 5 Entity boosted by the Extremity of Loot currently causing these Scriptures to approach 99,999 in totality.
Their power unfurled freely as with a glimmer of tyranny, the illusory figure born from a singularity gradually became more real!
[GAH!]
As if waking up from an endless dream, Tatiana Nikolaievna gasped from the depths of her soul and breathed heavily, her Records distorted as she came to.
The last she could remember...was everything about her fading.
Everything about her existence coming to an end.
And yet now, here she was again.
She could feel her record.
She could feel her existence.
What was she?
Who was she?
And her purpose was...
Her mind buzzed and finally came to as she opened her eyes.

The scene around her was chaotic as a flood of information came rushing in, her eyes seeing 9 wondrously spinning Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction along with a glimmer of a golden Haven as she finally remembered her purpose.
BZZT!

Around her figure, tens of thousands of Crimson Hyperversal Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures began to gather as she felt within the depths of her soul, a Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scripture and a Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scripture shining with utmost brightness.
She knew who they belonged to.

As the aura of an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity unfurled from her, its pressure and potency being something that even her old self could not compare to, Tatiana Nikolaievna turned around.
And she saw the Entity that had called her out here.
Seeing him, her eyes gained immense clarity as her exceedingly gorgeous figure very quickly fell to her knees.
Tatiana Nikolaievna, formerly known as the Annals Inquisitor, an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity...fell to her knees and bowed her head respectfully as she called out.
[I greet my Master. I greet the Extremity of Quintessence.]
HUUM!
She knew who she was.
She was merely an Extra in his grand tale.
A Quintessential Extra who came to be simply to listen to his orders!

So she paid her respects as 9 crimson gold Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction swirled around them, the wills of Esteemed Havenly and Infernal Emperors seeing this progression as they couldn't help but watch gobsmacked!
At such a juncture, Noah's visage emanating endless brilliance waved his hand as his voice rang out.
[Rise.]
With a glimmer of brilliance, Tatiana Nikolaievna, the first Quintessential Extra, rose and came to stand in front of the Extremity of Quintessence protectively.

Her body glowed with glory and power as she pulled upon the Concepts of Extremity from her Records, as well as the gradual changes occuring within these concepts and her very existence as a Colorless light began to spread from her very core!
With such an entity standing before Noah, his gaze remained calm as he looked out towards the distant Prime Devourer and the veiled identity of the Cimmerian Architect.
His work...was not done!
And his work was not just limited here.
There were many things for him to do- many wrongs for him right, and many paths he needed to close.
At this moment, his other bodies moved to close off certain paths.
Outside of the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.
In the reality and non-reality of a war that seemed to only be the continuation of a conflict across endless eons, light and darkness clashed.
Reality and non-reality clashed.

Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Legions clashed as each force seemed ready to expand the lives of endless millions for their cause, the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms being the ones constantly ground down like ants as occasionally, those who had achieved Extremity would perish!

Across the battlefield, there were areas isolated where powerful Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities held cataclysmic battles, the light of Armaments of Extremity spreading around madly as small squadrons of elite Extremities led by Zenith Tier 3 Entities also moved and clashed.
It was a war that by all means would last an innumerable period of time, with the rulings on just who would be the victor being hard to establish.
In such a battlefield.

From one of the Vacuous Hyperversal Legions led by a Hyperversal Savior's Ark, the devilish form of an Apex Vacuous Lifeforms began to break out of rank as he floated towards the Vacuous Hyperversal Legions in the distance.
[Aleksandr! Fall back in line!]

His actions were quickly seen by a Vacuous Extremity who bellowed out, but he was paid no heed as at this moment, the form of a Vacuous Entity adorned began to fall off, gradually revealing the visage of devilishly handsome Emperor with a dazzling cerulean robe etched with infinity symbols draping over him!

His hair was dark as it held countless mysteries within, his eyes blazing with Nine Pupils as his face was one that a decent number of Entities from the Vitalis Hyperversal Legions had seen or heard about recently.
It was the grandeur of the True Emperor of Quintessence unveiling itself freely without fear as immeasurable waves of tyranny were about to be let loose.
On the 100th millisecond after Noah stretched his Records towards Infinity, he genuinely and truly appeared in the battlefield between the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Legions.
And his sharp gaze...seemed to be directed against a portion of the forces within the Vitalis Hyperversal Legions!

sentences.text: 2799 Unshackled Tyranny!
VI
The gaze of the Primogenitor of the Yog-Nyarvax Infernal Extremity Lineage became firm.

His worm like main body in the distance redirected it's devouring force from the broken cocoon and Esteemed Havenly Emperors as he turned up, gazing at the solid walls of forming Havens as he began to devour space, time, and reality itself.
The very extreme of Devouring was pulled upon as time seemed to be moving back before the Dream Haven was enacted, and anything that was already formed was steadily being broken down and devoured.
The Prime Devourer...was seeking to make a run for it!
At the same time, the singularity before the visage of the Extremity of Quintessence became extremely potent as within a moment, it transformed into an illusory humanoid figure.
When it appeared, even the eyes of the Cimmerian Architect opened wide.
Extremity Solarium and all the others were the same.
The Bard of Vitalis had his symphony gradually change from a somber one and into a low string of tense times as his monkey like figure also watched on closely.

They all watched and were surprised because the illusory outline stemming from the singularity that was becoming more real...looked extremely close to the visage of the Annals Inquisitor that had been granted True Death and even had three Hyperversal Gradation Fruits of Extremity from over her perishing!
It was an ecstatic scene.

And before Noah's eyes, prompts rose and fell as even with the Extremity of Manadynamics jumping in, the fuel to power the Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures of The Protagonist required 80% of his ever changing Extremity Soul Values as Conquest and Ascension sought to affirm their majesty on what was coming to fruition as well!
[The feature of Quintessential Protagonist's Bookmark has chosen Tatiana Nikolaievna, the Annals Inquisitor, as the target Quintessential Extra to summon.] [A great cost has been paid.]

His Colorless and Cerulean Hyperversal Existential and Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures pulsed and radiated waves of glory as they circled around his existence, the devouring and assimilation of the Records of a Tier 5 Entity boosted by the Extremity of Loot currently causing these Scriptures to approach 99,999 in totality.
Their power unfurled freely as with a glimmer of tyranny, the illusory figure born from a singularity gradually became more real!
[GAH!]
As if waking up from an endless dream, Tatiana Nikolaievna gasped from the depths of her soul and breathed heavily, her Records distorted as she came to.
The last she could remember...was everything about her fading.
Everything about her existence coming to an end.
And yet now, here she was again.
She could feel her record.
She could feel her existence.
What was she?
Who was she?
And her purpose was...
Her mind buzzed and finally came to as she opened her eyes.

The scene around her was chaotic as a flood of information came rushing in, her eyes seeing 9 wondrously spinning Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction along with a glimmer of a golden Haven as she finally remembered her purpose.
BZZT!

Around her figure, tens of thousands of Crimson Hyperversal Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures began to gather as she felt within the depths of her soul, a Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scripture and a Colorless Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scripture shining with utmost brightness.
She knew who they belonged to.

As the aura of an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity unfurled from her, its pressure and potency being something that even her old self could not compare to, Tatiana Nikolaievna turned around.
And she saw the Entity that had called her out here.
Seeing him, her eyes gained immense clarity as her exceedingly gorgeous figure very quickly fell to her knees.
Tatiana Nikolaievna, formerly known as the Annals Inquisitor, an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity...fell to her knees and bowed her head respectfully as she called out.
[I greet my Master.
I greet the Extremity of Quintessence.]
HUUM!
She knew who she was.
She was merely an Extra in his grand tale.
A Quintessential Extra who came to be simply to listen to his orders!

So she paid her respects as 9 crimson gold Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction swirled around them, the wills of Esteemed Havenly and Infernal Emperors seeing this progression as they couldn't help but watch gobsmacked!
At such a juncture, Noah's visage emanating endless brilliance waved his hand as his voice rang out.
[Rise.]
With a glimmer of brilliance, Tatiana Nikolaievna, the first Quintessential Extra, rose and came to stand in front of the Extremity of Quintessence protectively.

Her body glowed with glory and power as she pulled upon the Concepts of Extremity from her Records, as well as the gradual changes occuring within these concepts and her very existence as a Colorless light began to spread from her very core!
With such an entity standing before Noah, his gaze remained calm as he looked out towards the distant Prime Devourer and the veiled identity of the Cimmerian Architect.
His work...was not done!
And his work was not just limited here.
There were many things for him to do- many wrongs for him right, and many paths he needed to close.
At this moment, his other bodies moved to close off certain paths.
Outside of the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.
In the reality and non-reality of a war that seemed to only be the continuation of a conflict across endless eons, light and darkness clashed.
Reality and non-reality clashed.

Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Legions clashed as each force seemed ready to expand the lives of endless millions for their cause, the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms being the ones constantly ground down like ants as occasionally, those who had achieved Extremity would perish!

Across the battlefield, there were areas isolated where powerful Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities held cataclysmic battles, the light of Armaments of Extremity spreading around madly as small squadrons of elite Extremities led by Zenith Tier 3 Entities also moved and clashed.
It was a war that by all means would last an innumerable period of time, with the rulings on just who would be the victor being hard to establish.
In such a battlefield.

From one of the Vacuous Hyperversal Legions led by a Hyperversal Savior's Ark, the devilish form of an Apex Vacuous Lifeforms began to break out of rank as he floated towards the Vacuous Hyperversal Legions in the distance.
[Aleksandr!
Fall back in line!]

chapters.title: Chapter 2800 A Quintessential Demon! I
paragraphs: 2800 A Quintessential Demon! I
He came from the Vacuous Hyperversal Legions.
Within the midst of the Domain Fields of the Hyperversal Savior's Arks, he floated freely as his change was noticed by all perceptive eyes!
They watched as he transformed from an Apex Vacuous Lifeform and into the visage of a young and glorious Emperor whose body was draped with a deeply blue robe.
He didn't emanate any aura.
He didn't blaze with any majesty!

But as he appeared amidst the Vacuous Hyperversal Legions, his presence very quickly became the center of all in this nearby region as from the Ark behind him, the aura of a Tier 3 Vacuous Extremity blazed as he bellowed out.
[What are you?! Daring to hide in the ranks of our forces!]
A Vacuous Entity in the form of a humanoid Bull appeared, his obsidian horns rising high as a flaming obsidian crown rotated above his head.

He flashed to instantly appear in front of the visage of Noah that was now under the scrutiny of many, his nostrils flaring with obsidian flames as he was bringing his gaze onto Noah's eyes while seeking to speak when... [Who ar-]
His words couldn't finish.
He found that even his eyes could not lock onto the eyes of this being.
As of he was far too honored for beings like him to even hold his gaze!
So this Tier 3 Vacuous Entity actually froze without being able to utter another word.

Noah didn't even turn his gaze towards this appeared Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity as he simply continued forward, but the moment that he passed to the right of this being and proceeded ahead... POOOF!
The massive visage of the frozen bull-like Tier 3 Vacuous Extremity exploded into nothing but ash.
A heavy silence descended in the surroundings.
In the distance, the Vitalis Hyperversal Legions that had located Noah's figure in this region began to buzz as voices rose amongst them.
[Isn't that...Noah Osmont?]
[A supposed Demon if the recent news are to be believed...]
[The one whose adulations were just sung by the Aeonic Annals of Extremity...!]
[The one calling himself the True Emperor of Quintessence! The one in conflict with...!]
The words buzzed and spread as they soon stopped when the topic of the Avernus Clan came up.
Because they could see that the direction and gaze that the True Emperor of Quintessence was floating towards was directly before the Avernus Legions participating in this War!

Currently, two Tier 4 Avernus Extremities were leading the myriad Legions spread out across certain regions of the battlefield- one being an Entity granted the moniker of Purple Flame of the Extreme, the other being an Entity known as the Extremity of Ignition.
They both had roiling purple flames surrounding them as Noah's line of sight was directly locked onto the Legions following behind the Extremity of Ignition.
Noah's figure crossed the demarcations of the battlefield from Vacuous and into the grayish region at the center as anywhere he passed, ongoing battles stopped as Entities made way.
HUUM!
A sense of profound tension rose as after a few milliseconds, Noah floated closer towards the Avernus Legions as his voice echoed out.
[You have 3 milliseconds.]
[If you have not sworn a vow of Extremity and renounced any associations with the Avernus Clan, you will perish.] ...!
A Colorless light flashed.

The Extremity of Plot shone as all of sudden, the vast array of Extremities and Apex Aeonic Lifeforms of the Avernus Clan felt their very existence tingle as if a tremendous and unimaginable danger was about to fall on them.
3 milliseconds.
To those with power, it was a long and also an extremely short period of time as the millions of Entities within the Avernus Legions received such a command!
At this moment, Noah's appearance was noticed by more and more entities prominently moving across the battlefield as even Emperor Shao battling in the distance turned his head over.
He saw the Avernus Clan members.
He heard Noah's words.
And he then sighed as he remembered his promise.
With a determined look, he pulled back from the Vacuous Entities he was embroiled with as he made his way towards the distance!
As for the Avernus Clan members, after the first millisecond...
"I renounce everything to do with the Avernus Clan!"
"I renounce...!"
[I renounce!]
Their souls felt an unprecedented pressure that warned them if they didn't do this one thing, their future might very well end right then and there!
Some listened to this intuition right away.
Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and Tier 1 and 2 Hyperversal Extremity renounced in the vast majority.
Less than half of the Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities with their deep associations with the Avernus Clan and confidence in their own power renounced.

And the two Tier 4 Avernus Extremities became immeasurably somber as they gritted their teeth, the Purple Flame of Extremity raising her flaming purple spear towards Noah with defiance as she bellowed out.

[Demon! We are in the midst of a holy war and you turn your blade against your own people? Do you think the Investiture of Extremity will stand for this? Do you think the other Clans and Senatus of Extremity will let you be?!] Her words were scathing as the sense of danger she felt was ignored.
She was an Entity in the Fifth Gradation of Extremity.
They had just heard adulations about this being as based on their prior information, he should have just stepped into the ranks of Extremity within the span of this current second.
What could happen within the span of this current second that could threaten the lives of Entities at the Fourth Gradation of Extremity?
Based on such assumptions, these beings remained defiant.
And as soon as her words finished, three milliseconds had passed.
Noah's gaze was cold as he didn't even make a move.
His eyes only shimmered with brightness as his figure radiated unbound majesty.
A moment later, the few Apex Aeonic Lifeforms who had not renounced instantly exploded into a glimmer of ash and dust!
Not just within the Avernus Legions in his line of sight, but also those in the far distance!
After the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, Tier 1 and Tier 2 Extremities also exploded into apocalyptic Ash as they died just as easily as the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!
The scene was horrific as this wasn't just a few beings.
It was the remaining strong force of the Avernus Clan- their very Legions cultivated for eons that were being dismantled!
The scene caused the souls of others to tingle as soon after...
[Hold on.]
A voice filled with tiredness and age echoed out towards the visage of Noah.

And yet it was paid no heed as after the Tier 1 and 2 Avernus Extremities, the remnant Tier 3s that had not renounced began to express looks of horror as their very existence also turned into a glimmer of ash and dust!
This...was what Noah was doing within the field of battle of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Legions without fear or worrying of consequences.

And as this was occurring here, even grander changes were taking place within his Infinite Hyperversal Haven as while he battled with entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity and wiped out thousands of Extremity with his mere gaze alone, the Infinite Hyperversal Haven also carried out its grand designs.
Quintessence and Infinity also enacted their grand designs as the Quintessential Annals of Extremity went towards completion!
The prompts appearing before his main body due to this...were simply astounding.

[The Banner of Quintessence has been born within the forging Quintessential Annals of Extremity.] [Depending on feats and acts of Quintessence, Entities belonging to the Infinite Hyperversal Haven may have their names honored, ranked, and glorified on the Banner of Quintessence!]

[All others will fall below the Extremity of Quintessence, with those standing at the highest spots within this Quintessential Ranking gaining access to the Armaments of Extremity and Planalith Krystallos about to be produced from the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, and gaining the capability to accumulate Honorariums of Quintessence that can be exchanged for aid in speedily traversing across the Gradations of Extremity...]
Feb 13th- Something rose up today preventing the readiness of the next chap, so only one chapter today! Back to regularly scheduled program tomorrow!
Tomorrow's working chapter titles: A Quintessential Demon! II & III

chapters.title: Chapter 2801 A Quintessential Demon! II
paragraphs: 2801 A Quintessential Demon! II

The Infinite Hyperversal Haven seemed to move with its own purpose and conviction as during the forging of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity, one of the first things constructed was an entirely ridiculous feature.
[The Banner of Quintessence]!
Near the very peak of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, a multicolored illusory rectangular banner draped down onto the stellar space as it was the length of a small Haven.
From any side of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, entities would be able to see this illusory banner that at this moment has the numeral and words- [I] The Extremity of Quintessence.
Below it, blank numerals with empty slots could be seen below this as [II], [III], [IV], and onward were all empty!
Apart from the Extremity of Quintessence, nobody else was on the list.
The Vassals saw this scene.
Their minds buzzed as information flowed into them regarding what the Banner of Quintessence was and what the rewards were for those whose names ranked on it!

[The Banner of Quintessence will be updated automatically through the Quintessential Annals of Extremity, with those ranked highest at the determined end of each 12-hour period being awarded for their feats of Quintessence.] WAA!

[To aid in the accomplishments of grand feats of Quintessence, different Instance Dungeon Portals of Quintessence will be forming throughout the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.] [Colorless Instance Dungeon Portals of Quintessence lead to different locations across the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains where battles are ongoing, while Cerulean Instance Dungeon Portals of Infinity lead to recreated Records of the battles of the Extremity of Quintessence- with the enemies being the devoured Records of his past enemies in the form of Quintessential Extras.] ...!
A sensational change began.
The minds of all Vassals buzzed as when this information flooded into their minds, some accepted it with much more emotion than others!
One example was an Entity who had recently obtained a great fortune due to the concepts she had expanded- the Daughter of Hatred, Lilith.
She wasn't among the tight-knit close circle around the True Emperor of Quintessence.
She wasn't one of his women, his family, or those who had the honor to be his closest friends who could even still treat him with such a relationship at this stage.

When it came to getting resources, chances, or Loot, she was at the bottom of the pyramid as loot would surely flow down- but she could never have the chance to gain something as profound as what the Son of the Extremity of Quintessence could gain, or his women like Barbatos or Adelaide.

After her recent fortune of being among the few to be elevated to Extremity purely due to the low level of concepts she expanded, she was prepared to work hard while not expecting for such a thing to occur again!'
She expected that very soon, those closest to the Extremity of Quintessence would attain Extremity with Crimson Consummate Boundaries of Extremity as they would surpass her by miles.
And such a scene was affirmed when all of a sudden, the son of the Extremity of Quintessence began blazing with a light of Quintessence that was brighter than all those before him.
This had only affirmed her thoughts!
But now, with the advent of the Banner of Quintessence...

With the Advent of the Instance Dungeon Portals of Quintessence and Infinity...she had the chance to change her fate and place her name high in the rankings in order to obtain rewards that could propel her to ridiculous levels!
She already knew what she had to do in order to accumulate points contributing to feats of Quintessence and place her name on the grand multicolored illusory rectangular banner above.

Destroying or devouring the Records of other Entities. Performing actions deemed Quintessential or Astounding within the Quintessential Annals of Extremity. Expressing the will of the Extremity of Quintessence across the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains...there were a great deal of things one could do.
These were the thoughts buzzing in the mind of the Daughter of Hatred.
She wasn't the only one as there were many others in the same position as her who looked at these new changes as a profound opportunity!
What if they could rank right below the Extremity of Quintessence?
What if they were placed higher than even prominent Entities like Henry, The Emperor Penguin, Kazuhiko, Barbatos, or Katelyn?
Their minds danced with possibilities as a moment later, massive rifts began opening in space across different locations of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

A vibrant Extremity Vein in the shape of an Infinity symbol still shone brightly across the Aletheian Havens as Colorless and Cerulean Instance Dungeon Portals of Quintessence and Infinity began to appear.
Some led to battlefields of Recorded Histories of previous battles of the Extremity of Quintessence, others led to battles going on currently within the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.

The moment these massive rifts began to appear, the visage of the daughter of Hatred bellowed out as her body split in two, a profound Extremity Clone being formed that instantly shot towards a Colorless Instance Dungeon Portal of Quintessence in front of the Avalon Aletheian Haven, while her main body shot towards the Cerulean Instance Dungeon Portal of Infinity near the forming Haven of Genesis!
She moved with haste to grab an opportunity to change her fate.
On the possibility of surpassing those she already considered herself below of!
On the possibility of regaining her grandeur in an unfathomable way.
HUUM!
The cerulean glow of the Instance Dungeon Portal in front of her blared as the moment it was fully formed and stabilized, the Daughter of Hatred sank right into it.
A millisecond later, other Vassals also reacted and began to scramble one after another!
WAP!
Across the Cerulean Instance Dungeon Portal of Infinity that Lilith had just entered.
Prompts rose over her eyes.
[You have entered a Record of the Extremity of Quintessence named The Advent of the Quintessential Demon.]
[The Quintessential Extras defeated by the Extremity of Quintessence will be spread out across an Artificial Haven that leads you into a random Cosmos filled with enemies.]
[Kill as many enemies as you can and forge yourself through the fires of war, rising across the Gradations of Extremity just like the Ranker occupying the top of the Banner of Quintessence!] ...!

[To aid in the accomplishments of grand feats of Quintessence, different Instance Dungeon Portals of Quintessence will be forming throughout the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.] [Colorless Instance Dungeon Portals of Quintessence lead to different locations across the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains where battles are ongoing, while Cerulean Instance Dungeon Portals of Infinity lead to recreated Records of the battles of the Extremity of Quintessence- with the enemies being the devoured Records of his past enemies in the form of Quintessential Extras.] ...!
A sensational change began.
The minds of all Vassals buzzed as when this information flooded into their minds, some accepted it with much more emotion than others!
One example was an Entity who had recently obtained a great fortune due to the concepts she had expanded- the Daughter of Hatred, Lilith.
She wasn't among the tight-knit close circle around the True Emperor of Quintessence.
She wasn't one of his women, his family, or those who had the honor to be his closest friends who could even still treat him with such a relationship at this stage.

When it came to getting resources, chances, or Loot, she was at the bottom of the pyramid as loot would surely flow down- but she could never have the chance to gain something as profound as what the Son of the Extremity of Quintessence could gain, or his women like Barbatos or Adelaide.

After her recent fortune of being among the few to be elevated to Extremity purely due to the low level of concepts she expanded, she was prepared to work hard while not expecting for such a thing to occur again!'
She expected that very soon, those closest to the Extremity of Quintessence would attain Extremity with Crimson Consummate Boundaries of Extremity as they would surpass her by miles.
And such a scene was affirmed when all of a sudden, the son of the Extremity of Quintessence began blazing with a light of Quintessence that was brighter than all those before him.
This had only affirmed her thoughts!
But now, with the advent of the Banner of Quintessence...

With the Advent of the Instance Dungeon Portals of Quintessence and Infinity...she had the chance to change her fate and place her name high in the rankings in order to obtain rewards that could propel her to ridiculous levels!
She already knew what she had to do in order to accumulate points contributing to feats of Quintessence and place her name on the grand multicolored illusory rectangular banner above.
Destroying or devouring the Records of other Entities.
Performing actions deemed Quintessential or Astounding within the Quintessential Annals of Extremity.
Expressing the will of the Extremity of Quintessence across the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains...there were a great deal of things one could do.
These were the thoughts buzzing in the mind of the Daughter of Hatred.
She wasn't the only one as there were many others in the same position as her who looked at these new changes as a profound opportunity!
What if they could rank right below the Extremity of Quintessence?
What if they were placed higher than even prominent Entities like Henry, The Emperor Penguin, Kazuhiko, Barbatos, or Katelyn?
Their minds danced with possibilities as a moment later, massive rifts began opening in space across different locations of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

A vibrant Extremity Vein in the shape of an Infinity symbol still shone brightly across the Aletheian Havens as Colorless and Cerulean Instance Dungeon Portals of Quintessence and Infinity began to appear.
Some led to battlefields of Recorded Histories of previous battles of the Extremity of Quintessence, others led to battles going on currently within the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.

The moment these massive rifts began to appear, the visage of the daughter of Hatred bellowed out as her body split in two, a profound Extremity Clone being formed that instantly shot towards a Colorless Instance Dungeon Portal of Quintessence in front of the Avalon Aletheian Haven, while her main body shot towards the Cerulean Instance Dungeon Portal of Infinity near the forming Haven of Genesis!
She moved with haste to grab an opportunity to change her fate.
On the possibility of surpassing those she already considered herself below of!
On the possibility of regaining her grandeur in an unfathomable way.
HUUM!
The cerulean glow of the Instance Dungeon Portal in front of her blared as the moment it was fully formed and stabilized, the Daughter of Hatred sank right into it.
A millisecond later, other Vassals also reacted and began to scramble one after another!
WAP!
Across the Cerulean Instance Dungeon Portal of Infinity that Lilith had just entered.
Prompts rose over her eyes.
[You have entered a Record of the Extremity of Quintessence named The Advent of the Quintessential Demon.]
[The Quintessential Extras defeated by the Extremity of Quintessence will be spread out across an Artificial Haven that leads you into a random Cosmos filled with enemies.]
[Kill as many enemies as you can and forge yourself through the fires of war, rising across the Gradations of Extremity just like the Ranker occupying the top of the Banner of Quintessence!] ...!

chapters.title: Chapter 2802 A Quintessential Demon! III
paragraphs: 2802 A Quintessential Demon! III

[If your Extremity Soul and Vitality Values are entirely drained while in a Cerulean Instance Dungeon Portal of Infinity, your Record will be expelled in the last instant at the cost of barring your entry into another Cerulean Instance Dungeon Portal of Infinity for 12 hours.] ...!
These prompts rose before Lilith as it was the prompts that came after that caused her body to tremble.
[An astonishing feat!]

[You are the first Vassals of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven to enter a Cerulean Instance Dungeon Portal of Infinity.] [Due to this initiative, you have gained residues of the effects of the Quintessential Zenith Concept of Loot of the Extremity of Loot, with all enemies you defeat granting you 100% more Loot for the next 7 days.] [Your attacks carry a trace of the effects of Tyranny for the next 7 days.]
WAA!
The buzzing set of prompts were enough to cause her soul to tremble as her single rapid thinking and movement had already elevated her to obtain something that could greatly increase her edge.
But this wasn't all.
Even more astonishing prompts rose thereafter that caused her soul to nearly freeze.
[You are the First Vassal to have accomplished a feat worthy of being recorded in the Quintessential Annals of Extremity!] [You have attained the distinction of (The Second on the Banner).]
[You are now ranked Second on the Banner of Quintessence.]
Her mind buzzed and froze before she quickly reigned herself in, her gorgeous devilish figure heaving heavily as her blessed chest rose and fell.
The red flaming dress she wore blazed as her demonic horns radiated a profound light, and she quickly contained her excitement as she looked ahead at the dark Artificial Haven ahead of her!
Being first was a distinction.
She didn't even have to be the strongest as she only had to act first.
'Would killing Apex Aeonic Lifeforms in an Instance Dungeon Portal of Infinity also be a first? Killing a Tier 1 Quintessential Extra?'

Her mind buzzed with possibilities as she didn't even look at the details of what shocking authority her new distinction as [The Second on the Banner], her feet taking a step forward as she disappeared.
The moment she came to again, she found herself in a small Cosmos.
The randomized cosmos one would be sent into this Artificial Haven of the Instance Dungeon Portal of Infinity named the Advent of the Quintessential Demon!

The cosmos was filled with desolation and shattered stellar objects, and the instant she arrived, Lilith felt multiple auras converging around her as in the far distance, hundreds of thousands of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms could be felt as leading them, three Tier 1 Quintessential Extras who stemmed from the records of Tier 1 Avernus Extremities...were led by a Tier 2 Quintessential Extra who stared coldly towards the newly appearing figure of the Daughter of Hatred.
Lilith felt the auras of the enemies around her as her face rapidly changed.
[Motherfu-]
Randomized teleportation into any possible Cosmos within this Artificial Haven as nobody would know which one they would end up in.
But...wasn't the difficulty just a little bit too high?
[HO!]

And the Quintessential Extras didn't play around as they made a move as soon as she appeared, with Lilith's gaze becoming firm as Rune Scriptures of Hatred began to circle around her maddeningly, billowing apocalyptic flames beginning to rise.
[Let's. Fucking. Go!]
Her bellow was valiant as she delved into battle to etch her own records.
Within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

The figures of Guinevere, Arthus, Eowyn, and other entities connected to the past 9 Dimensions of the Desolate Mausoleum who shared an intricate history with Lilith had their gazes change as they saw the name of the Daughter of Hatred appear on the number [II] spot of the Banner of Quintessence.
[I] The Extremity of Quintessence
[II] The Extremity of Hatred- Lilith
Clear as day, there her name was!
Seeing this, their figures quickly began to move.
They weren't the only ones to react as in the far distance, an angry bellow from Barbatos could be heard as her figure was disappearing into a Cerulean Instance Dungeon Portal of Infinity.
[This bitch dares?!]
And in front of a Colorless Instance Dungeon Portal of Quintessence....
RAA!
An Emperor Penguin bellowed out as he disappeared into the Colorless portal, and a moment later...he found himself on a shocking battlefield.

[You have arrived in the midst of the Holy War of the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Legions.] [You are in the presence of a battle that the Extremity of Quintessence is participating in!] [An Astonishing Feat!]

The Emperor Penguin found himself in the midst of Vitalis Hyperversal Legions as ahead of him, endless droves of Vacuous Hyperversal Legions could be seen as currently, many eyes and Wills were locked onto the brilliant figure of his master- The Extremity of Quintessence who was staring at a certain region that had some Extremities exploding into Ash and dust!
The Emperor Penguin stared at such a shocking reality with trembling eyes as immense pride rose within its existence, gazing at the Vacuous Lifeforms in the far distance as... RAA!
His bellow rang out as his flipper thundered down a golden radiance of destruction!
All of these unfolding realities and possibilities...were what the Infinite Hyperversal Haven was just beginning to accomplish at this moment.
The formation of the Banner of Quintessence and the Instance Dungeon Portals were a product of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven and Noah himself as they were just in their beginning stages.

In the background, the Extremities of Quintessence, Infinity, Plot, Manadynamics, Systems, Skill Trees, and the Protagonist worked at a tremendous pace as they were part of the major reason that something like the Cerulean Instance Dungeon Portal of Infinity could be enacted- along with multiple other supporting Concepts of Extremity!
Millions of Quintessential Extras could quickly be called forth for the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities.
That a brand new system of innovation unfolded within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as what its results could be were yet to be known!
Even as it was being conceived...

[The Extremity of Systems asserts its Authority and entrenches its grasp into the Colorless and Cerulean Instance Dungeon Portals, placing and managing them under the umbrella of the Dungeon System of Extremity!] [The Extremity of the Protagonist gazes on from its high seat and nods in affirmation.]

chapters.title: Chapter 2803 A Quintessential Demon! IV
paragraphs: 2803 A Quintessential Demon! IV
The Dungeon System of Extremity came to fruition under the banner of the Extremity of Systems.

At this point in time, it seemed like the insurmountable dead paths Noah expanded were working independently to achieve his tyrannical will, with some moving with much greater levels of independence compared to others.

Now, many of his Concepts of Extremity were spearheading the construct that was the Quintessential Annals of Extremity, and there was now an interface design of a Dungeon System of Extremity that simply because so many profound concepts were involved in its design...it had to be something profound and intricate in its details.

It generated a profound pathway for the Entities moving within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, with the Cerulean Instance Dungeon Portals of Infinity leading to Recorded Histories experienced or inferred from the memories of the Extremity of Quintessence, or the Colorless Instance Dungeon Portals of Quintessence leading to currently unfolding reality that was filled with even greater dangers and even more possible rewards!

Many Vassals were scrambling at this moment to enter these presented paths of opportunities as in the distance, the visage of Henry danced with Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures that were uniquely...painted with golden carvings of destiny.
A variation of Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures.
His gaze went on the Banner of Quintessence that after the name of the Daughter of Hatred appeared, the distinction of the First Spiritual Beast appeared right below her.
Henry gazed at this as his eyes flashed with a chilling light.
Since he was born, he had everything given to him.
Even now, he was the only one to achieve Extremity with Crimson Consummate Boundaries with help that should have only come from his father.
With all of this help and resources, if he still could not at the very least be ranked Second across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven...he didn't deserve to be that man's son!
[OOH!]

With a dazzling bellow of power, his body split multiple times over and produced 9 clones, each one shooting towards different Instance Dungeon Portals as he moved with purpose and bountiful emotions.
In another direction, there was a pulsing Cerulean Instance Dungeon Portal of Infinity that happened to have multiple figures converging on it at once.
It was the figures of Aurelia, Orion, Ophelia, Maximilian, Xiaomi, and Caesar who emanated great battle spirit!
They gazed at each other as the True Empress of Fortune had her intuition flash powerfully, her hands raising and stopping them as she spoke out.
[Why don't we enter and conquer this Instance Dungeon together?]
She said these words just by intuition as the others had nothing to lose, nodding at her as a millisecond later, they all entered the massive blue rift portal at the same time.
HUUM!
A brilliant light formed.
And as they reappeared, they found themselves in a region burning with blistering white flames of Anarchos, a dazzling set of prompts blooming before them.
[You have discovered the feature of forming a Party to delve into an Instance Dungeon.]
[An astonishing feat!]

[Due to this initiative, you have gained residues of the effects of the Quintessential Zenith Concept of Loot of the Extremity of Loot, with all enemies you defeat granting you 100% more Loot for the next 7 days.]
[Your attacks carry a trace of the effects of Entropy for the next 7 days.]
[Entering an Instance Dungeon as a group greatly increases the difficulty and possible rewards, with the Records of Enemies you face being much grander.] ...!

As soon as these prompts finished along with a flood of information on how the domain of the Instance Dungeon worked, their figures disappeared once more as they found themselves within a massive Cosmos filled with floating white mountains that burned with billowing white flames of Anarchos.

The peaks of these mountains held Quintessential Extras in the form of Vacuous Hyperversal Lifeforms as there were 10 massive mountains floating around them- each one holding a Tier 1 Vacuous Extremity as three mountains held an additional Tier 2 Vacuous Extremity!

They surrounded them in a chilling light as the first part formed within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven bellowed out, Aurelia erupting with a golden light as Xiaomi moved forward valiantly with Rune Scriptures of RUIN erupting all around her.
It was a glorious scene.
A scene that many other Vassals were facing their own version of at this very moment.
In front of another Cerulean Instance Dungeon Portal of Infinity, the visage of the golden haired Dr. Hall could be seen as a white coat fluttered behind him.
His profession was a healer.
He was a doctor who sought to understand the profundities of reality and nature!
But in order to truly do this, he needed power. He needed the grandeur of the being he could still not fully understand!
Because of this, he delved into the vast blue rift as for the sake of healing, he would do a great deal of hurting.
He came to his own conclusion as across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, other Vassals came to their own motivations!
And in the midst of all this, Noah's brilliance only continued to shine as within the expanding stretches of his soul, other prompts were blooming.
[The Extremity of Harems envisions a Reality where its partners have established quintessential achievements.]

[The Extremity of Harems is moving independently and selecting Members of the Harem to elevate and grant them 50% of the possible power expressed by your Main Body, with their existence being exposed to the grandeur and light of Colorless and Cerulean Hyperversal Existential and Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures in an extremely limited fashion.]
[The first chosen target of elevation is the only Harem Member to grant you a Scion- The Frozen Queen, Adelaide.]
[The second chosen target of elevation is the most active Harem Member in terms of Dual Cultivation- the Necromancer of Chaos, Barbatos.]
[The third chosen target of elevation is the second most active Harem Member in terms of Dual Cultivation- the Extremity of Ruin, Xiaomi.] ....!

chapters.title: Chapter 2804 A Quintessential Demon! V
paragraphs: 2804 A Quintessential Demon! V

[The fourth chosen target of elevation is the one who granted tremendous help for an important stage of the Protagonist- the Dream Inversion Bauble, Eowyn.] [The fifth chosen target of elevation is the one whose heart aches for the company of the Extremity of Harems the most- The War Princess, Athena.] [The sixth...]
WAA!
Prompt after prompt came.
A Colorless and Cerulean radiance also flashed and spread thereafter whether within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven or within Recorded Histories or outside of it.
A few entities connected to Noah began to experience an unimaginable change as they came across a sensation and power that only a single being truly understood at this moment!
50% of the power of the Extremity of Harems.
It was unchanged from when this Concept had yet to attain Extremity, but the sheer fact that it was kept while Noah's power rose so much had shocking implications.
What was 50% of the power of an Entity that has just devoured the Records of a being at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity?
Adelaide, Barbatos, and a few others were about to find out as the edge they were about to gain...would heavily propel them towards the top of the Banner of Quintessence!
And thus, a bustle of busyness ensued within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as the Quintessential Annals of Extremity neared its completion.

Located outside of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, Noah and his people were in an extremely safe position as all they had to do at this point was grow stronger as a force that others could not even fathom.
And the terrifying concepts of Extremity that he held...would take them there.
Along with the entities he had here, there were also pathways of inclusion of other beings that at this very moment- Noah was already working on establishing.
Within the vast stretches of the Domains of the Sima Clan.

In an isolated space filled with an Aurora of purple liquified light, Noah's clone gazed at the figure of the Seer of Sima, Extremity of Foundation, and Erikson as he replied to the Seer who realized she couldn't feel him anymore!

[The next few days will be extremely critical as many choices will have to be made. The choice I present to the Sima Clan now...is for you all to truly join the banner of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage. Once this choice has been made, it is irreversible.]
WAA!
As he spoke, his nine pupils radiated a profound authority as behind him, a rift began to tear open in space as it emerged with a Colorless light.
It was a Colorless Instance Dungeon Portal of Quintessence...but it was one that led into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!

Noah was confident of leaving this here as with his Records and the Records of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven isolated from the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, only those who held his lineage could enter as if any Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity or above tried to enter- they would come to find their pathway denied as they could not follow any records back into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
The rift portal blared with light as the aged figure of the Seer of Sima stepped forward, gazing at it while sighing as she spoke out.

[Primogenitor, you're not trying to put an old lady like me to work, right? If I go in there, is it akin to me finding a place to retire in old age and just enjoy my time- or is there another Holy War we're joining the cause of by stepping in?] Her uniqueness and majesty emanated out as only the Extremity of Foundation and Erikson were filled with somber seriousness as they gazed at the portal before them.
They were part of the Sima Clan.
One of the Seven Clans of the Seven Aeonic Havens!
When making a decision like this, they had to consult the Sima Extremity Overlord as it involved too many things.
Their history was simply too deep with too many lives involved.
And they couldn't just...

The thoughts of the Extremity of Foundation and Erikson came to a halt as in the corner of their eyes, they suddenly realized that the Seer of Sima was walking forward serenely after saying what she said.
"Granny, you can't just-!"
Erikson shouted out towards her as she waved her hands with a harrumph.
[I've lived for too long and seen too many things. I'm curious about what this Primogenitor here has in store...so I'll see you all on the other side.]
With wanton recklessness and a laid back demeanor, the Seer of Sima stepped into the massive Colorless Instance Dungeon Portal of Quintessence under the shocked gazes of a father and son!
A Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity began to traverse across records towards the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

She was the first...and it was unknown just how many would follow after her as while Noah was living up to his name of a Demon of the Seven Havens by destroying one of the Seven Clans, he was also setting up the pathway to begin devouring the rest of them!

And the destruction of the Avernus Clan...was entering its end stages as in addition to the ongoing chaos and desertions of their forces within the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains, their Legions outside of it were now entirely destroyed as an appalling reality played out outside of the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.
The vast majority of those belonging to the Avernus Clan renounced them after they felt unprecedented danger.
As for those who went against their intuition and tried to apply their common sense to the being threatening them...
POOF!
Their fate was a deadly one of ash and dust as all those at The Third Gradation of Extremity and below faced such a deadly fate!
There was immense and deafening silence in this region from the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Legions alike.
Such a catastrophic chain of death had not occurred since moments ago when an unknown Esteemed Emperor also reaped the lives of 100 Tier 2 Avernus Extremities.

But now, all of those who had not renounced from Tier 3 and below perished as following the terrifying words of the True Emperor of Quintessence, the wills of all nearby Entities came to lock onto the two Tier 4 Avernus Extremities who now floated without their Legions.

Their bodies were trembling as if their very existence was facing an unfathomable and terminal threat! Their faces were ashen as they wavered on the space they floated on, but they didn't fall and turn to dust as some more powerful beings noticed...there was a foreign buzzing of over a hundred thousand Crimson Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures surrounding each of them.
This was what was keeping them alive.
This...was not their own power.
HUUM!
Near the visage of the Extremity of Quintessence, the glorious figure of Emperor Shao appeared as his expression was a serious one.
The power stabilizing and keeping the lives of the two Tier 4 Avernus Extremities...was also not his.
[Sigh.]
An ancient voice echoed out like booming thunder across the battlefield as for the first time, the blaring aura of an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity emerged in this Holy War.
With it, the visage of an old man shrouded by blinding white light appeared.

His might was ever rising as with his appearance alone, a flood of Vitalis Hyperversal Extremity Authority spread out for light years as the Vacuous Legions were blinded and forced to move back ever closer to their Savior's Arks!
We should have an extra chap sometime in the next week.

chapters.title: Chapter 2805 You do not see the larger picture!
paragraphs: 2805 You do not see the larger picture!
A blinding white light of Vitalis spread out with his appearance alone as this being was one whose very existence was steeped in this Existential Authority!

The white light spread far and wide as the Vacuous Hyperversal Legions felt like scalding flames descended, Apex Vacuous Lifeforms in the front lines being burnt and turned to ash as the Vacuous Hyperversal Extremities ran back into the folds of the Savior's Ark.

His appearance alone screamed significance and majesty as he was garbed in a white robe radiating an aura of a Middle Grade Armament of Extremity, his skin sparkling white and filled with the vigor of youth even though he was portrayed as an old man.

A messy head of white hair and a long beard could be seen as he looked like a wise man of olden times, his hand grasping onto a crystalline blue staff that also pulsed with the light of a Middle Grade Armament of Extremity.
But this wasn't all!

The right hand that grasped the staff had dazzling rings around each of its fingers, the same configuration being repeated in his left hand as all 10 rings...also radiated a light of Middle Grade Armaments of Extremity.
He was fully decked head to toe with fantastical relics as he seemed like an overwhelming force of nature that could not be denied.
Such a being came to float a distance away from Noah as his power and might gazed forth with cold scrutiny.

[The Most Recent Honored One...this is the distinction you have as very few have attained it in the last few eons of Recorded History. You seem to hold your own unique means to hide anything relating to your history as after your distinction spread, you didn't allow us any time to reach out to you and bring you into our folds.] ...!
His voice only reached out towards Noah.
It didn't reverberate to any other entities on this battlefield as the things he was talking about were only ones just any eyes and ears could be privy to!

Yet towards his words, Noah didn't even seem to bat an eye as he instead locked onto the figures of the two Tier 4 Avernus Extremities now surrounded by nothing other than... Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of VITALIS.
Existential!
This was the Extremity authority this being controlled as he was someone on the same tier as the Cimmerian Architect of not grander.
While gazing at him, his name and distinction already rose before Noah as he already knew who he was speaking to.
The Extremity of Light.
The Extremity of Speed.
An Ancestor who was renowned and spread his name out across the Nether Havens of Extremity eons ago before he disappeared into oblivion- someone who was actually connected to the Prometheus Clan!
Yet, it seemed like he only disappeared from the eyes of average entities as he appeared in his full glory before Noah.
And even after he spoke the way he did...Noah didn't even address the topic he brought up as he replied calmly.

[You and I have not crossed paths, nor do we have any Enmity with each other. But...my words and promises must be realized. Those who chose not to renounce the Clan I am in a War of Annihilation with must perish- the two you are protecting included.] WAA!
His dominant gaze was unflinching as he spoke, making the Entity ahead of him become extremely stern!
Reality congealed all around them as it felt like a single millisecond was stretched out for millennia.
The Extremity of Light floated closer towards Noah as his majestic visage looked like a tiered Emperor grading barren lands.

[You have not seen the larger picture. The Records of unimaginable things that only those special at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity and higher may be privy to. The lives of two Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremities may not mean much to you now, but they are a great loss in the larger picture. The structure and existence of the Avernus Clan you are currently dismantling is a great loss for the larger picture. I do not seek to demean an Honored One who has their accolades sung by the Aeonic Annals of Extremity themselves, but as someone who has seen and lived many eons more than you, can I advise you to stop this War of Annihilation? To spare the remnants of the Avernus Clan? It will help you forge better relationships with other Esteemed Havenly Emperors and even the Esteemed Primogenitor will look favorably upon you for taking the high road as it speaks to your character.] ...!
The words of this entity were filled with wisdom as his head full of white hair buzzed with serenity.
His eyes were deep and cold as at this moment, Noah turned his gaze into this being with utmost coldness.
His sharp eyes squinted with Tyranny as he voiced out.
[Where were you when one of the Seven Clans, and a Major Of Extremity sent their forces against a small force whose name hadn't even been heard of?] WAA!
[Where were you when Shadow Extremities were killed along with quintillions of Entities across different domains? ] ...!

[Where were you when droves of Extremity were sent to assassinate me even more I reached Extremity? Were they successful, wouldn't the loss of my life have been a tremendous loss for the future? And yet, I didn't see you interfering then. So...what exactly makes it okay for you to intervene right now?] HUUM!
Noah's words were sharp as they echoed out with maddening grandeur.
What gave this being the right?
What made him so bold as to stand against the Extremity of Quintessence and what he sought to do?!
With a light of tyranny, Noah continued.

[I care not for better relationships with Havenly Emperors, nor the kind gazes of so called Primogenitors. We do not have any Enmity...but I have no qualms in designating you as my enemy if you stand in my way again.] At the same time that Noah's words finished...
[The Extremity of Tyranny rages with indignation!]
[The Extremity of Infinity exerts its Authority.]

chapters.title: Chapter 2806 A Ticking Time Bomb! I
paragraphs: 2806 A Ticking Time Bomb! I
Two prompts came that let it be known that the Extremity of Tyranny and Infinity were blaring with their authority!
A Colorless light flashed first.
And a Cerulean light flashed thereafter around Noah's existence as its speed...was far faster than even the extremes of Light or Speed.
Noah didn't care which force this being belonged to.
He didn't care for his power or standing, nor any of his words about what relationships he could forge if he chose to act a certain way!
His will reigning with Tyranny did not like to be told how to act and what to do in order to succeed or have a smoother path.

So it shone first as from him and spreading out for light years towards the Vitalis Hyperversal Legions ahead of him and Vacuous Hyperversal Legions behind him, Tyranny flashed and pressed down with scrutiny.
[The Extremity of Tyranny has expanded its authority across this region.]
[For the next three milliseconds, no authority of the Fifth Gradation of Extremity and below may be expressed in any form!] WAA!
Unbound tyranny.

It exerted its shocking authority and caused the eyes of the Extremity of Light to pulse with a powerful light, with the visage of Emperor Shao not too far from them changing his gaze to become somber along with all the powerful Entities in this region who all of sudden felt their Extremity Rune Scriptures isolated and oppressed to the bottom of their souls!
After the light of tyranny was laid down, a gorgeous blue flashed as its target were two protected entities whose protective light had dimmed around them.
[Two targets have been exposed to the immeasurable light of Infinity.]
Infinity.
Noah could seamlessly wield it as he had taken this concept to Extremity after waves of ordeals.
He could handle it!
But if the light of Infinity ever filled the Existence of Entities who could not even fathom it?
A terrifying result would bloom.

The two Tier 4 Avernus Extremities felt their existence filling with an endless light that overwhelmed them utterly and completely- a light that even overwhelmed the very Concepts of Extremity granting them their power as if they were overloaded with something top pristine!

This brilliant light of Infinity only flashed within their existence for a millisecond as it entirely filled their Records, the effect stretching, expanding, and shattering everything before the light retracted a moment later.
A millisecond passed.

It seemed as if Noah hadn't done a thing, and yet the bodies of the two Tier 4 Avernus Extremities...became entirely lifeless as they began to float listlessly in the space they were in, the mixture of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority around them compressing their bodies and causing them to fold into themselves before they were erased from existence.
All wills were breathless.
The True Emperor of Quintessence stated that all those who did not renounce the Avernus Clan would perish.
And he did exactly this as even the appearance of a terrifying Ancestor did not stop it!
Far ahead of Noah, the visage of the Extremity of Light gazed at the perishing figures of the Avernus Clan as once more... [Sigh.]
He let out a single expression of age and tiredness!
Far from the battlefield where Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Legions were mixing.
Within the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains- more specifically, across its eons of Recorded Histories within the Vacuous Annals of Extremity.

Inside a certain Recorded History, the figure of a woman with exceeding beauty and intellect could be seen as she stood at the very peak of a mystical black mountain that gushed Vacuous Hyperversal Authority all around it.
Her lush hair flowed with black and gold strands of light as her fair skin shone with a lustrous beauty as on her forehead, a unique runic ecriture of indeterminate origins was etched.
She was the main body of none other than the Cimmerian Architect.
She wasn't alone at this moment as behind her, obsidian grasslands sparkling with spirituality swayed as there was a small hut on the left and a fairly sizable crimson gold Forge on the right.

Two extremely powerful auras exceeding even the most honored and powerful Entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity could be felt in front of this hut and within the crimson gold Forge where a constant hammering could be heard.

The visage of a burly man with obsidian skin could barely be seen working on the forge, while a woman adorned in a Violet dress sat on a throne in front of the hut as she finished forging a Middle Grade Vacuous Planalith Krystallos after months of Refinement and hard work!
She inspected it with scrutiny as ahead, the voice of the Cimmerian Architect rang out playfully.

[The most recent Honored One is interesting to say the least...with him already grasping an Existential Authority. But...how do I say this? I feel like it is not so simple.] Her words caused the hammering within the forge to stop as the woman in a Violet dress in front of the hut on her grand throne gazed up at her.
The Cimmerian Architect had a carefree expression as she began walking towards them, her face expressing curiosity and a trace of excitement as she continued.
[I feel like he grasped an Existential Authority, and yet it is not Vacuous or Vital-]
BOOOM!
Her words didn't finish.

They weren't allowed to finish as an instant later, Millions of Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of VACUOUS emerged and bloomed from the forge and in front of the hut as they covered everything in their surroundings at maddening speed- obscuring reality and distorting space and time.
[Elodie!]
WAA!
Her name was called out while filled with a shockingly hard rebuke from the crimson gold Forge as the burly man within came out with a grim expression.

His eyes were gazing around him in the area now filled with millions of swirling Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures as if he was expecting something to descend, but when things remained calm- his eyes turned towards the Cimmerian Architect who was rolling her eyes at their actions.

[Why would you speak of such a thing freely?! The moment that such things are even theorized, they may be listening in...Elodie, there are some things you cannot be laid back about!] His voice was rough as he was filled with billowing smoke and flames, an aura that had successfully climbed over the Fifth Gradation of Extremity and into the Sixth swirling around him, and yet in the eyes of this being as he looked around...one could see a trace of hidden fear.
In front of the hut, the woman rose from her throne as she threw an angry look of reproach towards the Cimmerian Architect.

[The Ones Above Extremity...we have implored you again and again to take matters with extreme prejudice whenever it relates to them. You can joke about it now but understand that one of these days...you may risk your life and ours with your careless words.] ...!
The power of these beings wasn't low.
They were far more advanced across the Gradations of Extremity than many others as they could claim to be above the vast stretches of beings across the Annals of Extremity!
And yet even they held their fears.
The visage of the burly man once more stared at the space around them swirling with Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures as he spoke out in a low tone.
[The last time a Primogenitor tried to theorize and put into practice a concept other than Vitalis and Vacuous to the Existential level, he disappeared days after.] WAA!

[His records were erased as if they never existed, with his companion even being beside him the whole time as when she came to...he was just gone.] His words were shocking ones to hear as he moved his gaze from the surroundings and looked imploringly towards the Cimmerian Architect.

[Elodie...I implore you to exercise more caution. And this Osmont...just leave him to his own ordeals, no matter what he has attained. Amongst all of us, Honored Ones are those with the highest mortality rate as they always try to reach for things out of their grasp. I do not envy him, nor do I want to be anywhere near him. Depending on what he does, he is just a ticking time bomb that when it does explode...the only thing that matters is what he will drag down with him.] ...!
