Two prompts came that let it be known that the Extremity of Tyranny and Infinity were blaring with their authority!
A Colorless light flashed first.
And a Cerulean light flashed thereafter around Noah's existence as its speed...was far faster than even the extremes of Light or Speed.
Noah didn't care which force this being belonged to.
He didn't care for his power or standing, nor any of his words about what relationships he could forge if he chose to act a certain way!
His will reigning with Tyranny did not like to be told how to act and what to do in order to succeed or have a smoother path.

So it shone first as from him and spreading out for light years towards the Vitalis Hyperversal Legions ahead of him and Vacuous Hyperversal Legions behind him, Tyranny flashed and pressed down with scrutiny.
[The Extremity of Tyranny has expanded its authority across this region.]
[For the next three milliseconds, no authority of the Fifth Gradation of Extremity and below may be expressed in any form!] WAA!
Unbound tyranny.

It exerted its shocking authority and caused the eyes of the Extremity of Light to pulse with a powerful light, with the visage of Emperor Shao not too far from them changing his gaze to become somber along with all the powerful Entities in this region who all of sudden felt their Extremity Rune Scriptures isolated and oppressed to the bottom of their souls!
After the light of tyranny was laid down, a gorgeous blue flashed as its target were two protected entities whose protective light had dimmed around them.
[Two targets have been exposed to the immeasurable light of Infinity.]
Infinity.
Noah could seamlessly wield it as he had taken this concept to Extremity after waves of ordeals.
He could handle it!
But if the light of Infinity ever filled the Existence of Entities who could not even fathom it?
A terrifying result would bloom.

The two Tier 4 Avernus Extremities felt their existence filling with an endless light that overwhelmed them utterly and completely- a light that even overwhelmed the very Concepts of Extremity granting them their power as if they were overloaded with something top pristine!

This brilliant light of Infinity only flashed within their existence for a millisecond as it entirely filled their Records, the effect stretching, expanding, and shattering everything before the light retracted a moment later.
A millisecond passed.

It seemed as if Noah hadn't done a thing, and yet the bodies of the two Tier 4 Avernus Extremities...became entirely lifeless as they began to float listlessly in the space they were in, the mixture of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority around them compressing their bodies and causing them to fold into themselves before they were erased from existence.
All wills were breathless.
The True Emperor of Quintessence stated that all those who did not renounce the Avernus Clan would perish.
And he did exactly this as even the appearance of a terrifying Ancestor did not stop it!
Far ahead of Noah, the visage of the Extremity of Light gazed at the perishing figures of the Avernus Clan as once more...
[Sigh.]
He let out a single expression of age and tiredness!
Far from the battlefield where Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Legions were mixing.
Within the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains- more specifically, across its eons of Recorded Histories within the Vacuous Annals of Extremity.

Inside a certain Recorded History, the figure of a woman with exceeding beauty and intellect could be seen as she stood at the very peak of a mystical black mountain that gushed Vacuous Hyperversal Authority all around it.
Her lush hair flowed with black and gold strands of light as her fair skin shone with a lustrous beauty as on her forehead, a unique runic ecriture of indeterminate origins was etched.
She was the main body of none other than the Cimmerian Architect.
She wasn't alone at this moment as behind her, obsidian grasslands sparkling with spirituality swayed as there was a small hut on the left and a fairly sizable crimson gold Forge on the right.

Two extremely powerful auras exceeding even the most honored and powerful Entities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity could be felt in front of this hut and within the crimson gold Forge where a constant hammering could be heard.

The visage of a burly man with obsidian skin could barely be seen working on the forge, while a woman adorned in a Violet dress sat on a throne in front of the hut as she finished forging a Middle Grade Vacuous Planalith Krystallos after months of Refinement and hard work!
She inspected it with scrutiny as ahead, the voice of the Cimmerian Architect rang out playfully.
[The most recent Honored One is interesting to say the least...with him already grasping an Existential Authority.
But...how do I say this?
I feel like it is not so simple.] Her words caused the hammering within the forge to stop as the woman in a Violet dress in front of the hut on her grand throne gazed up at her.
The Cimmerian Architect had a carefree expression as she began walking towards them, her face expressing curiosity and a trace of excitement as she continued.
[I feel like he grasped an Existential Authority, and yet it is not Vacuous or Vital-]
BOOOM!
Her words didn't finish.

They weren't allowed to finish as an instant later, Millions of Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of VACUOUS emerged and bloomed from the forge and in front of the hut as they covered everything in their surroundings at maddening speed- obscuring reality and distorting space and time.
[Elodie!]
WAA!
Her name was called out while filled with a shockingly hard rebuke from the crimson gold Forge as the burly man within came out with a grim expression.

His eyes were gazing around him in the area now filled with millions of swirling Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures as if he was expecting something to descend, but when things remained calm- his eyes turned towards the Cimmerian Architect who was rolling her eyes at their actions.
[Why would you speak of such a thing freely?!

The moment that such things are even theorized, they may be listening in...Elodie, there are some things you cannot be laid back about!] His voice was rough as he was filled with billowing smoke and flames, an aura that had successfully climbed over the Fifth Gradation of Extremity and into the Sixth swirling around him, and yet in the eyes of this being as he looked around...one could see a trace of hidden fear.
In front of the hut, the woman rose from her throne as she threw an angry look of reproach towards the Cimmerian Architect.
[The Ones Above Extremity...we have implored you again and again to take matters with extreme prejudice whenever it relates to them.
You can joke about it now but understand that one of these days...you may risk your life and ours with your careless words.] ...!
The power of these beings wasn't low.
They were far more advanced across the Gradations of Extremity than many others as they could claim to be above the vast stretches of beings across the Annals of Extremity!
And yet even they held their fears.
The visage of the burly man once more stared at the space around them swirling with Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures as he spoke out in a low tone.
[The last time a Primogenitor tried to theorize and put into practice a concept other than Vitalis and Vacuous to the Existential level, he disappeared days after.] WAA!

[His records were erased as if they never existed, with his companion even being beside him the whole time as when she came to...he was just gone.] His words were shocking ones to hear as he moved his gaze from the surroundings and looked imploringly towards the Cimmerian Architect.
[Elodie...I implore you to exercise more caution.
And this Osmont...just leave him to his own ordeals, no matter what he has attained.
Amongst all of us, Honored Ones are those with the highest mortality rate as they always try to reach for things out of their grasp.
I do not envy him, nor do I want to be anywhere near him.
Depending on what he does, he is just a ticking time bomb that when it does explode...the only thing that matters is what he will drag down with him.] ...!

chapters.title: Chapter 2807 A Ticking Time Bomb! II
paragraphs: 2807 A Ticking Time Bomb! II
A ticking time bomb!
This was the term given to the newly Honored One whose name rang out across the Annals of Extremity.
Depending on how he moved and how extravagant his actions were about to be, he may perish quicker and in a more brutal way than animals in a butchery!
And if what the Cimmerian Architect theorized was even close to being true...
he may already be dead.
He just didn't know it.
He may come to find out of nowhere that his whole existence was slowly perishing as he wouldn't even be able to understand why.
Existential Extremity Authorities were that terrifying as for those who truly grasped Vacuous and Vitalis...anything was possible.
After all, they were Existential!
They could truly alter the very state of Existence in ways other beings could not even fathom.
The Cimmerian Architect gazed at the figures before her as she felt immense sadness when she saw the way they were acting.
They were Entities that had crossed the threshold into the insurmountable Sixth Gradation of Extremity.
They held unimaginable power at their fingertips...and yet they seemed to be even more fearful than an Apex Aeonic Lifeform who didn't know any better.
Who didn't have any knowledge of what was out there.
When the Cimmerian Architect saw such a reality, she questioned what the purpose of it all was!

Why work so hard to attain so much power when at the end of it all, you live with such caution and fear? What use do all of them have for expanding their pristine concepts to their extremes at the end of the day, even with these concepts...they chose to hide in the dark under the Shadow of beings they didn't fully understand?
HUUM!

The question caused her emotions to fluctuate as her Extremity of Intuition buzzed within her soul, guiding her in a way even Entities at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity couldn't fathom as she gazed at the man she had known all her life- a being who forged Armaments of Extremity in his sleep.
He continued to talk while gazing at her imploringly.

[You know a great deal about the Ones Above Extremity- you may even know more than us. But that should only make you more careful of them. One could be standing right in front of you, and you won't notice. One could take on the form of your closest ally, and you wouldn't know. For them, killing us is as easy as butchering chickens- and that's on a bad day.]
WAA!

[Their goals are not ours, nor do they care how we live so long as we don't encroach upon their authority. So...do not encroach upon their authority. Do not even get near entities or subjects who don't know better as you could simply be thrown in as collateral damage.]
A deafening silence descended as the Cimmerian Architect looked at the figure of blacksmith and refiner before her with an interminable gaze as she only shook her head and turned away from them.
She stared at the millions of Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures around her in silence.
She only wanted to mention how she didn't think the Existential Authority that Osmont expressed was either Vacuous or Vitalis.
It had grand implications as it meant he may have managed to do the impossible!
And yet...the result was this talk and reminder she had heard a few times before.

And as if the two pristine entities behind her didn't think she had truly gotten it, the woman who had just forged a Middle Grade Vacuous Planalith Krystallos rose from her grand throne and spoke out with a sharp light.

[Elodie...have you come across any records of Entities stepping in the Ninth Gradation of Extremity all these eons? Have you heard of any grand tales of achievements and honorariums for the Honored Ones of the past? You know why this is so. You know what happens to those who think they can deny the fate granted to them. So just...take a step back and revel in the Extremes you have achieved. Revel in the wonders out there. The Aeonic Annals of Extremity are so vast that even now, we haven't explored all of their Records. Why jeopardize everything for mere possibilities? For slim chances of nothingness?]
WAA!
Her words were grave ones as after they finished, the Cimmerian Architect found herself growing increasingly frustrated.
Her body began to shimmer with a spatial light as she couldn't even manage to keep herself here at this time.
As she was about to leave, she turned around and spoke lightly.

[I won't delve into anything, and by the way- that Prime Devourer may just die to this newly Honored One. I know he's just one of the latest pawns to launch a widespread Existential War. If he perished...]
Her words were met with a dismissive wave from the burly man as he also turned around to head back into the forge.

[If he perishes, then that is his fate. Everything stems from Vacuous and Vitalis, and everything will return to Vacuous and Vitalis. That is Existence. His death may only be the spark to have those in the Middle Stages of the Gradations of Extremity test each other's extremes early. From this Existential War...who knows how many new distinguished beings will enter the Sixth or Seventh Gradations of Extremity.]
His words were callous ones as the moment he finished, the refiner also sat back on her throne and nodded while she added on.

[The appearance of a new Honored One is also an indication for the Emperors of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority stretched out across Recorded and Unrecorded Histories to get together once more. They may use that stage for this Existential War as this Osmont you are mentioning, his actions may spark and accelerate all of this, but he may not even be alive to participate in it.]

A stream of information flowed that only irritated the Cimmerian Architect as she wanted to swear and curse, but she respected these beings before her just a little as she didn't want to do that to them!

chapters.title: Chapter 2808 A Ticking Time Bomb! III
paragraphs: 2808 A Ticking Time Bomb! III
So, the Cimmerian Architect could only leave this domain as she wondered.
The Noah Osmont that even Entities at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity believed he wouldn't live long if even an ounce of her theory was correct.
If he truly did take another Concept to the Existential level...she wanted to know how he was still alive.
Others even attempting such an action had long since perished.

The Vacuous and Vitalis Annals of Extremity watched and recorded everything as the moment an achievement of creating an Existential Extremity Rune Scripture came and was etched- the Ones Above Extremity would know.
And it wouldn't even take a fraction of a nanosecond for them to erase everything about such an existence.
So why.
What was it that Noah Osmont did that made him an exception?
Or...was she actually mistaken and he hadn't taken a concept to the Existential level at all?

With such questions in mind, the Cimmerian Architect came to a profound conclusion as around her existence, Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Vacuous began to swirl with activity and purpose!
[The Quintessential Annals of Extremity near a profound completion.]

[The resultant effects of its design are unfathomable and not yet understood as at this very moment, a clear line of distinction has been drawn between you and the Records of the Existential Extremity Authorities of Vitalis and Vacuous Annals of Extremity!]
Within the depths of Noah's mind.

There were always prompts surging within his mind for one thing or another, but the more profound ones related to himself and the birth of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity that took him outside the scope of Vacuous and Vitalis!
Noah understood very well the possible implications of this, and his mind was computing millions more theories as even more astonishing prompts continued to rain down.

[New existences born within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven covered by the Quintessential Annals of Extremity will have at their source either the Existential Extremity Authorities of Quintessence or Infinity.]

[Current entities within the Quintessential Annals of Extremity have been branded by the Existential Extremity Authority of Quintessence and Infinity, while their brandings of Vitalis or Vacuous have had their cognizance erased.]
[The Existential Extremity Authorities of Quintessence and Infinity will only continue to be further elevated from their usage, refinement, and ascension by you and other Existences.]
[The higher up the Gradations of Extremity entities traverse with Quintessence and Infinity, the grander and more potent these Existential Authorities will become.]
[The Quintessential Annals of Extremity have placed more focus on the Dungeon System of Extremity in order to propagate the usage and refinement of Quintessence and Infinity.]
[You are walking an Unfathomable Path full of unknowns, glory, and danger that cannot currently be extrapolated!]
HUUM!
The massive Infinite Hyperversal Haven shook with brilliance as a profound Record was established.
His very own Annals.
His very own set of Recorded and Unrecorded Histories!
Along with them, there came shocking implications and possibilities.
His own Existential Extremity Authorities would only become grander as he and those he had within his Quintessential Annals of Extremity rose across the Gradations.
As the authorities were refined to become ever purer and more pristine.

At this moment, with his connection to the Infinite Hyperversal Haven and Quintessential Annals of Extremity, Noah felt a profound phenomenon as on the bodies of all Entities here...he felt a twinkling of Quintessence and Infinity around them.
They may soon begin to touch upon these authorities, and even possibly undergo Quintessential and Infinity Awakenings!
But in the midst of all of this...he saw that would return even more to Quintessence and Infinity.
The quintillions upon quintillions of entities would only make these two Existential Authorities even purer.
Ever more perfect.
Ever more powerful!
Now, this left behind the implication of this in relation to Vitalis and Vacuous Extremity Authorities.
They were Existential Extremity Authorities.
But...they were not Noah's Existential Extremity Authorities.
It meant they belonged to someone else- or a group of Entities that could be in the dozens, thousands, or millions!
He didn't know.
There was still too little information.
But this...made him look within himself and gaze at Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority flowing within his very Origin, Body, and Soul.
They made major parts of him at this moment.
His foundation held them at his very core as at this moment, Noah found himself questioning.
Did he make an error?
Should he have incorporated Vitalis and Vacuous to become such a major part of him?
Based on what he knew now...was it even safe for him to have these authorities? For him to further traverse on them and even attain the Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Vacuous and Vitalis?!
RUMBLE!
The question caused his soul and very existence to buzz as at this moment...
Noah did not have an answer.
He needed more information as it would determine just what path he would take from here on out!
His soul buzzed with brilliance.
His will flashed as another scene came to focus.
It was in the isolated domain surrounded by droves of Talismans, his Dream and Apollyon Havens, and multiple buzzing Existential Extremity Authorities.
His Colorless and Cerulean Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Quintessence and Infinity were silent and filled with power.
The Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Vacuous buzzed around the Cimmerian Architect.

In the distance, the Titanic figure of the Prime Devourer was eating up time and space itself as he sought to make an exit from this domain- the figures of the Four Esteemed Havenly Emperors bellowing out and surrounding him on all sides as they further chained him down!
The Bard of Vitalis was playing a shocking soliloquy that roused intense emotions as Noah's figure was behind the Quintessential Extra that was Tatiana Nikolaievna- the Annals Inquisitor.

At this moment in time, the visage of the Cimmerian Architect exploded out with even grander waves of power as she withdrew the Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Vacuous and instead released Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures of CHRONOLOGY, TIME, and EPOCH.

Hundreds of thousands of such Rune Scriptures unfurled in the surroundings as their target wasn't any specific beings, but this space itself as the flow of time was altered tremendously- to the extent that a day could pass within this domain now, and only a millisecond would have passed outside of it!

The circulation and usage of authorities were also affected as the veiled visage of the Cimmerian Architect breathed out a sigh of tiredness while craning her neck, even the Four Esteemed Havenly Emperors, Tatiana Nikolaievna, and the Prime Devourer all seemed like they were caught in this slowed time as everything about their reactions became Infinity slow.
Only two beings could fully and cognizantly move and think rationally in such a space of slowed and even absence of time.
SHIING!

And from the far distance, the figure of the Cimmerian Architect disappeared and trapped outside of the buzzing 9 Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction, her tremendous power spilling out as Noah coldly gazed up at her with Quintessence and Infinity beginning to blaze in his eyes.
And yet this powerful Entity didn't attack.

She gazed at Noah quizzically as her voice echoed out in the form of wavelengths perceptible only towards his Will- as if the things she was about to say needed to not be heard by anything or anyone else!
[You...why aren't you dead? I'm confident the Existential Extremity Authority I clashed with is neither Vacuous nor Vitalis. Which leads me to ask- why aren't you dead?]

The Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Vacuous buzzed around the Cimmerian Architect.

In the distance, the Titanic figure of the Prime Devourer was eating up time and space itself as he sought to make an exit from this domain- the figures of the Four Esteemed Havenly Emperors bellowing out and surrounding him on all sides as they further chained him down!
The Bard of Vitalis was playing a shocking soliloquy that roused intense emotions as Noah's figure was behind the Quintessential Extra that was Tatiana Nikolaievna- the Annals Inquisitor.

At this moment in time, the visage of the Cimmerian Architect exploded out with even grander waves of power as she withdrew the Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Vacuous and instead released Infernal Extremity Rune Scriptures of CHRONOLOGY, TIME, and EPOCH.

Hundreds of thousands of such Rune Scriptures unfurled in the surroundings as their target wasn't any specific beings, but this space itself as the flow of time was altered tremendously- to the extent that a day could pass within this domain now, and only a millisecond would have passed outside of it!

The circulation and usage of authorities were also affected as the veiled visage of the Cimmerian Architect breathed out a sigh of tiredness while craning her neck, even the Four Esteemed Havenly Emperors, Tatiana Nikolaievna, and the Prime Devourer all seemed like they were caught in this slowed time as everything about their reactions became Infinity slow.
Only two beings could fully and cognizantly move and think rationally in such a space of slowed and even absence of time.
SHIING!

And from the far distance, the figure of the Cimmerian Architect disappeared and trapped outside of the buzzing 9 Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction, her tremendous power spilling out as Noah coldly gazed up at her with Quintessence and Infinity beginning to blaze in his eyes.
And yet this powerful Entity didn't attack.

She gazed at Noah quizzically as her voice echoed out in the form of wavelengths perceptible only towards his Will- as if the things she was about to say needed to not be heard by anything or anyone else!
[You...why aren't you dead?
I'm confident the Existential Extremity Authority I clashed with is neither Vacuous nor Vitalis.
Which leads me to ask- why aren't you dead?]

chapters.title: Chapter 2809 A Heavy Choice! I
paragraphs: 2809 A Heavy Choice! I
As the Cimmerian Architect's voice reverberated within Noah's mind, he felt a surge of profound brilliance mingled with waves of uncertainty.
Her words echoed the doubts that had been lingering at the edges of his consciousness- especially the doubts of possible dangers!
'Why am I not dead?' Noah mused silently, his thoughts racing as he considered the implications of the Architect's question.

He stared at her figure shrouded with power and mystery as he could erupt with Quintessence and Infinity at any time if he wished, but there was no harm in obtaining more information that others were not privy to!
From the records of the Annals Inquisitor he had devoured, he gained a semblance of knowledge on The Ones Above Extremity.
Mere rumors and scattered records, but they were there.

He already theorized for himself the many possibilities and probable dangers, but the entity before him was much more equipped with knowledge as she was on a whole other Tier of importance in comparison to the Annals Inquisitor.
But she floated close to him right now without the intent to battle as she seemed intent on a discussion.
Should he just...kill her and devour her records entirely to obtain all of this knowledge and not have to go through a back and forth conversation?
Such a dangerous thought arose as the brows of the Cimmerian Architect quickly flashed with brilliance.

[Yo, what the hell were you just thinking? Were you thinking of trying to fuck me up when the things I could tell you could possibly save your existence? Because you wouldn't be waving around another type of Existential Extremity Authority freely if you fully understood just what it implied.]
Her perception was a profound one as the slight eruption of killing intent was felt by her, Noah's mind calculating the risks and benefits as her voice echoed out again.

[I'll give you the respect as the most recent Honored One to try and hold a discussion, and you can try to reciprocate that same respect and see what we gain from this. Otherwise, we can go back to trying to kill each other- it's fine for me either way.]
WAA!
Her words were resonant ones as at them, Noah smiled.
He analyzed the risks and benefits as he waved his hands.
[The Extremity of Chronos exerts its Authority.]
[The Extremity of Continuity emerges with indomitable brilliance, basking in the light of Infinity and taking this instance of time and expanding it endlessly!]
Their surroundings slowed down even more until the flow of time entirely ceased in this domain.
Even the visage of the Quintessential Extra who was the Annals Inquisitor seemed frozen in time as only he and the Cimmerian Architect could move freely.
With a wave of his hands, a solidified cerulean crystalline throne appeared behind him while pulsing with glory.
He sat down with majesty on such a throne while waving his hands toward the Cimmerian Architect.
[Alright, Cimmerian Architect...let us see what will come from this discussion.]
The air congealed as the veiled figure of the Cimmerian Architect became serious.
She was here as the Primogenitor of Talismans. Her identity as the Cimmerian Architect was not guessed even by the Prime Devourer!

Yet this being spoke about her so freely as she harrumphed and conjured a dazzling obsidian crystalline throne, sitting atop it grandly as the veil over her faded, her true form and face being revealed.
Black and gold strands of hair flowed freely to her shoulders.

A runic ecriture of indeterminate origins was inscribed on her forehead as her fair skin pulsed with a light of Extremity- the beauty she expressed having been refined for innumerable years across the Gradations of Extremity.
She was exquisite in all accounts as putting her right hand on her chin, she began to speak calmly while waving her left hand to conjure a dazzling ball of light.

[Since you can at least figure out who I am, you may not be an entirely lost cause. Here- unlike what others may believe, I'm not that much of a talker, so peruse this present of mine for information.]

The ball of light from her left hand floated the few feet between them as the colorless light of Quintessence flowed to receive it, the appearance of this light causing a piercing light to flash in the depths of the eyes of the Cimmerian Architect as after Quintessence found nothing wrong, Noah's will absorbed this bundle of light.
A light...that was more like an intricate database of information regarding things that were of utmost importance for Noah right now!

This ball of light eliminated a back and forth dialogue of at least two pages as Noah attained more background information on the Ones Above Extremity, prior records or mere whispers of anything to do with them, and the eons of History of entities who had sought to elevate their Concepts to the Existential level...and their sudden disappearance.
Noah perused through this bundle of information as the question of the Cimmerian Architect buzzed in his mind once more!
Why wasn't he dead?
His eyes flashed with solemnity as he came to realize the answer right away!
He wasn't dead...because of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity.

He wasn't dead because his records were sealed and pulled into their own separate database as were he to still be getting Recorded in the Vitalis or Vacuous Annals of Extremity, he truly couldn't say for sure if he would still be functioning and alive right now!
The Empire he had built all these months.
The Infinite Hyperversal Haven and all of its intricacies.
His Family. His Vassals!
It was all hidden within the Recorded History within the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
It could have all been eradicated in less than a nanosecond!
Such a thought was a solemn one to come across as such a threat should have never been this close to bringing an end to his story without him even knowing it.
It was too close for his comfort!
And even now, the danger was much greater than even what the Cimmerian Architect believed.
Noah didn't just forge an Existential Extremity Authority- he forged two.

And he had gone even further and enacted something that the Ones Above Extremity- the unfathomable force behind Vitalis and Vacuous Existential Authorities...he had enacted something that they would consider blasphemous and utter overarching into their Authorities!

chapters.title: Chapter 2810 A Heavy Choice! II
paragraphs: 2810 A Heavy Choice! II
Compiling all of this information together, Noah's Will moved rapidly as his internal discussion about Vitalis and Vacuous Existential Authorities returned.
He had entrenched these two authorities in his very existence as they flowed across his Meiridans.
They flowed across his Body, Origin, and Soul as they were even a part of his Lineage!
And yet at this moment, they felt like scorching molten flows of lava coursing across all his vessels.
HUUM!
His existence trembled.
His soul buzzed with unfathomable majesty as at this moment...
[The Extremity of Quintessence and Infinity rise to support the extremely difficult choice and path ahead.]
[The Extremity of Plot rises and says such a path would be the only acceptable one going forward.]
[The Extremities of the past Natural Laws and Decreta express their willingness to act as the greatest pillars of support if need be.]
[The Extremity of Tyranny shines with unblemished glory and states that the Vitalis and Vacuous Existential Authorities are too dangerous to make up such a core part of your existence!]
A heavy choice.
One that Noah didn't even fathom hours ago!

But when all of the information lined up, it was leading to a future where if he didn't correct something right at this moment, his path could be ended at any point in time by unfathomably powerful forces that very few beings understood.
[The Extremity of Plagiarism states that the Sources of Vitalis and Vacuous Existential Authorities are nowhere close to your grasp as they cannot even be commandeered or stolen.]
[The Extremity of Cheats rises from its slumber.]
WAA!
From the depths of his existence, a concept rose and looked at everything as it stated its position a moment later.
[The Extremity of Cheats affirms that while it would be a difficult process and a momentary loss, Vitalis and Vacuous must be scorched from your existence.]

[The Extremity of the Protagonist gazes from its high throne and states that the Protagonist cannot be under the influence and control of Existential Extremity Authorities that are not of your own control.]
The insurmountably heavy decision was made unanimously from all parts that made Noah.
With a steely resolve, Noah turned his gaze toward the Cimmerian Architect, his eyes blazing with Quintessence and Infinity.

Gazing at her figure on the throne, he sighed and turned upwards to stare at the Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Vacuous that the Cimmerian Architect had purposely left in the back while bringing forward her Runic Scriptures of EPOCH, TIME, and CHRONOLOGY.

This being had advanced the Hyperversal Authority of Vacuous to Extremity and even turned its Scriptures Existential, and even she didn't trust it enough as she called upon other concepts of Extremity that could lay out the effects of the absence of time.
Even though she had reached such a high Gradation of Extremity and refined this Existential Authority to such a level, even she didn't trust it!
So how could Noah, who had now forged two other separate Existential Extremity Authorities...ever come to trust Vacuous or Vitalis?
From the Records of the Annals Inquisitor, he had the choice to begin embarking on expanding the Vacuous Hyperversal Authority towards Extremity.
Until now, there was a prompt buried among many that stated the words simply!
[You have gained the authority to embark on the path of Extremity for the Existential Authority of Vacuous!]
Such a prompt had appeared within Noah's mind milliseconds ago.
He had not embarked on this path then, and it now seemed like he would not be embarking on this path for the foreseeable future!

Unlike the time when he could take a concept and expand it himself to make it his own, like when he expanded Genesis and it was entirely different from what the True Emperor of Genesis held- Existential Authorities were not treated the same.
If he tried to expand Vacuous or Vitalis....it would always be connected to the Vacuous and Vitalis Existential Authorities that were the backbone of the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains!
This was an authority and majesty granted to Existential Extremity Authorities!
At such a reality, Noah sighed once more as his gaze returned to the Cimmerian Architect while voicing out majestically.
[What a fucking mess.]
The eyes of the Cimmerian Architect were roused as her voice echoed out with a mixture ofcuriosity and skepticism.

[What is it? What realization did you come to? Why...are you not dead? The moment you succeeded in something that has gotten Honored Ones killed before, your existence should have been over then and there. So what is preventing it even now?]
She reiterated her question again.
She was curious to know if this being had any possible answers to her conundrum!

Was the mere thought of challenging The Ones Above Extremity actually feasible? Or would the eons continue where even the most powerful entities across the Gradations of Extremity moved carefully and with a sense of fear?
She wanted an answer from this Entity before her as at this moment, his reply was one that angered her!
[I will repay this favor with an answer soon enough, but for now...I have to take care of something.]
[You...!] Immense frustration and anger were roused in the mind of the Cimmerian Architect as a moment later, she saw a heavy and unseen authority erupt and veil the figure of Noah Osmont entirely.
This was the same authority that she felt was unlike Vacuous nor Vitalis as at this moment, it seemed like a gap in existence that couldn't be seen or fathomed by others!
She could not see what was happening within such an enclosure.

At the same moment, time began to flow ever so slowly as the Quintessential Extra who was the Annals Inquisitor somberly came to float in front of the cocoon, gazing at the Cimmerian Architect with sharp eyes while in the distance, the Four Esteemed Havenly Emperors had their authorities pierce space and lock onto the Prime Devourer!
At such a moment.
On the 125th millisecond since Noah took his Records and stretched them towards Infinity.
His whole existence began to buzz.
But it wasn't him alone.
The whole Infinite Hyperversal Haven began to buzz as around it, a heavy apocalyptic light of Armageddon began to wade through!
An Apocalypse began.
It began with authorities that had brought Noah to where he was today, their help being critical for him to do all the things he had grown capable of doing that brought him here!
But at this moment, all of it was about to be eradicated and forever scorched out of his existence.
[The Extremity of Apocalypse initiates the destruction and cataclysm of everything to do with Vitalis and Vacuous Existential Authorities within your Existence and the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.]
[ Quintessence and Infinity Existential Authorities move to support and replace the gaps that will be left behind!]

After becoming exposed and coming to understand Vitalis and Vacuous in the last few weeks since he stepped into the Seven Aeonic Havens, integrating them to become major parts of his existence, and even coming close to expanding them to Extremity...Noah made the choice to entirely scorch these foreign Existential Authorities out of his existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 2811 The Apocalypse of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities! I
paragraphs: 2811 The Apocalypse of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities! I
Choices.
All Entities lived or died by the choices they made.

On this day, the Extremity of Quintessence made a grand choice as the two Existential Authorities that made up a key part of existence itself...he began to wage an apocalypse on them within his body and Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
Every trace of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority within him was rapidly being scorched and burned out of his Records as the implications of this were far too grand.
His Lineage would change.
His Body, Origin, and Soul would change.
His Awakenings would be gone.
The products he attained by having withstood Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority within his existence together would disappear!
Would his distinction of Inscrutable Existence have any of itself remaining? The Units of Havenly Aurora? His Havenly Organ? His Enneagonal Existential Jewel?
There were so many things that would be involved that thinking about it alone was enough to overwhelm the common mind.
And this wasn't something that would just be applicable to him as this effect would be carried out across everything connected to Noah!
His Vassals.
The Extremities stretched out across the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains who had just attained the First Vitalis Awakening through their Enneagonal Existential Jewels.
Everything...was about to change!
In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, Noah's body floated at the center point of the massive Extremity Veil that cycled with waves of authorities.
His body was currently buzzing as he seemed like he was destroying his very existence- and he truly was as Vitalis had bathed his soul and other parts of his existence deeply.
Vacuous had bathed his body and physiology deeply!
And they both made his Origin go towards becoming Existential.
Now, he brought apocalypse to all this.
It would have been a major and irreversible loss for any other being, but for Noah...
HUUM!
As soon as things were broken and erased from his Existence, the Colorless and Cerulean light of Quintessence and Infinity came in to make it shine ever brighter.
He was undergoing an apocalypse of his existence while in its place...a rebirth with Quintessence and Infinity followed.
At the same time...
[The Extremity of the Protagonist sees an opportunity for an elevation in the wake of this apocalypse and rises from its high throne.]
[The Extremity of Plot says its importance is insurmountable and seeks the same opportunity!]
[The Extremity of Tyranny blazes with mad grandeur while expressing that such an opportunity should be theirs.]
[The Extremity of Apocalypse rages with Cataclysmic light while asserting that its current actions make it the more suitable candidate for this opportunity!]

The major concepts of Extremity making up Noah's existence took this terrifying ordeal and time as an opportunity to see if Noah's soul could handle the rise of another Existential Authority after Vitalis and Vacuous were eradicated.
And they blared with their own might and profound extremes as they sought to elevate themselves and achieve the same stage as Quintessence and Infinity!

His main body underwent tremendous changes as it floated amidst the very center of the forming Extremity Vein, countless units of authorities surging around him as he felt like all parts of his existence were being torn apart and replaced!

Quintessence and Infinity radiated their Existential Extremity Authorities as they burnt everything there was about Vacuous and Vitalis, the Extremity of Apocalypse borrowing their power to bring about their ultimate demise.
This was Noah undergoing this change.
But he...was in no way alone.
At this same moment in time, the Seer of Sima had entered the Colorless Instance Dungeon Portal and arrived into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven for the first time.
She should have at least been given time to understand and fathom the domain of the Primogenitor of the Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage she was now a part of.
But the moment she arrived, she stared at the wonder that was the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
She saw the massive Infinity shaped Extremity Vein that bound together multiple Aletheian Havens.
And at the very core of it all, she could see an outline of a figure.

Tendrils of heavy and astonishing authorities swirled around his visage as she could distinctly feel and see milky white and obsidian authorities being turned into flames and ash as in their place, a Colorless and Cerulean light blazed with glorious magnificence.
This Tier 4 Hyperversal Extremity looked at such a scene in a daze as she spoke out.
[Primogenitor...?]
The connection she couldn't feel all of a sudden seemed like it was right in front of her, but before she could understand it and the situation around her...
BZZT!
She felt a part of her existence burning.

It was a tingling sensation as if an itch was being scratched, but the Seer of Sima quickly located where it stemmed from as within her very Bloodline, she felt an intricate and core part of it being burnt and replaced!
And this wasn't all.
Prompts began to appear before her.
[The Existential Authority within your existence is being expunged and altered.]
[You have lost any attained Vitalis Awakenings.]
[Within the root of your existence, Seeds of Quintessence and Infinity bloom as you can choose which Existential Authority to Awaken with.]
Prompts with utterly disastrous implications boomed within her mind, the Seer of Sima's cane falling from her hands as her aged figure gazed around in horror.
As if she expected the very space to crack open and for her to be struck out of existence!
Yet...nothing occurred.
Only the changes within her body continued as she gazed towards the distant figure of the Primogenitor in the center of pulsing Havens in shock.
[Existential Authorities? Different from Vacuous and Vitalis?! Primogenitor...
what the hell are you doing?!]
Her voice was hoarse as she wanted to ask, but her very existence was trembling with excitement as it told her to choose.
Between Quintessence and Infinity.

Her very existence seemed drawn to it and immensely sought it as she had to take this decision while at the same time, she felt every trace of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority being erased from her records.
She was inclined towards something as ridiculous as Infinity.
A dead path!
But then...she remembered and knew very well how the Primogenitor had introduced himself.
The True Emperor of Quintessence.
The Primogenitor of Quintessence and Infinity!

His Vassals.

chapters.title: Chapter 2812 The Apocalypse of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities! II
paragraphs: 2812 The Apocalypse of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities! II
With such a distinction, the Seer of Sima sighed while making a selection that would drive the direction of her existence.
[You have selected Quintessence to be at the core of your Existence!]
[You are undergoing your First Quintessential Awakening!]
Boundless brilliance coursed within her existence as a phenomenal change unlike any other she had experienced before began to take place.
This was one Vassal.

Such profound changes were occurring to all Vassals within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as its will, Noah's Will, and the nearly complete Quintessential Annals of Extremity were all working together to lay out rules and distinctions on how the purging of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities would be carried out, as well as how much of Quintessence and Infinity would be spread outside of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
Within Noah's mind, dense sets of prompts were flashing in a constant fashion.

[The Extremity of Quintessence and all Vassals within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven will undergo complete expulsion of foreign Existential Authorities, with the Vassals granted a choice between Quintessence or Infinity at their core.]

[The Vassals or those containing the Lineage of the Extremity of Quintessence outside of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven will undergo an incomplete expulsion and transformation that will only be complete when they enter the Infinite Hyperversal Haven and have their Records anchored to the Quintessential Annals of Extremity.]
It was intricate.

Those under the complete umbrella of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity were safe from expressing and utilizing the Existential Authorities of Quintessence and Infinity as those who still had even a portion of their records within the Aeonic Annals of Extremity...they were stuck in a place where they couldn't enjoy the full benefits of what was currently occurring.
It did mean that eventually, all those who had his Lineage- Any of those within the Seven Clans or Major Inheritances...Noah would eventually have to absorb them into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

This would directly mean that he was taking an influx of beings who used to utilize and refine Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authorities within the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains...and he would be taking them to refine and utilize his own Existential Authorities!
He...would directly and very clearly be making enemies with those behind Vacuous and Vitalis.
This was something that caused Noah's soul to buzz with contention.
How he should navigate something like that as in the very near future, the Ones Above Extremity would see what was happening and they would make a move.
When they did make a move...would Noah be ready? Would those of his Lineage he was connected to be safe?
It was an ordeal to ponder and be ready for as for now, there were only the profound changes occurring within his existence that mattered.
[Your Soul lives and breathes Quintessence. As Vitalis leaves you, Quintessence fully blooms within your soul and illuminates the dark path ahead of you.]

[Your body has been forged into a physiology capable of rivaling even Middle Grade Armaments of Extremity. As Vacuous leaves you, Infinity courses within your body to give you a Physiology that is interminable across existence!]

His Body and Soul changed greatly as the Colorless light of Quintessence covered every part of his soul that was undergoing an apocalypse of all the Vitalis Hyperversal Authority he had been bathed in whenever he was honored.
His body experienced the same thing as Noah felt that the change was beginning at a fundamental level!
[Your very makeup is changing as your cells are being altered to become Epochal Aion Cells of Infinity.]

[Each of your cells will carry the interminable authority of Infinity as when every part of your body is filled with them, a mere movement of your body can express the profundities and might of Infinity!]
His very cells tore and split as new ones blazing with a cerulean light took their place.

Such a change began in the depths of his bone marrow as one cell changed and propagated to another, with every trace of Vacuous being scorched leaving millions more cells undergoing apocalypse and Rebirth as within his body, billions upon billions of cells began to proliferate.

The cells were uniquely taking the shape of Infinity symbols as they cycled the terrifying Existential Extremity Authority of Infinity, and by the time trillions of Noah's cells continued within his bones became Epochal Aion Cells of Infinity....
BOOOM!
His skeletal structure released a blinding cerulean light.
His bones glowed a stellar blue as very few beings in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven could even see his body clearly right now, but for those who could...
they would come to see an illusory skeletal structure radiating an endless blue light superimposed on his body!

And it's brilliant ultramarine light only spread out to the rest of his body as the cells within his very blood died and were reborn as brightly flickering infinity symbols, with his Blood beginning to flow across his vessels and into his organs as they caused their own subtle changes there.
THUMP!
The beat of his heart was wild.

With each beat, the authorities around him surged as at this moment, for the first time in Recorded History...a resonating best resounded from the Quintessential Annals of Extremity as the beginnings of a symphony bloomed.
A symphony of a profound honorarium for what the Extremity of Quintessence was undergoing!
THUMP!

Trillions upon trillions of his cells all became Epochal Aion Cells of Infinity as his body emanated an endless light that went as far as to bathe the Aletheian Havens around him, with even more grandiose prompts echoing out thereafter.
[The Innate Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Meridians within your body are being broken down and changed into Innate Infinity and Quintessence Existential Hyperversal Meridians!]
[Your Body is unlocking a Physiology Unrecorded in the Quintessential Annals of Extremity.]
[You are bringing to light the Unrecorded Epochal Infinity Existential Hyperversal Extremity Physiology!]
[Your Soul blazes with Quintessence.]
[You are bringing to light the Unrecorded Tyrannical Quintessential Existential Hyperversal Extremity Soul!]

chapters.title: Chapter 2813 Existential Tyranny! I
paragraphs: 2813 Existential Tyranny! I
His body and soul blazed with profound brilliance as they both went towards stupendous stages of power!
An Epochal Infinity Existential Physiology.
A Tyrannical Quintessential Existential Soul.
And his Origin that had been bathed in both Vacuous and Vitalis...
[You are bringing to light an Unrecorded Quintessential Infinity Existential Hyperversal Extremity Origin!]
A mixture of both Quintessence and Infinity in equal weight.
Two Existential Authorities made up his being as at this moment, nearly all of Vitalis and Vacuous within Noah's existence and records were being entirely erased.
In their absence, other Concepts of Extremity within Noah tried to claim a profound elevation from their current stages and towards Existential.
One concept was at the forefront as it was the one actively destroying both Vitalis and Vacuous with the aid of Quintessence and Infinity!
[The Extremity of Apocalypse radiates a profound brilliance while leaping towards the stage of Existential left by the gaps of Vitalis and Vacuous.]
Apocalypse.
Since it was destroying Existential Authorities itself, it felt that it should naturally take the lead!
And yet...
[The Extremity of Ascendancy pulses with halcyon radiance that envelopes all ongoing transformations and seeks the state of Existential.]
[The Extremity of Blood rises and says its Lineage is too critical to remain in the back seat.]
[The Extremity of the Protagonist exerts its overwhelming authority.]
[The Protagonist says it best defines the Extremity of Quintessence and seeks the seat of Existential!]
HUUM!

Multicolored waves of light erupted around Noah's body that was currently releasing endless cerulean brilliance, with Protagonist, Ascendancy, and Apocalypse fighting for Hegemony when all of a sudden...
[The Extremity of Plot says it moves everything forward.]
[The Extremity of Plot states that since the very beginning, it has always been Exist-]
BOOOM!
A heavy and profound crackling of purple light of utter regality and majesty boomed from the very depths of Noah's Soul- coursing through his newly forming soul as a moniker within it was pulled at.
A designation of his new soul that was already Existential was pulled upon as currently, Noah was bringing to light the Unrecorded Tyrannical Quintessential Existential Hyperversal Extremity Soul.
The distinction of Tyrannical within his soul blared.
It domineeringly grabbed onto the Existential Authority of Quintessence within the melding of Noah's soul and used this authority to instantly overwhelm all others!
In an utterly tyrannical fashion as it never allowed the Extremity of Plot to finish its words.
[The Extremity of Tyranny rises above all others with indomitable brilliance!]
[The Extremity of the Protagonist rages with indignation!]
BOOOM!

Reality cracked and splintered around Noah as wild waves of Extremity Authority clashed and rebuffed each other, but a burning royal purple light was encompassing all others as it gained more and more dominance with every passage of a millisecond, until finally...
A blinding royal purple light blazed out for light years.
And a booming symphony accompanied it with profound veneration as...
[The Extremity of Tyranny imposes its authority.]
A new Emperor rose aside from Quintessence and Infinity.
[The Amethyst Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Tyranny have begun to proliferate!]
Deeply purple.
Immeasurably brilliant.
Tyranny unfolded rapidly and in full bloom while pressing down all others below it, grabbing onto the chance to elevate itself to Existential with the fall of Vitalis and Vacuous within Noah's body.
And as soon as it arrived on this stage...
[The Extremity of Tyranny takes reigns over the eradication of Vitalis and Vacuous Existential Authorities.]

[The Extremity of Tyranny states that at this point in time, we have already been clear enemies of the Vacuous and Vitalis Existential Authorities, and that there is no need to wait cautiously to see how they react.]
[The Extremity of Tyranny states that the enemies may already be on the move and by the time reactionary action is taken, it may already be too late.]
Tyranny asserted itself actively and with shocking dominance as after stating its reasons, it carried out actions.
Terrifying actions!

[All Entities carrying the Lineage of the Extremity of Quintessence cannot coexist with Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities, and nor can they continue to stay within the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.]
WAA!

Under Noah's guidance, those who had entered the Infinite Hyperversal Haven would gain the full blanket of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity and have a complete transformation under Quintessence or Infinity.
Those outside of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven would have to make their way here in order to gain the full benefits- just like what the Seer of Sima did!
But at this moment, under the blazing will of Tyranny...

[All Entities carrying the transforming Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage will immediately be warped into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven and removed from the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.]
A terrifying move was made as the whole Infinite Hyperversal Haven buzzed.
[The Extremity of Tyranny moves to rename its lineage into the Tyrannical Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage.]

Tyranny moved quickly and renamed Noah's lineage by removing the moniker of Havenly as moments after, across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven...miniature Amethyst Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Tyranny flashed.
And with every flash, an existence who had just had their Vitalis or Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities wiped out along with the removal of their Records from the Aeonic Annals of Extremity appeared.
The gorgeous royal purple flashes of light...were in the millions and only continuing.
RUMBLE!

In front of the buzzing Aletheian Haven of Avalon, astonished and shocked figures of Erikson and the Extremity of Foundation clutched their chests while feeling the profound changes in their existence- turning up to gaze around them in shock as one after another, Extremities and Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from the Sima Clan that had taken the Blood Sources all began to appear.

Near the Dream Aletheian Haven, the figure of Ayame and her Grandfather appeared as they gazed around them, other figures from the Infinite Extremity looking around and suddenly...falling to their knees as they saw the massive Extremity Vein shaped in the form of an Infinity symbol!
[Infinity...]
Ayame's grandfather spoke in a raspy voice as if he hadn't had any water for eons.
In another region, Extremities and Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from the Havenly Moon Clan appeared one after another.
Those from the Prometheus Clan.
Those who had renounced the Avernus Clan.
Those from the Curagulus of Extremity that had taken Noah's Blood Sources.
Those from the Senatus of Extremity that had attained Noah's lineage!
The members of the Cult of Endless Shadows who obtained Blood Sources.
The Adjudicator of Dissolution.

Every single Entity belonging to any of the Seven Clans and Inheritances of Extremity who took the Blood Sources Noah spread was warped across space and time- across Recorded and Unrecorded Histories, across Aeonic Annals of Extremity...and into a domain obscured from Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.
Into a domain outside of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
Into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven that was surrounded and covered thoroughly by the Quintessential Annals of Extremity!

Under Noah's guidance, those who had entered the Infinite Hyperversal Haven would gain the full blanket of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity and have a complete transformation under Quintessence or Infinity.
Those outside of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven would have to make their way here in order to gain the full benefits- just like what the Seer of Sima did!
But at this moment, under the blazing will of Tyranny...

[All Entities carrying the transforming Havenly Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage will immediately be warped into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven and removed from the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.]
A terrifying move was made as the whole Infinite Hyperversal Haven buzzed.
[The Extremity of Tyranny moves to rename its lineage into the Tyrannical Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage.]

Tyranny moved quickly and renamed Noah's lineage by removing the moniker of Havenly as moments after, across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven...miniature Amethyst Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Tyranny flashed.
And with every flash, an existence who had just had their Vitalis or Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities wiped out along with the removal of their Records from the Aeonic Annals of Extremity appeared.
The gorgeous royal purple flashes of light...were in the millions and only continuing.
RUMBLE!

In front of the buzzing Aletheian Haven of Avalon, astonished and shocked figures of Erikson and the Extremity of Foundation clutched their chests while feeling the profound changes in their existence- turning up to gaze around them in shock as one after another, Extremities and Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from the Sima Clan that had taken the Blood Sources all began to appear.

Near the Dream Aletheian Haven, the figure of Ayame and her Grandfather appeared as they gazed around them, other figures from the Infinite Extremity looking around and suddenly...falling to their knees as they saw the massive Extremity Vein shaped in the form of an Infinity symbol!
[Infinity...]
Ayame's grandfather spoke in a raspy voice as if he hadn't had any water for eons.
In another region, Extremities and Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from the Havenly Moon Clan appeared one after another.
Those from the Prometheus Clan.
Those who had renounced the Avernus Clan.
Those from the Curagulus of Extremity that had taken Noah's Blood Sources.
Those from the Senatus of Extremity that had attained Noah's lineage!
The members of the Cult of Endless Shadows who obtained Blood Sources.
The Adjudicator of Dissolution.

Every single Entity belonging to any of the Seven Clans and Inheritances of Extremity who took the Blood Sources Noah spread was warped across space and time- across Recorded and Unrecorded Histories, across Aeonic Annals of Extremity...and into a domain obscured from Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.
Into a domain outside of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
Into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven that was surrounded and covered thoroughly by the Quintessential Annals of Extremity!

chapters.title: Chapter 2814 Existential Tyranny! II
paragraphs: 2814 Existential Tyranny! II

An action true to the name of the Extremity of Tyranny was taken as Extremities ranging from Tier 1 to Tier 4 who had taken Noah's Blood Sources were all forcefully warped into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven- their Records scorched of anything to do with Vacuous or Vitalis whether they wished for it or not.
The structure of power laid out across the Nether Havens of Extremity for eons.
The Seven Clans and Major Inheritances stretched throughout the Seven Havens.
The Extremity of Tyranny took an action that effectively broke apart all of this intricate structure as it considered the reality that they were likely in a time of a great and unfathomable war!
And they couldn't wait for their enemy to make the first move.
Because with their enemies, there were too many unknowns. The moment they made a move, everything could be over and done!
[All Vassals that have entered Colorless Instance Dungeon Portals of Quintessence have been forcefully recalled.]
[Any trace of Quintessence, Infinity, and Tyranny within the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Domains is being recalled and erased.]
Until Noah understood what enemies lay ahead of him, Tyranny moved to contain and not expose him under the gaze of authorities they didn't fully understand!
It was a move on the border of an overabundance of caution carried out by Tyranny.
But this one move...had greatly altered what would have otherwise been catastrophic results.

Because around the same time that Tyranny carried out its shocking Will- unimaginable and unexpected changes began that nobody- not even those who had taken their version of Destiny to the highest Gradations of Extremity...could have predicted.
In the domain isolated from time and space when Talismans covered its outer exterior, and Havens of Dreams and Apollyon covered everything else.
Four Esteemed Havenly Emperors had chained and were dragging down the Prime Devourer- his huge worm like figure wriggling and wishing to leave this domain after his plans entirely fell apart!

And at the very center of this domain, the Quintessential Extra who was the Annals Inquisitor stood before Noah's body as she stared with caution towards the visage of the Cimmerian Architect who was currently cursing nonstop.
[Fucking hell! What would you have to do at a critical time like this? All I asked was a single damn question and I even provided information you sorely needed! And now...fuck!]
Immense frustration could be heard in her voice as the issue at hand was truly a major one.
Why was he not dead?
What did he have to do at this time as soon as he received the information she gave him?
What-...!
Her thoughts came to a halt.
Her pupils dilated in a shocking fashion as her heart...her very soul...it felt an unprecedented and unimaginable danger.
She wasn't the only one as within the cocoon, the head of Noah's Clone was barely able to rise an inch before...
|UNGRATEFUL|
HUUM!
A booming voice shattered the barrier of talismans, the Havens of Dreams, and Apollyon above.
A voice.
A word.
It held no emotion within it as it was filled with profound apathy, indifference, and aloofness.
But what it carried...
Oh, what it carried!
It carried such immense and unstoppable power that the moment this word was uttered, the surroundings congealed as if the very reality was against them!

And in this instant, austere and utterly pristine milky tendrils of light instantly bloomed and descended from the very crevices of reality as they seemed like celestial judgment raining down from all around.
Each tendril of milky white light was akin to a river of reality as its composition were unique Existential Rune Scriptures whose origins, shape, nor form could be easily discerned.

From above and below, massive and intricate circles filled with layers of Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of VITALIS bloomed- grinding downwards and upwards as from them, even grander tendrils of smiting lightning of destruction unfurled!

Noah's brief glance of these massive Rune Scriptures reminded him of the same ones that appeared above the Infinite Hyperversal Haven to grant him a baptism of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority for his Honorariums.
Now, their purpose here was much different!
When they appeared, the 9 Infernal Superius Wheels of Extinction were instantly splintered and shattered as the tendrils of white lightning seemed like unstoppable smites of judgment.
They were raining down all around as their target...was not singular.
Rage and horror were apparent on the face of the Cimmerian Architect as she saw boundlessly large milky white tendrils of light converge on her from all around.

Her Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Vacuous did nothing to prevent them from coming close, these Scriptures even moving and making way seamlessly as the milky white tendrils of smite thundered down!
Her rage was immeasurable as when her eyes turned to the man opposite her, she could see his still calm gaze in the cocoon as her Extremity of Intuition buzzed its utmost in all her life.
And she moved, her hand reaching out towards Noah as her voice angrily echoed out!
[Make all of this fucking worth it!]

Her hand reached out, and Noah stared at the coming tendrils of milky white smites that seemed to be coming across space and time, as if they had been coming milliseconds ago and they would keep coming milliseconds later as he knew they weren't avoidable.
His will...was only able to wrap around the Quintessential Extra in front of him and the outstretched hand of the Cimmerian Architect before an instant later...
BOOOM! BOOM!
Like an unending cluster of thunderous judgment.

Noah felt the unstoppable might of the foreign and unknown Scriptures contained in these tendrils of smiting lightning shred across his Colorless and Cerulean Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures, their might tearing apart his body that was expressing a might of the Middle Grade Zenith level as if it were paper!
This terrifying light...they sought his records.
But this was where things ended.
For the consciousness within this clone, everything turned dark as they would never come to find his records!
Even if they searched all of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, he would not be found!
BOOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 2815 Cleansing! I
paragraphs: 2815 Cleansing! I
The thundering waves of judgment continued.
Noah's figure was shredded out of existence as before this entire scene faded from his eyes, he was able to catch a glimpse of a terrifying scene.
A scene of the Cimmerian Architect bellowing out as her Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of VACUOUS did nothing against the retribution of white lightning around her.
The target of all of this was Noah, yes, but thereafter...the apathetic voice that uttered a single word seemed to then target any of those connected to or had aided Noah in any way!

Their gaze saw everything across the Aeonic Annals of Extremity as any Records, cause and effect, and the usage of Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Authority was perused and acted upon with callousness and extreme apathy.

Apart from the Cimmerian Architect, Noah saw the unfiltered shock and horror on the face of Extremity Solarium as the very Vitalis Hyperversal Authority within her body seemingly constricted and held her in place as tendrils of milky white lightning scorched everything!
She wasn't alone as the other three Esteemed Havenly Emperors she had called forth to aid Noah in his endeavor also faced the same fate!
It was a surreal and shocking scene that very quickly escaped Noah's gaze.
For him, in this region, everything went dark.

And the moment Noah's consciousness was cut off from this domain along with every shred of his authority, the two circling intricate formations of Extremity Rune Scriptures and boundless white light of judgment all faded within an instant as if they were never there!
All that was left behind...were a few spots where the Four Esteemed Havenly Emperors used to be.
What was left behind of their existence was a bundle of the source their existence stemmed from as very soon, it dispersed into whispers of Vitalis that sank into the surrounding reality.
What was born from Vitalis...returned to Vitalis.
There was no loss.
Only a cycle!
In utter shock, the massive figure of the Prime Devourer gazed at this terrifying scene as he was untouched.
His worm like figure wriggled with shock and emotion as he saw the deaths of all his enemies and the Primogenitor of Talismans as he questioned...whether he was actually alive.

In another corner, the Bard of Vitalis held a sorrowful expression as he played a slow and heart-rending melody, a melody of extreme loss that had just occurred, and the immense loss that would follow!
This was because what occurred here was not a singular event.
It was something...occurring in many other places!
Simultaneously and across spacetime, everything to do with and connected to Noah Osmont was being cleansed out of existence!
In the Supernal Haven of Helios where Noah was with the Main Body of Extremity Solarium.
He was here waiting to enter the Havenly Hyperversal Gauntlet of Gradation.

His eyes were only able to flicker with brightness as his Will reached out towards Extremity Solarium whose face was ashen with horror as above and below them, massive spinning intricate circles of milky white Scriptures ground down- instantly shredding the records of Extremity Solarium at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity and Noah's clone mercilessly!
But this wasn't all.
In the Obsidian Saurischian Archipelago.

The space above this massive floating landmass of utter beauty and magnificence opened as a single massive strike of milky white lightning the size of multiple Minor Havens rained down with a cataclysmic light, shredding everything below it as after a nanosecond...
Glimmering stellar dust was all that remained.
The entire Archipelago disappeared as if the traces of Noah appearing within it had to all be entirely erased.
Along with its disappearance, trillions of figures who were simply going about their day disappeared with their records wiped as if they never existed.
Simultaneously, in the far distance where the Golden Smilodon Archipelagos were, a burst of blinding light bloomed as the moment it passed, everything on this landmass was scorched!
And at this same time, across the Supernal Haven of Dissolution, Noah's floating islands that held his clones acting under the guise of the Infernal Havenly Commerce....
BOOOM!
Faced a raging burst of blinding white light from all directions.
For all islands where he had distributed Blood Sources before...and all the entities continued within these islands.
It was a heavy and irreversible action!

And it was occurring simultaneously across different areas as outside of the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains, Noah's clone that was facing the Fifth Gradation of Extremity- the Extremity of Light...a blinding beam of white light tore across spacetime to instantly sunder him out of existence as an instant later...
Emperor Shao and Extremity of Light along with the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Legions could only stare blankly in shock and horror.
His Will within the Extremity Bridge connecting to Anarchos.
His Will that hadstepped into this Infernal Domain.
The bodies of Vacuous Malignancies near the Extremity Bridge of Anarchos that he had infected with his Virions.
Anything and everything connected to Noah...faced a thorough and utter Annihilation as if all of the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains were being cleansed!
Cleansed of Noah Osmont.
Cleansed of anything to do with Quintessence and Infinity!
The effects were widespread and far reaching.
Far in the depths of the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains.
Within layers of veiled Records twisted in time and space, in a domain where a hut and a forge stood stably.

A Refined and a Blacksmith were carrying on their own business when all of sudden, their gazes changed heavily as the Records they were hidden in trembled while buzzing with an obsidian flash of light that was followed by a single reverberating word!
|UNGRATEFUL|

A trace of interminable shock and disbelief overcame them as they quickly turned into streams of light that weaved across multiple pathways and Records, their figures coming to arrive in what should have been a record of a paradisiacal Haven that was Recorded eons ago- a Haven that the body of the Cimmerian Architect normally stayed in.
Yet at this moment, when they arrived...all they could see was a scorched reality and landmasses breaking off into a cataclysm as the aura of the Cimmerian Architect was nowhere to be felt.
[No...Elodie!]
