chapters.title: Chapter 2816 Cleansing! II
paragraphs: 2816 Cleansing! II
The female Entity at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity bellowed out with immense pain and shock as the Blacksmith beside her trembled.
His hand moved as Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of VACUOUS unfolded, his will searching for Records of the Cimmerian Architect.
Of any records to do with Elodie!
And...
[Nothing...]

His massive burly body seemed to age immense as it trembled, because he shockingly came to find the Records of Elodie were entirely absent in the Vacuous Annals of Extremity and the Vitalis Annals of Extremity.
As if she had never even existed.
His burly figure trembled.
His power at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity was immense and boundless as he gazed upwards.
He gazed at the silent space all around as his gaze was fierce- as if he wanted to rebel against it!
But an instant later...his gaze became cloudy as he looked down.
Age and weakness filled his body as he couldn't find it within himself. He couldn't do it.

Even such a powerhouse at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity...felt immeasurable weakness and power as a moment later, he roared out in helplessness as his bellows shattered the Recorded History around him!
Across the absence of space and time.
Within the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains- inside the Haven of Perdition.
A man waved his hands to cause the disappearance of multiple figures around him as silent waves of Perdition roared around him.
A hint of Extremity was covering his body unstably as at this moment, his gaze was filled with solemnity.
|UNGRATEFUL|

A single word boomed out from all around as an instant later, a dazzling obsidian circle filled with swirling Existential Extremity Authority bloomed and came crashing down towards the figure of this man!
His eyes shone with tendrils of Cerulean light as he came to place his right hand on his chest.
He felt the last beat of his heart.
He felt the intricate layers of Systems he had forged within his existence, and what he had done in order to create a safe haven for himself and those he loved from ever facing certain death.
His safeguards were activated automatically a moment ago as he didn't know who the enemy was, but it didn't matter now.
He only hoped that what he had set up would be enough.
BOOOM!
With an apocalyptic glimmer, the rotating circle buzzing with Existential Extremity Authority arrived above the visage of the Great Usurper.
Cataclysmic authority crashed down on Noah Eckert as the moment it dawned on him, his body turned into tendrils of blue light that scattered freely!
A large amount of these tendrils of Cerulean light tried to arc and wrap around the descending obsidian circle of destruction before ultimately, they were seemingly entirely destroyed into oblivion!
Immense silence and nothingness remained thereafter as the seas of Perdition flowed freely.
Where Noah Eckert used to be...nothing remained!

A thorough and indeterminate cleansing had occurred for anything and anyone related to Noah Osmont, with this moment in time being a major turning point and a moment that would be etched in the minds of many as across the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains...a single one had thundered out that had come with it immense fear.
A single word that seemed to show off great power and act as a reminder to all others at the same time!

The actions carried forth simultaneously across existence at the same time only further cemented the power of this single word as with it, the landscape of the Nether Havens of Extremity was entirely changed.
The structure of Clans and Inheritances were fractured and desolate.
Quintillions upon quintillions died, no matter if they were Extremities or Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.
And most of all....
HUUM!

Resonating waves of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority bloomed as in the isolated domain where only the figure of the Prime Devourer and Bard of Vitalis remained...space twisted and warped as a burly entity walked out of it.
With devilishly handsome features and great age and power...it was actually none other than the Primogenitor of Steel.
WAP!
WAP!
He wasn't the only one to arrive as moments later, a burst of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority bloomed.

And a burst of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority followed thereafter...with flashes of white and black continuing thereafter as within a nanosecond...this space was filled with terrifying auras in the upper tiers of the Gradations of Extremity.
Some were wrapped heavily in Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Vitalis, while others were wrapped in Vacuous.

Different races and creeds all adorned variations of humanoid forms as some gazed towards the Primogenitor of Steel and nodded in recognition and respect, and they did the same to a few select Entities that had just arrived here!
All of them...had their gazes focused on where the figure of Noah used to be.

Off to the side, the figure of the Prime Devourer trembled at the arrival of these terrifying monsters steeped in history as at this moment, the voice of one of these Entities rang out with a hint of sorrow.
[Little Bard, you saw everything?]
The question of this feminine voice was directed towards the Bard of Vitalis who calmly packed his instruments and tools as if his job here was done.
The monkey-like visage of the Bard of Vitalis nodded without any emotion as he prepared to leave.
The symphony he had forged this time was a grand one, but it left a particularly bad taste in his mouth.
Before he left, the Primogenitor of Steel calmly spoke as his words stopped the Bard of Vitalis in his tracks.
[How was the most recent Honored One?]
A heavy question.
One that caused the expressions of other powerful Entities here to change as they didn't respect the Primogenitor of Steel to be so bold as to ask such a thing!

Some Entities even chose to leave right away when such a topic was asked as they had just affirmed how trillions of others just loosely connected to this most recent Honored One had just perished with him!
The Bard of Vitalis was silent for a moment before he spoke slowly.
[Milliseconds after achieving Extremity, he could already butcher those at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity. Who knows how far he could have gone...]
WAA!
While leaving behind such words, the Bard of Vitalis disappeared.
In this space that was now filled with a number of shockingly powerful entities who were always stretched out across Recorded and Unrecorded Histories, another voice boomed out.
[He fell down just as quickly as he rose...rest in peace, Osmont.]
An Entity of an unknown Gradation echoed out such words before he disappeared.
Others were silent and contemplative at this whole ordeal as they watched on with a myriad of their own thoughts and emotions.
All they could confirm...was that the most recent Honored One had already fallen!

sentences.text: 2816 Cleansing!
II
The female Entity at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity bellowed out with immense pain and shock as the Blacksmith beside her trembled.
His hand moved as Polychrome Hyperversal Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of VACUOUS unfolded, his will searching for Records of the Cimmerian Architect.
Of any records to do with Elodie!
And...
[Nothing...]

His massive burly body seemed to age immense as it trembled, because he shockingly came to find the Records of Elodie were entirely absent in the Vacuous Annals of Extremity and the Vitalis Annals of Extremity.
As if she had never even existed.
His burly figure trembled.
His power at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity was immense and boundless as he gazed upwards.
He gazed at the silent space all around as his gaze was fierce- as if he wanted to rebel against it!
But an instant later...his gaze became cloudy as he looked down.
Age and weakness filled his body as he couldn't find it within himself.
He couldn't do it.

Even such a powerhouse at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity...felt immeasurable weakness and power as a moment later, he roared out in helplessness as his bellows shattered the Recorded History around him!
Across the absence of space and time.
Within the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains- inside the Haven of Perdition.
A man waved his hands to cause the disappearance of multiple figures around him as silent waves of Perdition roared around him.
A hint of Extremity was covering his body unstably as at this moment, his gaze was filled with solemnity.
|UNGRATEFUL|

A single word boomed out from all around as an instant later, a dazzling obsidian circle filled with swirling Existential Extremity Authority bloomed and came crashing down towards the figure of this man!
His eyes shone with tendrils of Cerulean light as he came to place his right hand on his chest.
He felt the last beat of his heart.
He felt the intricate layers of Systems he had forged within his existence, and what he had done in order to create a safe haven for himself and those he loved from ever facing certain death.
His safeguards were activated automatically a moment ago as he didn't know who the enemy was, but it didn't matter now.
He only hoped that what he had set up would be enough.
BOOOM!
With an apocalyptic glimmer, the rotating circle buzzing with Existential Extremity Authority arrived above the visage of the Great Usurper.
Cataclysmic authority crashed down on Noah Eckert as the moment it dawned on him, his body turned into tendrils of blue light that scattered freely!
A large amount of these tendrils of Cerulean light tried to arc and wrap around the descending obsidian circle of destruction before ultimately, they were seemingly entirely destroyed into oblivion!
Immense silence and nothingness remained thereafter as the seas of Perdition flowed freely.
Where Noah Eckert used to be...nothing remained!

A thorough and indeterminate cleansing had occurred for anything and anyone related to Noah Osmont, with this moment in time being a major turning point and a moment that would be etched in the minds of many as across the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains...a single one had thundered out that had come with it immense fear.
A single word that seemed to show off great power and act as a reminder to all others at the same time!

The actions carried forth simultaneously across existence at the same time only further cemented the power of this single word as with it, the landscape of the Nether Havens of Extremity was entirely changed.
The structure of Clans and Inheritances were fractured and desolate.
Quintillions upon quintillions died, no matter if they were Extremities or Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.
And most of all....
HUUM!

Resonating waves of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority bloomed as in the isolated domain where only the figure of the Prime Devourer and Bard of Vitalis remained...space twisted and warped as a burly entity walked out of it.
With devilishly handsome features and great age and power...it was actually none other than the Primogenitor of Steel.
WAP!
WAP!
He wasn't the only one to arrive as moments later, a burst of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority bloomed.

And a burst of Vitalis Hyperversal Authority followed thereafter...with flashes of white and black continuing thereafter as within a nanosecond...this space was filled with terrifying auras in the upper tiers of the Gradations of Extremity.
Some were wrapped heavily in Existential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Vitalis, while others were wrapped in Vacuous.

Different races and creeds all adorned variations of humanoid forms as some gazed towards the Primogenitor of Steel and nodded in recognition and respect, and they did the same to a few select Entities that had just arrived here!
All of them...had their gazes focused on where the figure of Noah used to be.

Off to the side, the figure of the Prime Devourer trembled at the arrival of these terrifying monsters steeped in history as at this moment, the voice of one of these Entities rang out with a hint of sorrow.

Who knows how far he could have gone...]

chapters.title: Chapter 2817 An Existential Declaration of War! I
paragraphs: 2817 An Existential Declaration of War! I
The most recent Honored One had fallen!
It was a reality cemented in stone for many.
For any beings who had lived across eons of History, this was not a first. They had lived across Records of Honored Ones killed before.
Entities who achieved grand Honorariums, and yet they reached for a place they should have never even thought about.
It was a heavy moment in eons of Recorded History.
On the 500th millisecond after Noah had expanded his Records towards Infinity.
[Fuuuck!]

A bellow of rage and pain echoed out across records as the very Existence of an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity had to actually lower all her defenses and allow another being to guide her- otherwise she would find herself completely perishing.
It felt like just moments ago, her hand had reached out towards Noah's Existence.
With her single reach, she threw out her Records and very existence towards him as at this moment, it wasn't a matter of trust.
It was a matter of life and death as her actions of sharing information with Noah had landed her among the many beings who were cleansed out of existence!
She didn't know if she was escaping the death of the predicament she had placed herself in, or if the Entity she reached out to would even be capable of helping her to evade it.
But he was alive after creating an Existential Extremity Authority.
And he didn't show fear and horror even as an Existential night filled with undeniability rained around them.

All of these clues forced the Cimmerian Architect to very quickly and defenselessly transfer her very existence towards this being- where his will was even able to connect to her main body as currently, she was being pulled across records as she found herself asking many questions.

First, she fully opened herself and laid everything bare as any trace of Vacuous and Vitalis within her Existence was currently being scorched and erased by the foreign Existential Extremity Authority she felt around Noah.
But then...there came the most important question.
She was being pulled across Records, yes, but where to?
There was always the Aeonic Annals of Extremity containing the Vacuous and Vitalis Annals of Extremity.
This encompassed all of existence.
All of them...under the light of Vacuous and Vitalis.
So where could she and Osmont go to escape existence itself?
It was a complex question that was also very easy to answer at the same time.
The Cimmerian Architect didn't have the answer.

So she only focused herself even more as she willingly lost all traces of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority she had elevated across Five Gradations, and her existence felt a brilliant colorless brilliance cover her as she was pulled somewhere.
Somewhere.
But where exactly?
HUUM!
Noah's will was robust and filled with immense coldness at this moment as he carefully pulled in the Cimmerian Architect.

He reached out towards her because Quintessence felt she held critical information- that she was a being who knew much more than others as it would benefit him to save her from the cleansing occurring because of him!
So he pulled her towards the Infinite Hyperversal Haven while erasing everything to do with foreign Existential Authorities.
This brought to light the critical question of exactly where the Infinite Hyperversal Haven was currently.
Not too long ago, it was contained in a Recorded History within Noah's memory that was within the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
His glorious Spiritual Land was hidden within layers of Records, but they were Records bathed under the light of Vitalis and Vacuous nonetheless.
When the Quintessential Annals of Extremity began forming, his Records were erased from the Aeonic Annals of Extremity and were Recorded in the Quintessential Annals of Extremity!
Naturally, everything was pulled into himself as they were his Records...and now, the Infinite Hyperversal Haven was within Noah's records.
But...his Main Body was also within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as this begged the question, where did everything actually exist in?
Was he truly outside of the scope of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity? Outside the scope of all Existence? If so, where exactly was he and the Infinite Hyperversal Haven?!
As the Quintessential Annals of Extremity neared their formation, this question had to be clearly outlined and answered.
And it was answered in the most obscene way possible while outlining just how Noah had removed himself from the Vitalis and Vacuous Annals of Extremity!
The answer lay in Quintessence and Infinity.
What exactly could Quintessence do?
As a concept, its usage was very abstruse as it could do any myriad of things for Noah.
It could grant him the capability of offensive and defensive moves while at the same time, providing something like the Sporos of Extremity and Ash Tree of Gradation.
Its usage varied greatly!
And now, it was Existential.
It was at its very Extremes as its first actions were working in conjunction with Infinity to set up the Quintessential Annals of Extremity.
But...was this it? Was this the extent of Quintessence? And then there came the question of Infinity.
This concept was grand as surely, its capabilities were more than overwhelming other Entities with a sense of the vastness of Infinity!
At this moment, these two Existential Authorities answered these doubts of their shocking capabilities as this whole time as Noah stretched his Records to Infinity...

[Endless Existential Authority flows through Infinity and courses through Quintessence to allow for the paradoxical existence and nonexistence of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity within Noah Osmont and the gaps of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.]

[When more Existential Authority is obtained and Infinity and Quintessence are further elevated, more knowledge will be obtained on how to entirely break free and exist outside the scope of currently established Existence.]
Outside the scope of Existence.

Outside the scope of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity. Outside of Vacuous and Vitalis. This was the main goal as currently, the newly born Existential Extremity Authorities of Quintessence and Infinity were not powerful enough!
Quintessence. Infinity.
They were currently acting in conjunction to flitter across the line of existence and nonexistence as Noah figured out just where to be in all this!
As he sought to understand where he fit and what landscape he was in!

chapters.title: Chapter 2818 An Existential Declaration of War! II
paragraphs: 2818 An Existential Declaration of War! II

Currently, while utilizing tremendous Existential Extremity Authority, Infinity and Quintessence had been working at all times to make it so that the Quintessential Annals of Extremity were masked by a never ending paradoxical light where it did not exist within the Aeonic Annals of Extremity...and it also existed at the same time.
And no records of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity could be found by the Vitalis and Vacuous Annals of Extremity.
No records of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven nor Noah and those he was associated with inside it could be discerned in this paradoxical state of existence and nonexistence!
And thus...

[The Incongruity of the current state of existence of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity, Infinite Hyperversal Haven, and Noah Osmont paired with Quintessence has given birth to a new Concept of Extremity.]
[You have attained the Extremity of Paradox.]
A brand new Extremity arose from an ancient slumber.
Its authority was there and not there, present and ever absent.
Its Rune Scriptures took one color in one instance, and took another color in the next.
It was unfathomable. It was...Paradoxical!
HUUM!
[The Extremity of Paradox gazes at the many incomprehensible concepts under the banner of the Extremity of Quintessence and nods in appreciation.]
[The Extremity of Paradox blares with brilliance and states that sometimes, that which is least understood and makes little conceptual sense is the strongest.]

[The Extremity of Paradox inserts itself into the conundrum of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity, Infinite Hyperversal Haven, and its Master as it activates the feature of [Quintessential Schrodinger's Paradox]]
[Quintessence burns with colorless brilliance.]
[Infinity burns with cerulean grandeur.]
[Tyranny bellows with amethyst resplendence!]
All three of Noah's current Existential Extremity Authorities blared forth as Paradox urged them towards a fantastical conclusion.
Until a stellar prompt bloomed within Noah's mind.

[Until they can be quantified, measured, fully understood or analyzed by others- the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, Quintessential Annals of Extremity, and the Extremity of Quintessence are all in a state of existence and nonexistence- a state of quantum indeterminacy.]
WAA!
A bold statement.
A temporary solution.
And a pillar for Noah to rely on until he truly understood what Existential represented.
What Vitalis and Vacuous represented...and what those Above Extremity represented!

So long as they did not understand him, his Quintessential Annals of Extremity, and the Infinite Hyperversal Haven...they would never be capable of finding him in a state of existence and nonexistence.
In a state of quantum indeterminacy!
It was a unique state powered by all of his Existential Extremity Authorities as a newly emerging Paradox provided a framework.
It showed that the Tier of this concept was not low.
[The Extremity of the Protagonist gazes threateningly towards the Extremity of Paradox.]
It was to the extent that Noah's authorities seeking the pristine status of Existential gazed towards Paradox with caution due to its unfathomable means.
BOOM
At this time.

His concepts utterly cleansed the Cimmerian Architect at this moment as finally, after crossing layers of records, safeguards, and protection from endless waves of authority emerging from Infinity....
[Ha...fuck!]
Her voice was resonant as the Cimmerian Architect blinked.
And she found herself in a place.
A where.

Her billowing Will of an entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity spread out as the first thing she saw was the blinding construct of an Infinity symbol stretched out like a massive Extremity Vein, and the stacks of Haven rotating and expanding in real time.
Along with this, trillions of auras of Entities could be felt stretched all around, with a great number of Extremities and Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.
But she didn't care about this.
What she did care about...
[Existential...]
Was what she could directly feel.
Her wounded Soul could no longer find a trace of Vitalis or Vacuous.
Instead, she could feel the potent aura of other Existential Extremity Authorities- and multiple ones at that!
It was an impossibility she couldn't fathom as her throat felt dry when gazing at it, with her Soul quickly establishing herself as Intuition blared.
Her gaze looked at the depths of the center of the Infinity symbol as there, she could feel the one at the source of it all.
She wanted to reach out to him, but in the next moment...a set of words appeared over her eyes.
[An astonishing feat!]
[Your unique soul is one of the strongest ones within the Recorded History.]
[The number of concepts you have taken to Extremity exceeds many others and gives you great distinction in the Banner of Quintessence!]
Her pupils widened ever further.
What she saw before her...was records.
But it wasn't records of Vitalis or Vacuous!
It was records etched in something else entirely as the moment she saw it, a shocking affirmation dawned on her soul.
Why he wasn't dead.
He didn't just forge an Existential Extremity Authority...he actually separated himself from the very Aeonic Annals of Extremity and enacted a new Database of Records!
An entirely new Annals!
In her shock and disbelief, she wanted to peer more into this shocking new reality when all of a sudden, another voice rang out not too far from her.
[What is this?]
A similar voice of utter astonishment as when the Cimmerian Architect turned her gaze, she saw the visage of Extremity Solarium whom she was fighting against not too long ago.
Both of them...and many others had just arrived in this unfamiliar new location filled with unknown shocks as they were not the only ones.
There were trillions of others.
All those who had been bathed in the past lineage of the Extremity of Quintessence!
And at this moment as they were trying to get acclimated, a booming authority and symphony blared out across the endless stretches of Havens they could see as a voice filled with Tyranny echoed out.
[The Extremity of Tyranny has broken the bindings of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities that have just rained down cataclysm on trillions.]

[Vitalis and Vacuous encompassed life and death, beginnings and endings, reality and non-reality. From this moment onwards, the Existential Authorities of Quintessence and Infinity will replace these unworthy authorities being utilized and placed under the callous beck and call of those designated as the Ones Above Extremity.]
[What Vitalis and Vacuous stood for, Quintessence and Infinity will elevate and bring to a grander level.]
A shockingly amethyst resplendence bloomed across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as a heavy authority and voice boomed out.
[The Extremity of Tyranny has laid down a Tyrannical Existential Judgment after the recently unfolding reality.]
[An Existential Declaration of War has been issued against Vacuous and Vitalis- and all those utilizing these Existential Authorities to carry out their obscene oppression!]
WAA!
A declaration of war.
An Existential Declaration of War against the Ones Above Extremity!

But it wasn't records of Vitalis or Vacuous!
It was records etched in something else entirely as the moment she saw it, a shocking affirmation dawned on her soul.
Why he wasn't dead.
He didn't just forge an Existential Extremity Authority...he actually separated himself from the very Aeonic Annals of Extremity and enacted a new Database of Records!
An entirely new Annals!
In her shock and disbelief, she wanted to peer more into this shocking new reality when all of a sudden, another voice rang out not too far from her.
[What is this?]
A similar voice of utter astonishment as when the Cimmerian Architect turned her gaze, she saw the visage of Extremity Solarium whom she was fighting against not too long ago.
Both of them...and many others had just arrived in this unfamiliar new location filled with unknown shocks as they were not the only ones.
There were trillions of others.
All those who had been bathed in the past lineage of the Extremity of Quintessence!
And at this moment as they were trying to get acclimated, a booming authority and symphony blared out across the endless stretches of Havens they could see as a voice filled with Tyranny echoed out.
[The Extremity of Tyranny has broken the bindings of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities that have just rained down cataclysm on trillions.]
[Vitalis and Vacuous encompassed life and death, beginnings and endings, reality and non-reality.

From this moment onwards, the Existential Authorities of Quintessence and Infinity will replace these unworthy authorities being utilized and placed under the callous beck and call of those designated as the Ones Above Extremity.]
[What Vitalis and Vacuous stood for, Quintessence and Infinity will elevate and bring to a grander level.]
A shockingly amethyst resplendence bloomed across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as a heavy authority and voice boomed out.
[The Extremity of Tyranny has laid down a Tyrannical Existential Judgment after the recently unfolding reality.]
[An Existential Declaration of War has been issued against Vacuous and Vitalis- and all those utilizing these Existential Authorities to carry out their obscene oppression!]
WAA!
A declaration of war.
An Existential Declaration of War against the Ones Above Extremity!

chapters.title: Chapter 2819 The Existential Paths to Follow! I
paragraphs: 2819 The Existential Paths to Follow! I
The Ones Above Extremity.
Little was understood about them, and even less was understood about their connections to the Existential Authorities of Vacuous and Vitalis.
Entities on the Gradations of Extremity spoke of them in rumors and whispers, not daring to speak too loudly against who they were or anything about them.
Some Entities...had even caught glimpses of the Ones Above Extremity, or mere glimpses of Records that held such beings!
But one thing was clear.
Their authority was inviolable.
Their mere existence was awe and fear inducing!

They could be standing right before you, and you wouldn't even know. They could take on the form of any Entity and very clearly replicate their Records to the extent that one wouldn't be the wiser on who exactly stood before them.
At least...this was among the little that was known about them.
The Cimmerian Architect gazed at the burning words and voice echoing out around her that laid out an Existential Declaration of War as her breathing was slightly heavy.

She was an entity of immense power and pride as her knowledge could rival those at the Sixth or Seventh Gradation of Extremity. She knew a great deal of secrets as when it came to the Ones Above Extremity...even she was cautious!
She had thrown this caution to the wind when she met this Entity who had forged his own Existential Authority as this led to a near true death, and she somehow ended up here.
In a place where unlike Vacuous and Vitalis, the Existential Authorities here seemed to be filled with even more...life.
Yes.
This was the closest she could think of it as she knew the reason why.
The existence who enacted and forged this amethyst Existential Authority was right before her.
And even more astonishing...he had multiple Authorities established as 12:01
Existential!
Was it always such an easy thing to do?
Yes, they weren't as potent as Vitalis and Vacuous, but this distinction alone was something that had escaped the grasp of many others- and there had been a few Honored Ones that came close.
So...what exactly was this Entity she had initially thought was interesting, but was now turning out to be someone even she couldn't fathom?
And the even more important question was...did he truly believe he could wage a war against the Ones Above Extremity? That he would...actually win?
At this moment, she didn't have an answer.
But she wouldn't doubt just yet.
She needed more information.
She had to understand this being first.

And the best way to do so...was to grasp exactly what his Existential Authorities held, and just what depth the so called Quintessential Annals of Extremity where she had begun to have honorariums recorded in were!
The moment this thought came, and before she could do anything else...
HUUM!

Bells rang out across these starry domains filled with tendrils of multicolored light as The Cimmerian Architect and Solarium turned their heads upwards- noticing a bundle of light appearing above them in the form of...a treasure cache.

The Cimmerian Architect squinted her eyes as she reached out towards this cache that shone with multicolored light as the moment she touched it, it exploded into a stream of prompts that washed over her eyes.
[You have unlocked the Newcomer Treasure Cache of Quintessence.]

[Within it lies introductory information of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven you are currently located in, the Banner of Quintessence, the Quintessential Annals of Extremity, the Existential Extremity Authorities of Quintessence and Infinity, and more.]
[The Extremity of Tyranny provides this information to you so that you can have no excuse when it comes to traversing across the Gradations with Quintessence and Infinity.]

[The only states of Existence currently available to traverse in are Quintessence and Infinity, with every inhabitant of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven being given a choice between a state of Existence to dedicate their path of Extremity on.]

[Once a state of Existence has been chosen, one will attain a Source of the Tyrannical Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage and undergo a transformation to prepare their existence for Quintessential Awakenings or Infinity Awakenings.]
The information from the Newcomer Treasure Cache of Quintessence was abundant as waves of information flowed into the mind of the Cimmerian Architect.
Her eyes shone brightly as she shifted through everything, taking less than a millisecond before she spoke calmly.
[Infinity.]
HUUM!
Her decision was resolute as for her, even though Quintessence burned with a shocking allure...her Intuition told her to embark on Infinity!
She was a Reader of Records.
She sought to understand and analyze countless records of all things.
For this, she could only touch upon Infinity and see just what this Existential Authority held in store!

She wasn't the only one having to make a decision at this moment as all newly arriving entities obtained a Newcomer Treasure Cache of Quintessence, with the visage of Extremity Solarium beside the Cimmerian Architect being difficult as she still found it hard to accept that she was nearly scorched out of existence by Vitalis.
All the while her own Polychrome Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of Vitalis acted as if they weren't hers to begin with!
Feeling this fresh sense of betrayal, Solarium closed her eyes as her soul led her towards Quintessence.
From her and the Cimmerian Architect, blinding lights began to shine. One with a Colorless radiance, the other with an endless blue light.

They were on the Fifth Gradation of Extremity as their light was much brighter than most, but across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, many beings made a choice as they received an introduction and acclimation to the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!

A distance away, a unique existence formerly known as the Seer of Sima looked at this scene as her own soul coursed with the Tyrannical Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage, bursts of Quintessence coursing across her vessels as she shook her head with a wry smile while gazing around her.
[Primogenitor, you really do have a ridiculous Holy War in store for these old bones...but, at least the Existence here seems fun!]

chapters.title: Chapter 2820 The Existential Paths to Follow! II
paragraphs: 2820 The Existential Paths to Follow! II
Trillions of entities from the Seven Clans and Major Inheritances of the Nether Havens of Extremity were acclimating and learning about the new lands they were in.
While this occurred...
[With the pillar of Quintessential Schrodinger's Paradox and state of Quantum Indeterminacy, The Quintessential Annals of Extremity near the completion of their intricate construct.]

[Quintessence and Infinity are the biggest pillars supporting the Quintessential Annals of Extremity as a backbone, with the Extremity of Quintessence benefiting greatly from the advancement and elevation of these Annals.]
Noah's grand ideals and constructs were coming to completion as he was faced with a heavy and dark future ahead.

A future where at this moment, his mere presence in the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains was met with an existential judgment, and would likely meet such a reaction should be ever appear again!
What did this mean?
That he could never again appear in the domains of the Seven Havens of Extremity?
That he would have to be fearful of even stepping out of his home?!
HUUM!
His very existence buzzed at such questions as Tyranny roared with silent indignation.
No.
His path was a grand one, a miraculous one, and one filled with innumerable trials.
But it was never a weak and cowering one.
With this in mind, his body within the center of the Extremity Vein released an untold splendor as he thought of the information he had obtained from the Cimmerian Architect.
Information on the Ones Above Extremity.
And he then paired this information with the rise of his Extremity of Paradox and the Quintessential Schrodinger's Paradox and state of Quantum Indeterminacy!
All of this came together and was then infused as mere ideas into his existence as moments later...
[Your Unrecorded Epochal Infinity Existential Hyperversal Extremity Physiology has successfully formed.]
[Your Unrecorded Tyrannical Quintessential Existential Hyperversal Extremity Soul has successfully formed.]
[Your Unrecorded Quintessential Infinity Existential Hyperversal Extremity Origin has successfully formed.]
BOOM!
At the center of the Extremity Vein of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, Noah's body was seemingly about to erupt with cataclysmic waves of Extremity when an instant later...
WAP!
Everything was calmly contained in his body as not even a trace of an aura leaked out.
And yet...he carried an air of glory and honor as very few beings would even be capable of gazing at him from afar- with any who were closer to him forced to lower their gaze!
He felt the power of his body.

The trillions of cerulean cells in the form of Infinity symbols making it up caused him to feel a sense of overwhelming power and strength as the cycling of blood across his vessels was akin to a high speed engine.
He resonated with his soul and felt an interminable Bastion of Quintessence surrounding it- with intricate Runic Scriptures weaver across his soul that interlinked and resonated with each other!
Then...there was his Existential Origin.

It was no longer in the form of a massive tower like structure of layered Havens as currently, Noah's own Extremity Vein of Quintessence was reflected across his origin as this...was where his Havens centered around.
Not in stacks of Havens, but the massive Aletheian Havens within his Origin were akin to mystical floating landmasses that rotated around the radiant multicolored Infinity symbol!

9 majestical Aletheian Havens followed the coursing authority within the Extremity Vein as they were in constant movement, and the type of Authority continued within them was not isolated anymore as within a single Aletheian Haven, Noah could see the authority of Dreams, Genesis, Avalon, Elera, Penumbra, Elysium...and more!

His Aletheian Havens were equilibrated and altered as equal amounts of authority flowed across all 9- with the Havenly Authorities of the Seven Havens being kept within Noah as since the moment he obtained them...
Quintessence had altered them to make them his.
They did not belong to Vacuous or Vitalis as these authorities- he kept!

Their existence also shed light on Noah's undoubtedly dark path ahead as there was the question of how he could fight enemies that he could not see. Enemies he had no information about, and enemies who could see him right away in the domains of their existence.

There was no clear answer...but the Havenly Authorities provided a point of attack. If he could make the Havenly Authorities his already, then his war against Vacuous and Vitalis could be waged on the very Seven Havens they supported- those outside of the Extremity Vein and the Supernal Havens within it!
And the moment this thought came to Noah...
[The Nine Existential Aletheian Havens of Extremity rotate around the Extremity Vein of Quintessence and receive constant nourishment.]
[The Extremity Vein of Quintessence paves the way for advancement and states that within it, new Aletheian Havens can now be built on the basis of any possible Authorities of your choosing.]

[Your Existential Origin is now of insurmountable importance as this, and your advancement across the Gradations of Extremity will be a key factor in the elevation of your Existential Extremity Authorities.]

[The Usage, Refinement, and Advancement of the Existential Extremity Authorities by your Vassals is secondary, but also of insurmountable importance as depending on the sheer number of beings involved, the advancement of your Existential Extremity Authorities can progress rapidly.]
The path forward for his Origin was laid out, and the importance of utilizing other beings to further elevate his Existential Extremity Authorities was laid out.
Noah's eyes shone brightly as he gazed around the changing Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
Currently, he couldn't step out of it, nor could any of the inhabitants within it.

It meant that the Cerulean Instance Dungeon Portals of Infinity were about to be of great importance as they would allow the progression of his people and for them to use, refine, and further advance his Existential Extremity Authorities by their means of warping entities across Records!
But...was it intricate enough at this moment to allow the volume of beings that had just stepped into the Infinite Hyperversal Haven?
[The Extremity of Systems raises its head with pride and states that the Dungeon System of Extremity is advancing to an unblemished state.]
His Concepts were himself, and he was his concepts.
His will lay dormant as his concepts followed it even without him having to exert himself actively!
This was the wonder of his Concepts of Extremity!
And as Noah theorized how to move forward...
HUUM!
His Existence began to buzz and resonate as new sets of prompts descended.
[Due to the nature of your Existence, you have gained the distinction of Indeterminate Quintessential I Existence.]
[You are in a constant paradoxical state of uncertainty, of existence and non-
existence as apart from the Quintessential Annals of Extremity, it is nearly impossible for other Entities, Authorities, or Annals of Extremity to perceive you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 2821 Eons of Change I
paragraphs: 2821 Eons of Change I
Indeterminate Quintessential I Existence!
It was a state of distinction granted to Noah due to his Existence becoming reforged under the light of Quintessence and Infinity.

In the past, he had the Inscrutable II Existence distinction from following the path of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities, but the mere first distinction of Indeterminate Quintessential I eclipsed Inscrutable by light years.
Its usage...may just be critical in allowing Noah to do what he sought to do in the future to come.
There were many more prompts that arose afterwards as Noah needed to consolidate all of them and understand just how powerful his new Aspects of Existence were.

By that time, things would also progress for those who had just entered the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as the path for them would also bloom- the Dungeon System of Extremity and its pivotal role in allowing for the usage, refinement, and the elevation of the current Existential Extremity Authorities fully unfolding then.
HUUM!

Noah's eyes closed as they radiated a profound cerulean brilliance, his will coursing through his body and traversing across trillions of cells in the form of Infinity symbols as he viewed his Meridians, his Reality Passages, his Aletheian Havens, and so much more!
200 Milliseconds after the reverberation of the single word |UNGRATEFUL| and the subsequent cleansing across the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains.
Above the lands of the Prometheus Clan in the Nether Haven of Oceanus.

Idyllic islands floated in bubbles of blue seas that rotated like individual Cosmos- domains that used to be filled with life and grandeur as now, there was a sense of tension and urgency as Extremities moved within.

Outside of these domains, the figures of the Extremity Clones of Seer Amestris and the Avernus Extremity Overlord could be seen as their eyes shone brightly, their pupils coming to lock onto each other as if they faced an unprecedented opportunity!
Seer Amestris was the one to speak as a deep smile was carved on her face, her worries finally fading after a hard few days where it seemed that the Avernus Clan was on the precipice of destruction.

[All Seven Clans were affected. Over half of all of their forces had taken the Blood Sources linked to Noah Osmont, with some like the Havenly Moon Clan reaching over 90%. And now...they have all faced Havenly Retribution and perished as their lands, domains, and deep history...]
Seer Amestris didn't need to continue.

The idea she placed towards was a profound one as from their perspective, the Seven Clans were cleansed out of existence along with the Major Inheritances of Extremity that were connected to Noah, and it was only the remaining members of the Avernus Clan who were enemies with him that were spared!

She could locate any traces of the major existences within the Seven Clans in the Vitalis Annals of Extremity as the only conclusion to this was their deaths through the Havenly Retribution observed across the domains.
Hearing her words, the Avernus Extremity Overlord smiled with regality and power as he gave an order.

[Assemble our remaining forces. Even we shall move ourselves as the goal...is to eat up any remnant forces of the Seven Clans and Major Inheritances of Extremity. Have them swear and Oath of Extremity to be wholly loyal to the Avernus Clan as only in death can they depart from it!]
WAA!
His gaze was a ferocious one of a mad emperor.
This whole time, he had been suppressed time after time by a being he hadn't even known about weeks ago, and finally...finally...

[It is time for us to change the History of the Seven Havens. There shall no longer be Seven Clans and Major Inheritances of Extremity...only the Avernus Clan taking reins of the Nether Havens of Extremity. Seven Nether Havens...
under one Avernus Clan!]
BOOM...CRACK!

His words were ecstatic as the moment they finished, the blue starry space above their Extremity Clones here- and even their main bodies in the Supernal Havens of Extremity...the space above cracked open as massive milky white circles of light appeared!
Heavy Existential Extremity Authority pulsed from the intricate makeup of Rune Scriptures as its appearance instantly caused Seer Amestris and the Avernus Extremity Overlord to turn fearful.
Were...were they about to face Havenly Retribution as well?
This thought was a shocking one as they were unwilling, but could do nothing as tendrils of thick milky white light instantly shot down and came to bathe their existence.
And...
Seer Amestris and the Avernus Extremity Overlord still felt their existence.

They didn't just feel their existence, they felt a profound and shocking elevation of it as extremely Pure Existential Extremity Authority flowed into and propped their concepts of Extremity- their souls also beginning to see the formation of a dense number of Polychrome Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures as the level of their Existence rapidly began to rise!
They were utterly shocked and exuberant at such a scene.
They felt their stagnant status within the Gradations of Extremity begin to move as around them, Vitalis Hyperversal Authority turned into a dense sea that surged into them.
In 10 milliseconds, they jumped from the Fourth Gradation of Extremity and came upon a heavy door that should have taken them a great deal of years, but...
CRACK!
As if the bottleneck never existed, it broke as their Existence ascended upwards.
Into the Fifth Gradation of Extremity!
[Haha!]
The Seer of Avernus laughed wildly amidst the storm of Vitalis around them.
How quickly things changed.
How shocking the paths that opened up could be!

She didn't fully understand why, but due to their animosity with Noah Osmont, they were receiving a baptism of power that they had never read about across Recorded History as their might rose to shocking levels.
Was it just their reward, or did it mean something else?
Why would the Ones Above Extremity do this for them? What benefits did they gain?
Could it mean...that Osmont was not fully eradicated, and they were planning on using those he held animosity with as conduits to track and bring him into their grasp?

Indeterminate Quintessential I Existence!
It was a state of distinction granted to Noah due to his Existence becoming reforged under the light of Quintessence and Infinity.

In the past, he had the Inscrutable II Existence distinction from following the path of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities, but the mere first distinction of Indeterminate Quintessential I eclipsed Inscrutable by light years.
Its usage...may just be critical in allowing Noah to do what he sought to do in the future to come.
There were many more prompts that arose afterwards as Noah needed to consolidate all of them and understand just how powerful his new Aspects of Existence were.

By that time, things would also progress for those who had just entered the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as the path for them would also bloom- the Dungeon System of Extremity and its pivotal role in allowing for the usage, refinement, and the elevation of the current Existential Extremity Authorities fully unfolding then.
HUUM!

Noah's eyes closed as they radiated a profound cerulean brilliance, his will coursing through his body and traversing across trillions of cells in the form of Infinity symbols as he viewed his Meridians, his Reality Passages, his Aletheian Havens, and so much more!
200 Milliseconds after the reverberation of the single word |UNGRATEFUL| and the subsequent cleansing across the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains.
Above the lands of the Prometheus Clan in the Nether Haven of Oceanus.

Idyllic islands floated in bubbles of blue seas that rotated like individual Cosmos- domains that used to be filled with life and grandeur as now, there was a sense of tension and urgency as Extremities moved within.

Over half of all of their forces had taken the Blood Sources linked to Noah Osmont, with some like the Havenly Moon Clan reaching over 90%.
And now...they have all faced Havenly Retribution and perished as their lands, domains, and deep history...]
Seer Amestris didn't need to continue.

She could locate any traces of the major existences within the Seven Clans in the Vitalis Annals of Extremity as the only conclusion to this was their deaths through the Havenly Retribution observed across the domains.

under one Avernus Clan!]

paragraphs: 2822 Eons of Change! II
Multiple theories flowed in the mind of Seer Amestris as she didn't know the right answer.
Whether it was just a reward they received, or whether there were many strings attached to it...did not matter.
[We have received a Havenly Mandate...a Mandate! Our thoughts are not wrong!]

Her voice echoed out grandly as beside her, the figure of the Avernus Extremity Overlord felt the overflowing power at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity that continued to rise as his pupils radiated purple white flames of majesty and regality.
[Seven Nether Havens...one Avernus Clan!]
WAA!
An unexpected elevation bloomed in this region and continued, the landscape of the Seven Havens about to change greatly due to it!
Away from this region, in the Supernal Havens of Extremity within the Extremity Vein.
In the skies where the Obsidian Saurischian Archipelago used to be.

A visage of a shockingly beautiful woman filled with a sense of wildness and craziness could be seen, Tendrils of Lunacy vibrating around her as she was starting at the destruction of the land she was near of when it was smited out of existence.

But now, she stared above as thick snake like tendrils of milky white Vitalis Hyperversal Authority cascaded down and came to bathe her body, her unstable realm at the Fourth Gradation of Extremity that she had just stepped into beginning to rise!
She didn't understand why.
But she didn't have to.
She held her obsession with the man who had infected her soul with Virions that nearly cost her life.
Inside Lunacy, this obsession didn't die.
It also meant that Noah Osmont...did not die!

After hearing his adulations and Honorariums of his name ring out across the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains, her pride and honor had been shaken as Lunacy went even crazier at the fact that she may not be powerful enough to take care of her obsession!
But now...
HUUM!

Tendrils of white grandeur surrounded her as Polychrome Hyperversal Havenly Extremity Rune Scriptures of VITALIS bloomed in her soul, Awakenings beginning to unfold one after another as she went towards a grand destination.
[Ah, Little Osmont...I know you're still alive. Come out, come out!]
Maddening waves of Lunacy echoed out as even more changes occured here!
In another region.
In the isolated domain where the Bard of Vitalis used to be, and where dozens of terrifying Entities at the Sixth Gradation of Extremity or higher had appeared momentarily Milliseconds ago.
The Main Body of the Prime Devourer stood alone in this region, still in shock at how things had played out as one way or another...he had actually succeeded in his goal.
But in his puzzlement and wonder...
BOOM...CRACK!
His soul shuddered as he felt the appearance of an obsidian cluster of unidentifiable Rune Scriptures above, followed by tendrils of pristine obsidian light smashing into him as....

He blinked in shock and alarm as he felt his stagnant progression at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity shoot up indiscriminately, coming to arrive at the uncrossable gates of the Sixth Gradation of Extremity as in the milliseconds that followed...the gates holding him back from a shocking power began to break!
It was a shocking scene reminiscent of what was occuring in the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains.
It was hard to accurately say why it was happening, or what the True intent for those behind these actions were.
But undoubtedly, it ushered in an era of change as after all of this, things would never be the same.
Far away from the Vitalis Hyperversal Domains, an even grander scene was playing out within the Vacuous Hyperversal Domains.
In a corner of the Haven of Perdition.
Seas of obsidian Perdition rose and fell chaotically as the aura of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority was particularly potent, the whole Haven seeming like a domain devoid of reality and time.
In a space surrounded by tendrils of Perdition.
Everything moving in its chaotic manner when suddenly....
SHAA!

Tendrils of deeply cerulean light suddenly emerged- these tendrils of light covered by a silent power and authority as within moments, it transformed into an illusory figure of a handsome young emperor.
He gazed around carefully with eyes burning with tendrils of blue light as he spoke with a hint of caution and serenity.
[Are you able to feel me?]
His gaze turned up as if he was speaking to the space around him, and yet there was no answer.

The blue light within his eyes became even more concentrated as the longer he waited and heard no reply, his lips began to curve into a devilish smile as he was ever so certain...that he had succeeded!
[Good...you came for me, so I'll be coming for you now.]
WAA!
With a flicker of cerulean grandeur, the illusory figure of the Great Usurper disappeared- almost as if he were melding into the reality around him.
Rumors and whispers of his death were greatly exaggerated.
He returned from a perilous point in his life once more as this time, he would ensure such a type of peril never presented itself again!
Inside the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
The Cimmerian Architect felt the new Existential Extremity Authority flowing within her as she was comparing it to Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.
Vacuous always held a cold regality and power as with it, one could power and expand upon the state of non-existence, non-reality, and the absence of time and space.
When she felt the endless blue light of Infinity coursing through her...she could sense an overabundance of existence.
Existence that seemed to be coursing endlessly as with it, she could sense the possibilities of endless time and space, of possible realities that stretched out with no end.

It gave her the illusion that she could continue following Infinity endlessly, that even if she somehow reached the Ninth Gradation of Extremity...she could still go further on an endless path of power!
She let out a light gasp and came back to herself as she stepped out of the stage of rich Infinity.
The feeling she just had felt like an illusion, and yet real at the same time as it caused the Cimmerian Architect to compare Infinity to Vacuous Hyperversal Authority!
If Infinity was elevated greatly enough...she felt that it may actually be possible for it to overcome Vacuous Hyperversal Authority!
This possibility alarmed her as before she could think any further...
WAP!
The space around her warped as with a cerulean flash, she disappeared.
When she came to again, the scene around her was a glorious one as she was surrounded by intensely burning authorities that caused her heart to palpitate.
Her eyes flashed as she turned her gaze ahead where she felt a heart shaking aura, expecting to see the visage of the man responsible for all this.
A visage of Noah Osmont.
And yet...
Her pupils dilated at the scene of a woman covered by waves of multicolored light similar to the massive Havens she had seen in the domain she was just in.
She sat on a glorious blue throne taking the form of an Infinity symbol, with her gaze cold and callous as if she never held a trace of emotion in all her life!
This...was not Noah Osmont.
-End of Chapter-

The blue light within his eyes became even more concentrated as the longer he waited and heard no reply, his lips began to curve into a devilish smile as he was ever so certain...that he had succeeded!
[Good...you came for me, so I'll be coming for you now.]
WAA!
With a flicker of cerulean grandeur, the illusory figure of the Great Usurper disappeared- almost as if he were melding into the reality around him.
Rumors and whispers of his death were greatly exaggerated.
He returned from a perilous point in his life once more as this time, he would ensure such a type of peril never presented itself again!
Inside the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
The Cimmerian Architect felt the new Existential Extremity Authority flowing within her as she was comparing it to Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.
Vacuous always held a cold regality and power as with it, one could power and expand upon the state of non-existence, non-reality, and the absence of time and space.
When she felt the endless blue light of Infinity coursing through her...she could sense an overabundance of existence.
Existence that seemed to be coursing endlessly as with it, she could sense the possibilities of endless time and space, of possible realities that stretched out with no end.

It gave her the illusion that she could continue following Infinity endlessly, that even if she somehow reached the Ninth Gradation of Extremity...she could still go further on an endless path of power!
She let out a light gasp and came back to herself as she stepped out of the stage of rich Infinity.
The feeling she just had felt like an illusion, and yet real at the same time as it caused the Cimmerian Architect to compare Infinity to Vacuous Hyperversal Authority!
If Infinity was elevated greatly enough...she felt that it may actually be possible for it to overcome Vacuous Hyperversal Authority!
This possibility alarmed her as before she could think any further...
WAP!
The space around her warped as with a cerulean flash, she disappeared.
When she came to again, the scene around her was a glorious one as she was surrounded by intensely burning authorities that caused her heart to palpitate.
Her eyes flashed as she turned her gaze ahead where she felt a heart shaking aura, expecting to see the visage of the man responsible for all this.

chapters.title: Chapter 2823 The Dungeon System of Extremity! I
paragraphs: 2823 The Dungeon System of Extremity! I
It was not Noah Osmont!

Around her throne made from a curved Infinity symbol, authorities of Manadynamics, Entropy, Continuity, Gravitation, Polarity, and all other Natural Laws swirled along with Dreams, Avalon, Elysium, and other Decreta.

She was adorned in a dress that was half colorless and half radiating pure blue light, her facial features hazy, but they still gave the Cimmerian Architect the thought that the beauty was one even she was slightly lesser in comparison to.
And in the next moment, her authority reverberated out as her words made it seem like her authority was undeniable.
[You have information regarding my enemies.]
WAA!
The voice gave the Cimmerian Architect goosebumps as simultaneously, the same words appeared as prompts in front of her face.
Prompts she had been seeing rising and falling this whole time as she received a great shock!
[You...] She pointed towards the Entity on the throne as she continued.
[You are the manifestation of...the Infinite Hyperversal Haven? The Quintessential Annals of Extremity?]
The Cimmerian Architect couldn't believe it.
The very domain she was in had such versatility and capability of independence?
As if to ascertain her words, even more set of prompts bloomed in first of her eyes.
[An Astounding Achievement!]
[You have gained the honor of gazing at the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.]
[If you can prove your usefulness before her, you will climb ever higher on the Banner of Quintessence!]
The eyes of the Cimmerian Architect became sharp.
The entity on the throne didn't open her mouth, and yet she answered her at the same time.
The Cimmerian Architect felt like she was facing a heavy and sacred entity as with sharp eyes, she spoke lightly.
[The Ones Above Extremity...we have Records of them dating back eons and eons of Recorded History.]

[From the changing tides of the Havenly Lineages and Clans within the Vitalis Domains, to the Infernal Lineages and Factions within the Vacuous Domains. There have been times where they freely showed themselves before- whether by chance or in passing in front of Primogenitors or Honored Ones, and there have been eons where no traces of them were found.]
As she spoke, the Cimmerian Architect seemed to be recalling heavy details of an ancient past, the entity before her listening silently.

[The time that showed off their power the most was in front of an Honored One who was discussing with his longtime friend about the possibility of reaching the Eighth Gradation of Extremity...and how after rising to such a stage, he may just be able to instantly elevate his main concept to an Existential level while having enough power to separate himself from Vacuous and Vitalis, that there may actually be another path for all of them. And...do you know what his dear friend said?]
Trepidation danced in her eyes as he continued.
[His longtime friend looked at him and smiled while stating...'Well, we can't have that, can we?']
WAA!

[Such a statement shook the Honored One to his very core as an instant later, all the Records in the surroundings shook as the wills of many distinguished Primogenitors were pulled to that domain, and they were forced to observe as an Entity about to grasp the Eighth Gradation of Extremity fell to his knees from a single tap of the Entity he had been sharing records with for eons. With a single tap, he was brought to his knees, with another tap, his Records and very being were entirely erased.]

[The gazes of Primogenitors and other Honored Ones were drawn there purposefully to observe such a scene. As if they were being given a blatant warning not to reach out where they shouldn't. Thereafter, that Entity disappeared before all eyes there and never reappeared again throughout the eons that followed- only leaving behind the sense of awe and fear of the Ones Above Extremity as after that day, even the discussion of Existential Extremity Authorities apart from Vacuous and Vitalis were taboo. And from then on, others did their best to move outside of the influence of the Ones Above Extremity. To not be under their gaze as much as possible.]
At this flow of information, the Will of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven radiated glory on the throne as she spoke a singular word.
[Records.]
HUUM!
Her eyes shone brightly while stating this as the Cimmerian Architect nodded with surprise while continuing.

[Yes, many left the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains and shifted their domains towards Records. They set up shop in Recorded or Unrecorded Histories for those who are truly powerful as even though the gaze of the Ones Above Extremity may still penetrate through, but it is not as present as within the Havens filled with Vacuous and Vitalis. Within Recorded or Unrecorded Histories themselves, the things one does or speaks about aren't as easily recorded, as one is already living inside records of records. The less of a footprint they leave behind, the more they can move around.]
The more powerful beings made their homes in Records that had occurred eons ago, or in Unrecorded Histories of events that had yet to even occur!
Why was it that no Primogenitors could be seen freely within Clans or Inheritances?
Why did entities like the Extremity of Steel or the Hero of Vacuous make their legends within the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains before they disappeared?
They...simply did not want to have such a large footprint of Records left behind in the eons that followed!
[Of course, creating a brand new database of Records before enacting an Existential Extremity Authority...what Osmont manage-]
BZZT!
The authorities in the surroundings raged madly as the Cimmerian Architect felt a heavy sense of oppression and suffocation all around her.
The gaze of the entity of the throne became sharp as the Cimmerian Architect couldn't help but curse.

[Fucking hell...the Extremity of Infinity. What the Extremity of Infinity managed to do is something no others have done. And thus, we are where we are today. Since he was being cleansed out of the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains, if he wants to appear within them again, it may only be feasible through Recorded or Unrecorded Histories.]
The surroundings calmed as the Cimmerian Architect silently cursed.
She couldn't refer to the Emperor of these lands with his name anymore lest this Will before her become displeased!

chapters.title: Chapter 2824 The Dungeon System of Extremity! II
paragraphs: 2824 The Dungeon System of Extremity! II
One woman looked at another.
One was a manifestation of a shocking and unfathomable construct as the other was merely an Entity seeking change and truth!

The Cimmerian Architect had said that if Noah wanted to appear outside of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, it may only be possible within Records where the gaze of the Ones Above Extremity wasn't as pervasive.

[Of course, his cleansing today should have also been one that was used as a warning. I heard the word |UNGRATEFUL| resound across Records and the Domain we were in, so solace can be taken that the most recent Honored One was likely used as an example and deterrent for others to not even think of doing the same thing. So it may be hard to rally any support from the powerful Primogenitors if the Extremity of Infinity starts wading through Records, as if he nears anyone...they may just expose him as nobody wants to be cleansed out of existence next. We are all seeking ways to overcome the Ones Above Extremity, but when an Entity like...your Master comes along, it is hard to say if he will gain any support from the Primogenitors and Honored Ones who have managed to remain alive in the Seventh or Eighth Gradation of Extremity this whole time. And without the support of others who had been trying to fight for eons...I truly don't know how all of this will pan out.]
The gaze of the Cimmerian Architect was difficult.
She was trying to see a path forward.

How an Entity that had managed to expand Existential Extremity Authorities at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity could somehow manage to overcome those who had exceeded the Ninth Gradation of Extremity.
Entities who were literally named the Ones Above Extremity!
What exactly...was above Extremity?
The moment her words finished, her surroundings began to buzz again as the Cimmerian Architect cursed, wondering what the hell happened now.
On the blue throne of Infinity, the Manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven gazed forward with indomitable splendor as a resolute voice echoed out.

[The Extremity of Tyranny issuing an Existential Declaration of War was not putting into account any aid or help from other Primogenitors or Honored Ones. Our victory is not dependent on any others who have been making Records for eons without affecting an iota of change. Our victory will be carved into existence with our own means...with the inhabitants of these great Lands working to make it into a pristine reality.]
HUUM!

The moment she finished speaking, she raised her hands up as the whole space became bathed in a shocking amalgamation of light, the Cimmerian Architect finding herself thrown out while she cursed as she continued to hear the authoritative voice along with its prompts booming all around her!
[Quintessence and Infinity will pave the way across the Nine Gradations of Extremity for those who seek brilliance.]

[The Extremity of Systems expresses its authority and brings to light the Dungeon System of Extremity as the pathway of the quickest and most efficient tool to traverse across the Gradations of Extremity.]

The Cimmerian Architect found herself thrown back right where she was initially at as before her eyes and the eyes of trillions of Entities across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, such prompts appeared as their eyes were drawn towards the center of these unfathomable lands and Havens.
Near the intersection of the blazing lines of the Extremity Vein of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
Elodie...the Cimmerian Architect felt her soul buzz as the figure that had been veiled in blinding lights this whole time could be seen by all of them.
His eyes held Nine Pupils that swirled with trillions of Infinity symbols.
His hair was dark, and yet every strand coursed and flashed with a cerulean light of Infinity ever so often.
His fair skin glowed with stellar might as his face was sharp and filled with devilish handsomeness!
A royal purple robe draped over him like a grand emperor from ancient times as around him, 9 massive wheels of terrifying light swirled with utmost majesty.
Some flashed with a gorgeous Cerulean hue, others with a Colorless light of Quintessence, and others with a blaring amethyst light of Tyranny.
His mere presence and figure felt suffocating for others to even stare at as at this moment, his gaze seemed to be sweeping across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
And everywhere it passed, others inextricably felt their eyes lower just slightly!
Those from the Seven Clans and Major Inheritances.
The Cimmerian Architect and Solarium.
Aurelia, Orion, Maximilian, and those of the Learnean Lineage.
Barbatos, Athena, Henry, and the Emperor Penguin.
Dr. Hall, Lilith, and Xiaomi.
With the eyes of these beings and trillions more staring towards him, the entity bathed in light moved his hands as the very makeup of reality seemed to be moving and affected by his mere movements.
And he...tapped the space before him.
BOOM!
[The Extremity of Systems opens the Existential Raid Rift System.]
Space splintered and cracked open as a massive Cerulean rift portal far exceeding the Cerulean Instance Dungeon Portals of Infinity in size bloomed.
It was so massive that it seemed similar to the size of one of the Havens within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!

[Inhabitants of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven can challenge the Existential Raid Rift in varying levels of difficulty for the sake of elevating their power across and into the Gradations of Extremity.]

[True Death is not possible within the Existential Raid Rift as any Entities on their last Vitality Values will face a False Death that disallows them from stepping into any Rifts of the Dungeon System of Extremity for the next 12 hours.]

[For those who manage to overcome and defeat the most powerful Challengers within, they will be rewarded with Armaments of Extremity, Planalith Krystallos, Existential Skill Books, and Varieties of Loot that will rapidly elevate one Across the Gradations of Extremity and earn them Honorariums to be on the Banner of Quintessence.]
Shocking prompts came as the hearts of the watching Entities beat ever faster.
They looked at the massive blue rift as its darkness fluctuated to reveal light.
Within the Existential Raid Rift, a shocking scene could be seen.
Stretching out for light years and standing atop stellar multicolored floating land masses, millions upon millions of titanic Enders of Extremity in the forms of majestic beasts could be seen.
Dragons, Phoenixes, Serpents, Qilins, Winged Tigers...or combinations of such Entities.
All of them were coursing with one or two Authorities of Extremity that correlated with past Natural Laws or Decreta.
All were on the First Gradation of Extremity or higher.
Towards the very forefront of these endless Legions of Enders of Extremity, the massive visage of none other than Hyperion could be seen.
His body was far faster than all others there, his size exceeding a Cosmos as his figure coursed with Manadynamics, Entropy, Continuity, Dreams, Elysium, and multiple other Concepts burning brightly!
He...was already emanating an aura grandly at the Fourth Gradation of Extremity, and it seemed to still be rising and nearing the Fifth Gradation of Extremity even now.
His Draconic Elephantine form full of majesty and valor gazed out from the Existential Raid Rift and onto the masses.
And his trunk raised to bellow out as a crimson gold prompt bloomed before their eyes!
[The Existential Raid Boss Hyperion welcomes the challenge of those wishing to traverse across Quintessence and Infinity!]
For the sake of elevating the power of Noah's Existential Extremity Authorities.
For the sake of strengthening themselves against enemies that were currently far, far more powerful than them.
A portion of the capabilities of the Dungeon System of Extremity were unveiled!

chapters.title: Chapter 2825 The Dungeon System of Extremity! III
paragraphs: 2825 The Dungeon System of Extremity! III
A chance for the inhabitants of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven to elevate their existence.
A chance for them to attain glory and honor within the Existential Raid Rift as it served multiple purposes all at once!
[The Extremity of Loot relishes in the forging of the Dungeon System of Extremity!]
[Loot Caches shall flow in overabundance for those worthy!]

The scene expressed within the massive rift the size of a Haven flashed as above the figures of millions of Enders of Extremity, Golden, Obsidian, and resplendent Crimson colored treasure chests and treasure caches appeared.
They gave off an enticing look as the very souls of Entities quivered when they looked at them!
Thereafter, the scene within the Existential Raid Rift disappeared as a cerulean radiance bathed everything, its interior a mystery until those who sought to enter approached it.
[The Extremity of Quintessence expresses that there is no need to worry about any forces outside of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven- their influence cannot reach here.]
[Focus on seeking greater power and glory of your Existence, focus on Extremity...and everything else will follow.]
They had no need to worry about Vacuous or Vitalis Malignancies entering this domain and causing any wars.
No distinction of Clans or Inheritances!
No worry of the Ones Above Extremity!
There was only...the search for Extremity.
The millions of Extremities from different factions looked at each other with heavy breaths at such a scene.
Each one held their own thoughts as at this moment, their souls were pulling them towards the dazzling cerulean Existential Raid Rift.

In a corner of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, the visage of Lilith had left the Cerulean Instance Dungeon Portal of Infinity as she gazed at other Portals and the even more massive Existential Raid Rift.
There were many choices to choose from, but her soul told her that undoubtedly, the Existential Raid Rift would have the most rewards!
With its size being akin to that of a Haven, anyone could be near its light and majesty.
Lilith only floated close to it before a cerulean bordered box rose in front of her eyes.
[You can now enter the First Existential Raid Rift of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.]
[The Difficulties available to select are Golden Difficulty, Obsidian Difficulty, Crimson Difficulty, and Tyrannical Difficulty.]
The glimmering test box in front of her was a dazzling one as just for the sake of seeing more about this System, Lilith went ahead and selected the Tyrannical Difficulty!
[You have selected the Tyrannical Difficulty.]

[Based on your Existence, it is recommended for you to start on the Mode of Golden Difficulty. The chances of meeting a False Death within 1 Millisecond in the Mode of Tyrannical Difficulty are 99.99%.]

The possibilities of Loot were endless, and it seemed like one had to successfully enter, clear, and repeat this Raid Rift Difficulty multiple times in order to gain the truly precious things it offered!
With a more powerful party...
Lilith gritted her teeth at this as she joined the randomized que.
Connections were a form of strength, and she had not forged any.
She couldn't be a part of a powerful party with Entities like Barbatos, Kazuhiko, or the Emperor Penguin that were always close to the side of the Extremity of Quintessence.

With her eyes blazing with Flames of Hatred, she began a new Queue as the party leader as she would decide how many random Entities joined in before she began the raid!
Realities like this began to play out all across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as nobody wanted to be the last.
Those who understood things a little bit more knew that for the greatest achievements, they had to be first!

In a certain region, the Son of the Extremity of Quintessence came to bathe in the light of the Existential Raid Rift as behind him stretched out hundreds of the core powerhouses of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
RAA!
