chapters.title: Chapter 2826 The Dungeon System of Extremity! IV
paragraphs: 2826 The Dungeon System of Extremity! IV
Reality warped and twisted around them as they entered the Obsidian Difficulty of the Existential Raid Rift and found themselves teleported into a vast and ancient Record.
Around them, shattered Royal Elysium Cosmos floated all around as in the distance, a golden sea seethed with glory!

Atop this Sea, the auras of hundreds of Enders of Extremity at the First and Second Gradations of Extremity could be seen, with there being dozens ofEnders at the Third Gradation of Extremity that uniquely took on the forms of the Reality Ursidae, Infinite Willow Trees, Dragon-Phoenix, and the Astral Race.
And at the forefront of these Enders at the Third Gradation of Extremity, there was actually a man.
A man that currently seemed to be steeped in darkness as his hair flowed with an obsidian light, and her his eyes shone with a resplendent golden hue of Destiny.
His stature was made to be larger than even the Enders of Extremity themselves as he was a few thousand miles in size- being equivalent to a Small World in stature.
When Henry, Kazuhiko, Emperor Penguin, and others saw him, their gazes changed to ones of shock as they remembered the extremely handsome face of this entity.
They...had even hunted down this Entity before!
[How befitting for you to be the first one I come across...O Son of Destiny.]
The voice of this Entity echoed out resoundingly as it ridiculously stood at the Fourth Gradation of Extremity.
The Extremity of Prana flowed across his Veins as with any Raid Boss, his Vitality Values were greatly inflated as killing him would require blood, sweat, and tears!
Tendrils of destiny swirled around him as seeing the shock of his opponents, this entity continued.

[I am despondent and even more surprised than you all are. I came back merely as a Record of my old self. A glimpse of what I used to be after my greatest Enemy yet...merely sent his son to kill me as he couldn't even be bothered. He had grown so powerful that even if I considered him a great enemy, to him...I was merely an Extra. And now, I truly am a Quintessential Extra that has merely taken the place of an Ender of Extremity. But even though I am not truly me...even though I am merely a collection of Records...
the Extremity of Destiny courses through and resonated with me.]
HUUM!
As the man spoke, the golden seas below him seethed as the Enders of Extremity behind him roared.
His gaze came to lock onto the Son of Destiny in the distance as a massive golden spear appeared in his hands.

[I never reached the Extremity of Destiny, but it flows across every single part of my Record due to the Will of Infinite Hyperversal Haven- due to your Father's Will. And I wish to see whether I truly deserved to be killed by you. I wish to see whether you have simply been riding on the Destiny of the one responsible for all of this, or if you can actually forge your own.]
WAA!
His presence was massive and oppressive as nobody had expected to ever see this being again, nor in such a position of power!
Even if he was just a Record and not the past being himself...this was still the past True Emperor that had reigned in the Age of Destiny.
The Past True Emperor of Destiny.
The Empyral Deceiver!
Oppenheimer!
HUUM!
Infused with the authority of an Ender of Nature, 3 Natural Laws and 3 Decreta flowed through him as at this moment, a heavy prompt rose.

[Prove your concepts of Extremity and take down the Obsidian Raid Boss- Oppenheimer. Failure to do so will result in a complete wipe out and restriction of using the Existential Raid Rift for 12 hours.]
Henry gazed at this prompt as he felt his blood burn.
He felt as if his Father- no, he felt as if the very Infinite Hyperversal Haven was testing him.
After all, this couldn't be random.
And if this was a test...they it wasn't one that he could fail!
[On me!]
He bellowed out commandingly as those behind him erupted with auroras and blazing auras that glimmered with Quintessence or Infinity.
RAA!

An Emperor Penguin enlarged as with a bellow, it and many others followed the lead of the Son of Destiny and charged towards a golden sea filled with Enders of Extremity and a supercharged Oppenheimer in the lead!
This...was the inside of one version- one record of an Obsidian Difficulty.

One by one, other parties had begun to enter the Golden Difficulty as they tested their own power and luck as at this moment...the usage, refinement, and elevation of the Existential Extremity Authorities under Noah began in full swing.
The means of the Extremity of Systems were shown to be terrifying as it worked intricately with the Infinite Hyperversal Haven to show off a glimpse of its current power.

It's shocking means regarding Alchemy and Blacksmithing weren't even unveiled as currently....just its sheer capability of producing terrifying Enders of Extremity advanced in the Gradations of Extremity through its infusion of Natural Laws and Decreta...this alone was enough to make any construct terrifying.
But the Infinite Hyperversal Haven wasn't any construct.

It was something supported by an Extremity Vein quire literally with the shape of an infinity symbol as its pillars of support that were the Natural Laws and Decreta...were all pulled towards Extremity.
All at the level of Quintessential Zenith.
It then held Existential Extremity Authorities flowing through it and constantly altering its very Existence.
It then had the Quintessential Annals of Extremity basking it and elevating it to an even greater level!
Its origin was a mere Spiritual Land, yes.
But currently...it was something that even Noah may have not yet fully ascertained as what it could currently do was already obscene to ridiculous margins!
And in the midst of all of this...
[MacGuffin rises from its slumber.]
Outside of the Existential Raid Rift he had just called out, Noah saw this prompt appearing as he felt a part of himself behind to pulse wildly.
[The Extremity of MacGuffin has made its choice.]
[The Dungeon System of Extremity shall be the first idea- the first construct that future plot will revolve around.]
The first MacGuffin was chosen in such a shocking manner as even though this was his own Will, even Noah was surprised!
But in the next moment...
[Even more Concepts of Extremity surge to support the Dungeon System of Extremity.]
[The Extremity of Conquest, Plot, Apocalypse, Devouring, Gluttony, Armageddon, Wrath, and many others infuse their Extremity Authority into the Dungeon System of Extremity.]
WAA!
[The methodology of stripping away the authority of the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Domains begins to unveil itself.]
[The Existential Dungeon Apocalypse feature is coming to fruition!]

chapters.title: Chapter 2827 The Dungeon System of Extremity! V
paragraphs: 2827 The Dungeon System of Extremity! V
The feature of Existential Dungeon Apocalypse.
Such a resonant prompt buzzed within Noah's mind as multiple of his Concepts of Extremity surged into the Dungeon System of Extremity that was deemed a MacGuffin!

It's usage was already prominent and of insurmountable importance as the elevation of the Existential Extremity Authorities was planned to occur through it- allowing the inhabitants of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven to go higher and higher with this tool.

But now, its importance and relevance to the unfolding Reality and Unrecorded History was about to become even grander- to the extent that it would even be capable of affecting the Vacuous and Vitalis Hyperversal Domains!
[The Extremity of Quintessence, Infinity, and Tyranny impose themselves deeply to allow for the function of the Existential Dungeon Apocalypse to come to fruition.]
[The Extremity of Paradox overlaps its will to reduce improbabilities and mask any possible understanding.]
[The Extremity of Systems pulsed with fortitude and guide all incoming authorities forward!]
Parts of him.
His Will.

Each of them moved in sequence as no part of his soul moved unless he willed it, and his concepts of Extremity that made up who he was all moved like a well oiled machine in order to achieve the most stupendous results.
The change was hard to see as it was a conceptual one.
But Noah felt it within the depths of his soul.
He felt it with his connection to the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as what his concepts sought to do right now was something utterly grand!
The cost for it...would be a heavy one.
HUUM!
The stable Extremity Vein of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven seethed as the Existential Extremity Authority of Infinity within it surged to be used as the source of power.
An Endless source of power!
Quintessence and Tyranny layered themselves thereafter to see if the conceptual theory of the Existential Dungeon Apocalypse would be fully realized.
It was the 900 Millisecond since Noah had begun to stretch his Records towards Infinity.
This single stretch of a second...would very soon come to an end as the things that were accomplished within it were of insurmountable wonder and honor!
BOOM!
Seas of Providence and Destiny seethed as Crimson Hyperversal Extremity Rune Scriptures bathed in a golden color mixed and clashed.
The Obsidian Difficulty of the Existential Raid Rift was not an easy one.

The Enders of Extremity taking on the forms of Infinite Willow Trees, Reality Ursidae, Dragon-Phoenix, and the Astral Race were terrifying enough as what the Emperor Penguin, Kazuhiko, Sword Emperor and many others among the hundreds in the party of the Son of Destiny came to realize...they could not get through their defenses.
Their bodies coursed with multiple types of past Natural Laws and Decreta.
They were representative of the Concepts of the Extremity of Quintessence!
A single Ender of Extremity carrying the Decretum of Prana was akin to a fortress who received all attacks with ease.
And no Ender of Extremity held just a single Concept as most held two or three coursing across their existence!

Most of the few Hundred entrants coming in with Henry were the finest Entities originally in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven before the inclusion of those from the Seven Clans and Major Inheritances of Extremity, and the vast majority were just on the upper tier of the First Gradation of Extremity, with less than 25% reaching the Second Gradation of Extremity along with their bodies being filled with the Lineage of the Tyrannical Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor.
A semblance of Quintessence, Infinity, and Tyranny flowed through them as this granted them a powerful edge.
Those at the First Gradation could release power equivalent to the Second Gradation.
Those at the Second Gradation could match average Tier 3 Entities on the scale of the Vacuous or Vitalis Domains!
But their enemies this time were those stemming from the very depths of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
Bred by the very Land that gave them power!
RAA!

The Emperor Penguin roared out in shock as while exhibiting rotating Obsidian Hyperversal Extremity Rune Scriptures of Pride that put him on the early steps of the Third Gradation of Extremity- a type of power only possible with the First Quintessential Awakening allowing for the rapid proliferation of his Rune Scriptures...he found himself pushed back by a massive Reality Ursidae pulsing with droves of Entropy.
His circling Rune Scriptures of Pride were shattering and being eroded by the Crimson Hyperversal Rune Scriptures of Entropy!
His very pride...was quite literally being put to the test.
BOOM!
And towards the fire area of the battle- in the center of the raging golden sea of destiny and providence.
A massive figure of Oppenheimer the size of a small world stood tall above the halcyon sea as his massive golden spear dripped of crimson gold blood.
Ahead of him, the Son of Destiny lay with his chest split open, his handsome expression dazed as his strands of dark blue hair were stained with blood.
His Crimson Hyperversal Rune Scriptures of Destiny were pierced through.

With the golden xyston of Oppenheimer swirling with thousands of Rune Scriptures of Providence and Destiny, he couldn't stop the strike of this raid boss who stood powerfully at the Fourth Gradation of Extremity!
The gaze of the Raid Boss Oppenheimer was a calm one as he spoke out.
[I am merely a record that has a semblance of the authorities of the Extremity of Quintessence flowing through me. A semblance of your father's destiny...
and you cannot even compare to this mere semblance.]
WAA!

[What use are you? Why were you destined to share such a connection with a being like him? It would be best iff you simply cut yourself off of him as the way you are now...it is a shame to consider you his only progeny.]
HUUM!
Utterly cold words echoed out.

Words that were followed by a horrific action as as the golden spear in the hands of the despondently handsome Oppenheimer began to spin- Providence, Destiny, and Manadynamics having their Rune Scriptures swirl and rotate as a blinding blue and gold light struck down to utterly end the life of the Son of Destiny and wipe out his whole party from this Raid!

He felt it with his connection to the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as what his concepts sought to do right now was something utterly grand!
The cost for it...would be a heavy one.
HUUM!
The stable Extremity Vein of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven seethed as the Existential Extremity Authority of Infinity within it surged to be used as the source of power.
An Endless source of power!
Quintessence and Tyranny layered themselves thereafter to see if the conceptual theory of the Existential Dungeon Apocalypse would be fully realized.
It was the 900 Millisecond since Noah had begun to stretch his Records towards Infinity.
This single stretch of a second...would very soon come to an end as the things that were accomplished within it were of insurmountable wonder and honor!
BOOM!
Seas of Providence and Destiny seethed as Crimson Hyperversal Extremity Rune Scriptures bathed in a golden color mixed and clashed.
The Obsidian Difficulty of the Existential Raid Rift was not an easy one.

The Enders of Extremity taking on the forms of Infinite Willow Trees, Reality Ursidae, Dragon-Phoenix, and the Astral Race were terrifying enough as what the Emperor Penguin, Kazuhiko, Sword Emperor and many others among the hundreds in the party of the Son of Destiny came to realize...they could not get through their defenses.
Their bodies coursed with multiple types of past Natural Laws and Decreta.
They were representative of the Concepts of the Extremity of Quintessence!
A single Ender of Extremity carrying the Decretum of Prana was akin to a fortress who received all attacks with ease.
And no Ender of Extremity held just a single Concept as most held two or three coursing across their existence!

Most of the few Hundred entrants coming in with Henry were the finest Entities originally in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven before the inclusion of those from the Seven Clans and Major Inheritances of Extremity, and the vast majority were just on the upper tier of the First Gradation of Extremity, with less than 25% reaching the Second Gradation of Extremity along with their bodies being filled with the Lineage of the Tyrannical Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor.
A semblance of Quintessence, Infinity, and Tyranny flowed through them as this granted them a powerful edge.
Those at the First Gradation could release power equivalent to the Second Gradation.
Those at the Second Gradation could match average Tier 3 Entities on the scale of the Vacuous or Vitalis Domains!
But their enemies this time were those stemming from the very depths of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
Bred by the very Land that gave them power!
RAA!

The Emperor Penguin roared out in shock as while exhibiting rotating Obsidian Hyperversal Extremity Rune Scriptures of Pride that put him on the early steps of the Third Gradation of Extremity- a type of power only possible with the First Quintessential Awakening allowing for the rapid proliferation of his Rune Scriptures...he found himself pushed back by a massive Reality Ursidae pulsing with droves of Entropy.
His circling Rune Scriptures of Pride were shattering and being eroded by the Crimson Hyperversal Rune Scriptures of Entropy!
His very pride...was quite literally being put to the test.
BOOM!
And towards the fire area of the battle- in the center of the raging golden sea of destiny and providence.
A massive figure of Oppenheimer the size of a small world stood tall above the halcyon sea as his massive golden spear dripped of crimson gold blood.
Ahead of him, the Son of Destiny lay with his chest split open, his handsome expression dazed as his strands of dark blue hair were stained with blood.
His Crimson Hyperversal Rune Scriptures of Destiny were pierced through.

With the golden xyston of Oppenheimer swirling with thousands of Rune Scriptures of Providence and Destiny, he couldn't stop the strike of this raid boss who stood powerfully at the Fourth Gradation of Extremity!
The gaze of the Raid Boss Oppenheimer was a calm one as he spoke out.
[I am merely a record that has a semblance of the authorities of the Extremity of Quintessence flowing through me.
A semblance of your father's destiny...
and you cannot even compare to this mere semblance.]
WAA!
[What use are you?
Why were you destined to share such a connection with a being like him?
It would be best iff you simply cut yourself off of him as the way you are now...it is a shame to consider you his only progeny.]
HUUM!
Utterly cold words echoed out.

Words that were followed by a horrific action as as the golden spear in the hands of the despondently handsome Oppenheimer began to spin- Providence, Destiny, and Manadynamics having their Rune Scriptures swirl and rotate as a blinding blue and gold light struck down to utterly end the life of the Son of Destiny and wipe out his whole party from this Raid!

chapters.title: Chapter 2828 The Dungeon System of Extremity! VI
paragraphs: 2828 The Dungeon System of Extremity! VI
The words of Oppenheimer buzzed in Henry's mind as the spinning spear filled with vibrant Crimson Rune Scriptures only caused his eyes to tremble.
His eyes that turned unyielding.
His eyes that began to burn with a semblance of Tyranny!
[OOOH!]
With his figure nearly split in half, he bellowed out while activating a single feature.
[Quintessential Entity I Form.]
Unlike many others, he had an overabundance of Quintessence flowing through him due to the pureness of his Lineage.
He called out to it.
A form that only those who had undergone the Second Quintessential Awakening could adopt!

A form that only he had access to as at this point in time, all other Extremities with the Tyrannical Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage had only undergone their First Quintessential or Infinity Awakenings.
[The number of Rune Scriptures flowing across your existence have been momentarily tripled!]
[The purity of your Tyrannical Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor Lineage is extremely high.]
[All Rune Scriptures momentarily gain the authority of Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures.]
[If your Vitality Values ever drop below 10% while in this form, you will undergo a Quintessential Rebirth that returns your Existence to its prime state for a maximum of three times.]
[The length of time you can maintain the Quintessential Entity I Form will depend on the purity of your lineage.]

His body shone with glorious splendor before a stellar form of an Entity as vast as thousands of miles emerged, his form humanoid and filled with a crystalline Colorless light as his hand reached out to stop the advancement of the roaring spear within the hand of Oppenheimer!
An aurora of colorless wings expanded behind his back as they buzzed like a celestial engine.

His visage became visible as his skin pulsed with an otherworldly crystalline Colorless light, his head cosmic as it only held a pair of eyes that held Nine Pupils spinning gloriously with a multicolored light!
Thousands of Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Destiny began to swirl around his body.
He stared at the Raid Boss ahead of him as with simmering emotions, Henry uttered out.
[Interminable Destiny]
HUUM!

Behind him, endless rivers of destiny began to manifest and buzz with an interminable light of power, their brilliance now backed by Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures as like rivers of reality intent on establishing the hegemony of the Son of Destiny- they thundered down unto the Raid Boss- Oppenheimer!
At such a show of power, Oppenheimer's gaze was cold as tens of thousands of Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures began to gather around him as well.
[During the rise of my past self in the Desolate Mausoleum, I targeted one Dimension in particular the most. Do you know which one this was?]
Sandy gold light began to buzz around Oppenheimer in addition to golden seas of Destiny and Providence.
[An authority that could turn Dreams into a reality. A dangerous thing that I sought to snip off quickly. And now, through the grace of your father...it flows through me.]

In opposition to the interminable rivers of Destiny cascading down from the attack of Henry, miniaturized Cosmos filled with the Colorless Hyperversal Quintessential Extremity Rune Scriptures of Dreams supported by Destiny and Providence began to manifest gloriously around Oppenheimer, their number ballooning up to hundreds as they entirely covered the halcyon skies of this domain!

In the distance, the figures of the Emperor Penguin, Kazuhiko, and others who were already struggling in the hands of the terrifying Enders of Extremity were forced to look up as the scope of this attack...was so wide that when it thundered down, it would very likely encompass them as well.
Conjuring an Ultimate Skill, the Raid Boss Oppenheimer emanated an aristocratic light of grace and majesty as his will bore down.
[The purpose of this record of mine here is to test you. But I...plan to bury your destiny in a haze of dreams so deep that it will never rise out of its slumber.]
WAA!
With indomitable might, the Ultimate Skill of the Raid Boss Oppenheimer thundered down as an Area of Attack that covered the whole expanse of the domain.
It was a light that brought shock and disbelief at the unbelievable level of power displayed by the Raid Boss of the Obsidian Difficulty.
It was a light...that would result in the wipeout of the party of hundreds that followed the Son of Destiny.
It was a reality check that unless they advanced and attained means that were truly Quintessential...they would not be able to stand proudly in the wake of what was to come!
Outside of this challenge of the Obsidian Difficulty of the Existential Raid Rift.
In a Domain inaccessible by the masses, with entry allowed only to those granted and one Entity who could freely go in and out.

Seas of the past Natural Laws and Decreta seethed with power and pulsed with more authority every passing millisecond, and a cerulean throne in the shape of a curved Infinity symbol could be seen as atop it, a Manifestation shrouded in waves of Colorless, Cerulean, and Amethyst tendrils of power sat down serenely!

Her gaze was a calm and calculating one as all around the current throne, illusory screens depicting the scenes occurring across multiple Records entrenched within the Quintessential Annals of Extremity were playing out.

One illusory screen showed the terrifying screen of the party that the Son of Destiny had entered with be entirely wiped out, his figure being the only one remaining as he underwent a Quintessential Rebirth two times over at this point.
The Manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven was calm at this scene as she watched it with impartiality.
What she wanted to do was to cultivate Existences worthy of the Master's path and concepts.
Existences who could innovate on their own and not simply rely on what he could grant them!
At this moment in time, they were all still subpar.
None would come to be as bright as the Master, but they at least needed to show their own unique brilliance.
Otherwise, they would only be left behind.

So she watched on calmly as the Son of Destiny radiated waves of power, seeking his best to prevent it but...even his third Quintessential Rebirth was used up as ultimately, he also faced a False Death.
The first challenged Existential Raid Rift of the Obsidian Difficulty failed!
It was within the expectations of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

If others truly wanted to gain exponential power, they would have to grind from lower Difficulty Raid Rifts over and over again- accumulate Caches of Loot to elevate their Existence, and only then could they think of overcoming the Enders of Extremity that held in the existence...Quintessential Zenith Concepts of Extremity!
Ones that were Dead Paths to expand for others.
Ones that the Extremity of Quintessence brought to their current stage.
Did they truly expect to defeat such concepts with two or three of their own that had attained Extremity?
The eyes of the Manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven were bright as at this moment, her voice echoed out.
[You will preside as the Raid Boss of the Tyrannical Difficulty.]
Her voice was a commanding one.
She wasn't alone currently in this domain as another figure radiating shocking authority was behind her throne.

The figure was silent at the command of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as a hint of defiance and power could be seen in their eyes, but eventually...they gave a nod nonetheless as waves of crimson gold light pulsed with majesty.
[...Understood.]

chapters.title: Chapter 2829 The Existential Dungeon Apocalypse! I
paragraphs: 2829 The Existential Dungeon Apocalypse! I
The Manifestation of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven spoke in a commanding tone towards an Entity floating behind her throne as this Entity...nodded with a hint of understanding and defiance!
She was currently here as her own manifestation, her true body being located in the very depths of the Infinite Forge of the Eternity of Extremity.
Her true body that had undergone such tremendous levels of transformations as currently...Existential Extremity Authorities were branded onto her very being.
She wasn't the Ruined Blade any longer.
She was the Existential Sword of Quintessence- Ruination!
Her hair burned with a crimson gold light as a fiery red dress draped over her manifestation, her pupils radiating a Colorless light as the rims of her eyes pulsed with blue.

Her skin was tinged with runic lines all around that radiated a royal purple light- a light of Tyranny that supported her defiance towards the Infinite Hyperversal Haven she had completed with long, long ago.
But at this moment in time, Ruination could no longer deny that she had lost in that completion.
The Infinite Hyperversal Haven had grown to the extent that it was indispensable to the Master.
After its connection and enactment of the Quintessential Annals of Extremity, and the lead role it was currently taking to support the Master...the result was a clear one!
But...she still held her own uses and capabilities of great impact in what was to come.

As the Existential Sword of Quintessence, her capabilities to multiply Loot had grown to a terrifying level that at this moment...she affirmed the reality that as a Zenith Quintessential Middle Grade Armament of Extremity, she could multiply Middle Grade Armaments of Extremity and Middle Grade Planalith Krystallos!
This was just one of her capabilities as when it came to the Loot to be utilized as rewards for the Existential Raid Rifts and for the empowerment of their Master, she would also be indispensable.
When she thought of this subject, her fiery eyes gazed at the throne before her as she asked calmly.
[Have you begun to produce the Armaments of Extremity and Planalith Krystallos? The first set of beings to clear an Existential Raid Rift may appear soon.]
The Loot for the beings who were powerful and intuitive enough to actually kill a Raid Boss had to be there for them.
And the Infinite Hyperversal Haven seemed to have planned for everything as she nodded without an ounce of emotion.

[The Quintessential Dowager is overseeing the production of Planalith Krystallos in the Existential Extremity Alchemy Hall. I am taking the lead in the Production of everything else within the Existential Extremity Blacksmith's Forge. All products will be funneled to you here to be multiplied.]
The Quintessential Dowager.
The Mother of the Extremity of Quintessence!

Ruination heard these words as she nodded, different parts of her existence going to different domains at this moment as she accepted the boons that came with taking on the role of the Raid Boss of the Tyrannical Difficulty.
For those who would face her...she could only utter prayers for them.
For they would be facing a part of the strength of the very Extremity of Quintessence!
In a region of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
The Cimmerian Architect gazed at the dazzling blue rift portal as she uttered out with sharp eyes.
[A means to elevate and challenge those encompassed by the Existential Extremity Authorities...without resorting to endless cycles of war.]
She thought of the endless wars between the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Domains.
One side killed another constantly as through the fires of war, powerful entities rose and fell.
But at the end of it all...it was only Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities that benefited.

The Extremity of Quintessence went a different direction and designed a construct that did not jeopardize the Records of those involved, and they could choose to enter or not as their path was in their own hands!
The Cimmerian Architect loved to make comparisons as so far, this Entity she didn't fully understand seemed to be going in a unique direction.
While she perused the information herself, a voice perked up behind her.
[Do you want to try the Crimson Difficulty of the Existential Raid Rift together?]
Beside her, Extremity Solarium voiced out calmly as Elodie blinked her eyes while turning towards her.
This entity was one she was fighting with hundreds of milliseconds ago, and yet now...there was no distinction between them!
Their Vacuous or Vitalis origins did not matter in these new lands as Solarium knew this well, and whether she was forcing herself or not, she reached out towards the Cimmerian Architect calmly.
A moment later, Elodie shook her head with a smile.

[That big Draconic Elephantine Entity is likely in there, with the more hidden Records I can peruse also showing the appearance of some...Arch Lich? My intuition tells me a dozen or more Tier 5s will be needed to possibly clear it. I can't even guess what lies at the Tyrannical Difficulty, but that should be fun when you step into the Sixth Gradation of Extremity, or if you have hundreds of Tier 5s with you...]
WAA!

The words of the Cimmerian Architect were shocking ones as this was only her intuition and may not be fully accurate, but she always trusted it for the most part as a moment later, she chose a difficulty herself and disappeared right after.
She went solo!

Her reality flashed as she felt herself crossing records, and a moment later, she stood in a domain above a halcyon sea seething with power, fractured golden cosmos floating all around as a huge Legion of Enders of Extremity lay ahead of her.
And at the forefront...was a regal aristocratic man the size of a world that gazed forth coldly.
[You have chosen the Solo Mode of the Existential Raid Rift.]
[If the Raid is cleared, rewards will be even more substantial!]

[Prove your concepts of Extremity and take down the Obsidian Raid Boss- Oppenheimer. Failure to do so will result in a complete wipe out and restriction of using the Existential Raid Rift for 12 hours.]

The Cimmerian Architect- an Entity at the Fifth Gradation of Extremity, and one who was particularly powerful in this stage...chose to go solo on the Obsidian Difficulty that held a Raid Boss at the peak of the Fourth Gradation of Extremity!
